약물 냄새가 가득한 복도에서 연구원이 주사기를 든다. 실험체는 이미 어딘: The researcher holds a syringe in a hallway filled with the smell of chemicals. The test subject has already disappeared somewhere. The research is not yet finished.
The sparring in the training hall ends like this. They received orders to test the candidate.
수련장의 목검이 칼날로 바뀌었다. 대련 상대는 말이 없다. 가문에서 칼을: The wooden sword in the training hall has turned into a blade. The sparring partner says nothing. This is what it means to learn the sword in this family.
서고의 책을 아무에게도 보여 주지 않는 것이 일이다. 후보에게도 예외는: Their job is to show the books in the archives to no one. There are no exceptions, even for candidates.
서고 문 앞을 하인이 막아선다. 후보에게도 열어 주지 않는 책이 있다고: The servant blocks the door to the archives. They say there are books that are not opened even for candidates. A needle glints inside their sleeve.
Anyone who breaks the family laws must be stopped, even if they are a candidate. It is the bodyguard's duty.
복도 끝에서 호위무사가 칼자루를 쥔다. 가문의 법을 어긴 사람에게는 후보: The bodyguard grips their sword hilt at the end of the hallway. Even a candidate is no exception for someone who has broken the family laws.
They guard the branch family's ledgers and block the path of candidates trying to buy the position of family head.
방계의 집사가 장부를 덮고 일어선다. 웃는 얼굴 뒤로 칼이 나온다. 가주: The butler of the branch family closes the ledger and stands up. A blade emerges from behind their smiling face. This is how the money changing hands for the position of family head moves.
The etiquette of Hong-Won begins with the sword. As an instructor, they must test the candidate's blade.
검술 교관이 수십 해째 쥔 장도를 뽑는다. 홍원의 예법은 칼에서 시작한다: The fencing instructor draws the long sword they have held for decades. They are the person who taught with their own body that the etiquette of Hong-Won begins with the sword.
매 라운드 내게 공허한 순종이 쌓인다(스택당 명중 −2). 흑수 부하가: Each round, Hollow Obedience accumulates on me (-2 Hit per stack). It decreases by 1 each time a Black Water subordinate assists, and is completely cleared by "Black Waters, Answer Me."
철함사의 가장 깊은 곳에서 짐수레가 굴러 나온다. 수레 위에는 선황충이: A cart rolls out from the deepest part of the Iron-Box Temple. The Divine Yellow Worm is curled up on the cart, and the one pulling it is the body of a person once called Gamo. Hon-Gak-On-Ryang-Heuk-Su. One who, without achieving true enlightenment, became a cart serving the Divine Yellow Worm itself, bound by old traditions. The elders bow their heads behind them. Hollow Obedience fills the room.
수레가 멈췄다. 선황충이 숙주를 잃고 바닥에서 몸부림치다 향 속에 말라: The cart stops. The Divine Yellow Worm loses its host, writhes on the floor, and withers within the incense. The elders could not rise. Gamo's body muttered one last time: that a disobedient family head has come for the first time.
머리가 다시 문을 연다. 이미 한 번 쓰러뜨린 상대가, 당신이 쌓은 금기: The Head opens the door once more. The opponent you already defeated stands before you, hardened by the taboos you have accumulated.
쓰러졌다. 머리는 이번에도 아무것도 내어 주지 않았다. 대신 걸어온 길만: They have fallen. The Head gave nothing away this time either. Instead, the value of the path you walked remains in your hands.
골목 끝 벽에 붉은 십자가가 그을려 있다. 한때 특색 해결사였던 이가 권: A red cross is scorched onto the wall at the end of the alley. One who was once a Color Fixer is running wild as a thrall. The hand that plunges the heated cross into the ground no longer retains its own name.
권속의 붉은 줄이 끊어졌다. 한때 특색이었던 이는 마지막까지 십자가를 놓: The red line of the thrall has been severed. The one who was once a Color could not let go of the cross until the very end. The red heat still remains on their palm.

보랏빛 칼날이 골목 벽에 가늘게 선을 긋는다. 뱀 비늘 같은 무늬의 장벽: A purple blade draws a thin line on the alley wall. 장벽의 비늘이 한 장씩 떨어졌다. 환도와 창과 건틀릿과 방패가 바닥에 흩: The scales of the barrier fell one by one. The curved sword, spear, gauntlet, and shield scattered on the floor. It was impossible to tell which was the original weapon. This is a person who can never be fully caught.

복구를 기다리던 살덩이 하나가 좌석 밑에서 일어선다. 눈이 있던 자리에: A chunk of flesh that was waiting for restoration rises from under the seat. Only a number tag is attached where an eye used to be.
수천 년을 버틴 승객들이 서로를 뜯어 하나로 뭉쳤다. 여러 입이 같은 말: Passengers who endured for thousands of years have torn each other apart and merged into one. Multiple mouths repeat the same words in the same rhythm. They say you cannot die inside the train.
동면 캡슐에서 나온 승객의 뼈 사이에 기계 장치가 박혀 있다. 누군가 이: Mechanical devices are embedded between the bones of a passenger who emerged from a hibernation capsule. Someone has repaired them into a doll. The doll wears a name tag.
수천 년 동안 한 가지 기술만 되풀이해 익힌 승객이 길을 막는다. 손에는: A passenger who has practiced only one technique for thousands of years blocks the path. Their hands are empty. Their hands are already weapons.
쓰러진 수련자의 등 뒤에서 낮은 박자가 한 번 울린다. 이 사람이 그토록: A low rhythm beats once from behind the fallen practitioner. That was the reason this person could not cross the wall despite so much practice. Like someone who knows the fact that you cannot die inside the train, it rises from the dried bloodstains on the carriage floor. A bloodfiend who received the blood of a parent bloodfiend three times over; a 3rd Thrall.
카세티의 숨이 끊어지자 객실에 흩어졌던 마른 핏자국이 한꺼번에 가라앉았다: As Casetti's breath stops, the dried bloodstains scattered across the carriage sink all at once. No one yet knows where the passengers who disappeared from this train have gone.
HP가 75% 아래로 내려가면 한 번, 피할 수 없는 광역 출혈 4와 H: Once when HP falls below 75%, unavoidable AoE Bleed 4 and HP recovery 12% · +2 damage per 1 Bleed against targets with Bleed (Max +10)
맨홀 뚜껑 옆에서 긴 갈고리를 든 사내가 쥐를 세고 있다. 쥐 대신 당신: A man holding a long hook next to a manhole cover is counting rats. Instead of rats, he counts your steps.
Those who go down into the sewer are believed to disturb the rats.
등불을 든 아이가 골목 어귀에 서 있다. 불빛이 당신 발끝만 비춘다. 아: A child holding a lantern stands at the corner of the alley. The light only illuminates your toes. The child does not show the way.
It is believed that when the lantern goes out, the person standing there becomes the light instead.
바닥에 분필로 선을 긋는 사내가 있다. 선을 넘어서자 사내가 천천히 일어: There is a man drawing lines on the floor with chalk. As you cross the line, the man slowly rises.
He tries to return those who crossed the chalk line back inside the line.
골목 안쪽에서 태엽 소리가 난다. 양철 인형이 같은 춤을 되풀이하다가 동: The sound of a mainspring comes from inside the alley. A tin doll repeats the same dance, then stops moving and looks this way.
They put spectators who stopped walking before the dance ended onto the stage.
비가 오지 않는데 우비를 입은 사내가 처마 밑에 서 있다. 모자 아래에서: A man wearing a raincoat stands under the eaves even though it is not raining. Water drips from under his hat.
He insists that the spot under the eaves belongs to whoever claimed it first.
어깨에 궤짝을 멘 사내가 골목을 막고 있다. 궤짝 안에서 무언가 숨 쉬는: A man carrying a crate on his shoulder blocks the alley. Something inside the crate is breathing.
You must keep the thing in the crate from opening to earn your daily pay.
시계를 빼곡히 건 좌판 뒤에서 장수가 웃는다. 시계는 모두 다른 시각을: The peddler smiles from behind a stall crowded with clocks. Every clock shows a different time.
He sells the time of those who do not buy his clocks.
쓰레기 더미 위의 개가 이를 드러낸다. 목줄은 끊겨 있고 주인은 보이지: A dog atop a pile of trash bares its teeth. Its leash is broken, and its owner is nowhere to be seen.
It guards the place where its owner vanished, chasing away strangers.
A child pokes their head out from a hole in the wall. The child repeats the same words: do not come in.
You try to lure them out of the hole to stay with you.
골목 한가운데에 벽돌을 쌓는 사람이 있다. 벽은 높아지는데 어디를 막으려: A person is laying bricks in the middle of the alley. The wall is growing higher, but it is unclear what they are trying to block.
You stop the person from letting out what should remain inside the wall.
연기를 병에 담아 파는 장수가 있다. 병을 열 때마다 골목의 시야가 흐려: A peddler sells smoke bottled in jars. Every time a jar is opened, the alley's visibility blurs.
You steal smoke from those who possess it but cannot bottle it.
골목 가로등 사이를 일정한 속도로 오가는 기계가 있다. 순찰 경로 안에: A machine moves at a constant speed between the alley streetlights. As you enter its patrol route, its eyes turn toward you.
You erase the variables that disturb the patrol route.
돌을 굴리며 칼을 가는 사내가 앉아 있다. 갈던 칼을 멈추고 당신의 칼: A man sits sharpening a knife while rolling a stone. He stops his work to watch how you hold your blade.
He tests those who possess a blade sharper than his own.
가면을 늘어놓은 좌판 앞에서 장수가 가면 하나를 건넨다. 받지 않자 장수: In front of a stall lined with masks, the peddler offers you one. When you refuse, the peddler's expression hardens like a mask.
He wants to take the face of someone who walks without a mask.
홍원의 대문이 닫힌 지 사흘째, 골목 끝에서 방계의 자객들이 길을 막는다: Three days after the gates of Hongwon were closed, assassins from the branch family block the path at the end of the alley. These are the faces that retreated from the candidate's door. This time, they haven't come to take the candidate, but to erase them.
자객들이 쓰러졌다. 방계는 오늘 밤 소식이 끊긴 이유를 가문에 알릴 것이: The assassins have fallen. The branch family will inform the clan why they lost contact tonight.
장부에서 이름이 지워졌어도 흑수는 서로의 걸음을 안다. 가문이 보낸 흑수: Even if their names are erased from the ledger, the Heuksu know each other's footsteps. The Heuksu sent by the clan stand on the road. These are people who once scrubbed the same floors and stood before the same doors. Instead of calling names, they draw their blades.
흑수들이 무릎을 꿇었다. 한 사람이 중얼거렸다. 필두가 나서야 할 것이라: The Heuksu have knelt. One muttered that the Head must step forward. That word reaches the Heads on the road before it even reaches the clan.
열두 흑수 중 필두의 자리에 선 이들이 직접 나섰다. 어르신의 명이 아니: Those who stand at the rank of Head among the twelve Heuksu have stepped out themselves. They do not take up their blades by the Elder's command, but out of the shame of one who has reached the same rank. No one knows a Head's blade better than another Head. The weight of the position you abandoned rises up behind you all at once.
필두들이 칼을 내렸다. 한 사람이 재갈을 풀어 길바닥에 놓았다. 가문은: The Heads have lowered their blades. One removed their gag and placed it on the ground. The clan will no longer send people; they will call Honglu.
붉은 누각의 등이 꺼진 밤, 붕대를 감은 사내가 길 위에 서 있다. 선황: On a night when the lanterns of the Red Pavilion are extinguished, a man wrapped in bandages stands on the road. Knowing the existence of the Seonhwangchung, Honglu has come personally to deliver the clan's will: a candidate who fled after abandoning the family cannot be left alive. The Heuksu who follow him rise one by one. Your candidate is behind you.
흑수들이 차례로 무너지고, 홍루는 붕대를 풀어 건넸다. 놓아 주겠다는 말: The Heuksu fall one by one, and Honglu unwraps his bandages. He did not say he would let you go. He only opened the path. Hongwon has released two people who held its secrets, and the fugitive is no longer pursued.
The traces of the passenger who had their blood drained have taken form. It approaches, seeking more blood to drain.
의자 아래에서 붉은 주머니 같은 것이 부풀어 오른다. 피를 짜낸 승객의: Something like a red pouch swells beneath the chair. The traces of the passenger who had their blood drained have taken form. It tries to bite before it bursts.
The pouch bursts, and dried bloodstains spread long across the floor.
연무장의 오랜 수련자: Veteran Trainee of the Training Hall
열차의 시간 속에서 수백 번 칼을 내려친 사람이 아직도 연습 상대를 찾는: A person who has swung their blade hundreds of times within the train's time still seeks a sparring partner.
연무장 한가운데서 한 사람이 칼을 내리고 있다. 5급 해결사의 증표를 단: In the center of the training hall, a person is lowering their blade. Bearing the badge of a Grade 5 Fixer, they have trained for hundreds of years within the time of this train. They have lost count of how long they have held a blade in a carriage where the sun never sets. Their hands have reached the skill of a Grade 2 Fixer, yet it is said that even after pouring in hundreds of years, they could never cross the wall of talent. The tip of the blade points toward you.
수련자가 칼을 내렸다. 5급의 증표가 바닥에 떨어졌다. 수백 년의 수련이: The trainee lowered their blade. The Grade 5 badge fell to the floor. This was the end reached by hundreds of years of training. Even knowing they could not cross the wall, this person never once let go of their blade.
서고 열쇠를 쥔 후보로서, 아직 부족한 후보를 치워 열쇠가 넘어가는 것을: As a candidate holding the library key, you intend to clear away an insufficient candidate to prevent the key from passing on.
서고 열쇠를 쥔 후보가 흑수 둘을 앞세워 길을 막는다. 열쇠를 넘기면 기: The candidate holding the library key blocks the path with two Heuksu in the lead. If you hand over the key, records will leak; if you clear away the insufficient candidate, the key remains. Fights between candidates are an old custom of the clan.
후보가 서고 열쇠를 내려놓았다. 가문에서는 지는 쪽의 이름을 한 번만 부: The candidate has set down the library key. The clan calls the name of the loser only once. Your candidate's name was called twice, and the bottom shelf of the library opened.
방계의 비법을 쥔 후보로서, 쪼개져 있던 기록이 합쳐지는 것을 막으려 직: As a candidate holding the secret of the branch family, you have stepped forward personally to prevent the fragmented records from being combined.
향의 비법을 쥔 방계 후보가 직접 나선다. 어엿해진 후보가 쪼개져 있던: The branch candidate holding the secret of the incense steps forward personally. They are the ones who fear most that a capable candidate might combine and read the fragmented records. The oldest of the twelve Heuksu holds their sword hilt nearby.
방계의 후보가 무릎을 꿇고 향의 비법을 내려놓았다. 쪼개져 있던 기록이: The branch candidate has knelt and set down the secret of the incense. The fragmented records have gathered in one person's hands. The next clan head has already been decided.
They arrive to find those who have broken the lake's taboos before the lake itself notices.
배 위에 낯선 그림자가 올라섰다. 젖은 외투에서 호수 냄새가 났다. 사냥: A strange shadow has boarded the ship. The wet coat smelled of the lake. The hunter did not ask for your name, but looked at your hands. They are the hands of one who has broken a taboo.
It tracks the scent of those who follow the ship.
A pale face has risen above the water's surface. Where eyes should be, there is only wetness. It grabs the ship's railing and slowly crawls up.
I was taught that if you can't take the ship, take the people instead.
한 손이 갈고리로 되어 있는 사내가 난간 위로 뛰어올랐다. 갈고리 끝이: A man with a hook for a hand has leaped onto the railing. The tip of the hook glints in the sunlight.
Even with a hook for a hand, he is a man who has made a living with a single blade.
눈이 날카로운 사내가 칼날을 들고 다가왔다. 한쪽 소매 끝에서 갈고리가: A man with sharp eyes approaches with a blade. A hook is visible at the end of one sleeve. His feet make almost no sound on the deck.
I have never once disobeyed an order to stand in the front line.
나무 방패를 든 덩치 큰 사내가 갑판 앞을 막아섰다. 방패를 쥔 반대쪽: A large man holding a wooden shield blocks the front of the deck. The hand opposite the one holding the shield is a hook.
I have come to reclaim the ship the captain entrusted to me.
The first mate, who has a hook for a hand, appears with a harpoon gun slung over his shoulder. The muzzle aims a span above your chest.
도시에서 구하기도 어려운 진짜 총을 쥔 사내다. 배 하나를 잃고도 물러서: A man who wields a real gun, something hard to come by even in the City. He does not retreat even after losing a ship.
한 손이 갈고리로 되어 있는 두목 오르카가 건너왔다. 다른 손에는 진짜: Captain Orca, who has a hook for a hand, has crossed over. In his other hand, he holds a real gun. It is a rare item in this lake.
A young whale wandering the lake, following its mother. It is sensitive to sound.
라운드에 내는 카드의 소음(코스트 합, 3타 카드는 +1, 방어 제외)이: If the noise of the cards played in a round (cost sum, +1 for 3-hit cards, excluding defense) exceeds the limit, you take fixed damage.
The young whale did not follow the ship. The lake has grown quiet again.
호수의 물결이 가라앉았다. 어린 고래 한 마리가 천천히 배 아래로 지나간: The ripples of the lake have subsided. A young whale slowly passes beneath the ship. The crew exchanged glances, signaling that staying silent is the best policy.
A young specimen that mimics its mother to lure ships with light.
빛 촉수가 남아 있는 동안 적중해도 본체에 피해가 들어가지 않고 촉수만: While the light tentacle remains, attacks do not damage the main body, and only the tentacles are destroyed one by one.
The light has faded. You barely managed to find your direction in the darkness.
어둠 속에서 따뜻한 황금빛이 아른거린다. 등대 불빛이라 믿고 다가갔더니: A warm golden light flickers in the darkness. You approached, believing it to be a lighthouse, only to find it was the tip of a young whale's tentacle.
어린 닻을 삼킨 고래: Young Whale That Swallowed an Anchor
A young whale that swallowed an anchor and refused to sink.

검은 숲 쪽에서 아무 소리도 들리지 않는다. 종말의 예언이 가리키던 곳이: No sound can be heard from the direction of the Black Forest. Your body knows that is exactly where the prophecy of the end was pointing. It is on a different level from anything you have met so far. If you go in, you might not come back.
숲은 문을 닫지 않았다. 예언은 아직 유효하다. 다음에는 돌아설 수 없을: The forest did not close its doors. The prophecy is still valid. Next time, you won't be able to turn back.
검은 숲이 다시 당신 앞에 와 있다. 이번에는 숲이 길을 비켜 주지 않는: The Black Forest is before you once again. This time, the forest does not clear a path.
밤하늘의 네 별이 한 줄로 늘어섰다. 그 끝에 붉은 붕대 한 자락이 걸려: The four stars of the night sky have lined up in a row. A strip of red bandage hangs at the end of them. Twelve footsteps approach one by one.

소지의 얼굴로 걷던 길 끝에 붉은 붕대 한 자락이 걸려 있다. 열두 번의: At the end of the path I walked with the face of a Finger, a strip of red bandage hangs. Twelve footsteps approach one by one.
붕대는 바닥에 내려앉았다. 열두 번의 발소리는 멀어졌지만, 끝난 것 같지: The bandage settled on the floor. The twelve footsteps have moved away, but it doesn't feel like it's over.
회전목마의 음악이 멈추지 않는다. 불 켜진 성 꼭대기에서 누군가 당신의: The carousel music does not stop. Someone is calling your name from the top of the lit-up castle.

약지의 초대장이 왔다. 신체파의 마에스트로가 당신의 작품을 직접 보고 싶: An invitation from the Index has arrived. The Maestro of the Body-Part faction says they want to see your work in person. The envelope smells of iron and bone dust.

서가 맨 안쪽에서 열쇠 소리가 났다. 관장이 당신의 이름을 새 책에 옮겨: The sound of a key came from the back of the Library. You have a feeling the Librarian is inscribing your name into a new book. 서랍 속 초대장은 이미 재가 되어 있었다. 열쇠 소리만 한동안 귓가에 남: The invitation in the drawer had already turned to ash. Only the sound of the key remained in your ears for a while.
문틈으로 지령 봉투가 들어왔다. 봉투에 적힌 대상의 이름이 낯익다. 당신: A directive envelope slid through the door gap. The name of the target on the envelope is familiar. It is your name.
지령을 받은 자를 기다린다: Wait for the one who received the directive
봉투를 태우고 구역을 떠났다. 대행자가 끝까지 쫓아오지는 않았다. 아직은: Burned the envelope and left the district. The messenger did not follow to the end. Not yet.

열기를 등지고 다른 골목으로 들어섰다. 그을린 십자가가 한참 시야에 남았: Turned your back on the heat and entered another alley. The scorched cross remained in your sight for a long time.
골목 벽에 보랏빛 선이 가늘게 그어진다. 뱀 비늘 같은 무늬의 장벽 너머: A thin purple line is drawn on the alley wall. Beyond a barrier with a snake-scale pattern, someone is heard switching their grip on a blade. 비늘 무늬의 장벽을 등지고 걸었다. 칼 쥐는 소리가 등 뒤에서 한참 따라: Walked with your back to the scale-patterned barrier. The sound of the blade being gripped followed you for a long time.

A black car is parked at the end of the alley. The window is half-down, and someone is looking this way. The hierarchy of the Thumb is confirmed by the blade. The Godfather has come to test your seat himself.
문 아래로 봉투가 들어와 있다. 안에는 숫자만 적힌 장부 한 장. 맨 아: An envelope has been slid under the door. Inside is a ledger sheet with only numbers. Your name is at the very bottom. The ledger of the Index lists everyone whose name is known without exception. Today, that ledger sheet is your turn.

고개를 숙이고 지나갔다. 뇌횡은 아무 말도 하지 않았다. 쇠 끌리는 소리: Bowed your head and passed by. Noehwang said nothing. Only the sound of dragging metal remained in your ears for a long time.
빗소리 사이로 쇠가 끌리는 소리가 들린다. 정장 차림의 사내가 검을 짚고: The sound of metal dragging is heard amidst the rain. A man in a suit stands at the end of the alley, leaning on his blade. 골목 끝에 어제까지 없던 문 없는 방이 생겨 있다. 방 안에서 누군가 당: A doorless room that wasn't there yesterday has appeared at the end of the alley. Someone inside the room is calling your name. 귀를 막고 돌아선다: Cover your ears and turn away

도시의 소음이 한순간에 사라졌다. 골목 아래에 소리가 들리지 않는 연주회: The noise of the City vanished in an instant. A concert hall where no sound can be heard has opened at the bottom of the alley. {n}의 손을 잡고 돌아섰다. 핏빛 밤의 발소리는 다른 골목으로 멀어졌다: Took {n}'s hand and turned away. The footsteps of the Blood-red Night faded into another alley. Not yet.
검계 수장의 집 마당에 빈 술병이 줄지어 서 있다. 낡은 도포 차림의 비: Empty liquor bottles are lined up in the courtyard of the Blade Lineage head's house. A twisted shadow in an old robe waits, tapping their scabbard. It is an old rule that one must compete for the position of leader at least once.

골목 끝에 낯선 서커스 천막이 세워져 있다. 어제까지 없던 자리다. 안에: A strange circus tent is set up at the end of the alley. It wasn't there yesterday. Music and applause are heard from inside, but the entrance is empty. An energy unlike anything you have met so far flows along the tent flaps.

천막을 등지고 걸었다. 박수 소리는 한참 따라오다 사라졌다. 다음에는 천: Walked with your back to the tent. The sound of applause followed for a while before disappearing. Next time, the tent will come looking for you first.

You heard someone laughing behind your back, but you didn't look around.

The words cling to your fingertips. A single sentence remains like a blade.
The words pierce your eyes. A headache lingers for a long time.

Your body grew sturdier from carrying heavy loads.
There was an accident. A flying fragment grazed your arm.
That night, a siren wailed from the direction of the factory for a long time.
작은 사무소가 계약서를 내민다. 해결사로 등록하면 위험수당이 붙는 일이다: A small Office presents a contract. If you register as a Fixer, you get hazard pay. The signature line is blank.
You received unfamiliar equipment. You are sharper for having taken the risk.
The terms have changed. Instead of a signing bonus, you received a useful item.
The representative frowned. Your daily wage was docked that day.
The contract was folded and placed inside a drawer.
An invitation is tucked into your mailbox. There is no sender's name, only an address. The arrival time is tonight.
On the way back, you were carrying a book in your hand.
The way back was different from the way there. You wandered for a long time.
You slept soundly for the first time in a while.
골목 구석에 쓰러진 사람이 있다. 숨은 붙어 있지만 오래 버티지 못할 것: Someone has collapsed in the corner of the alley. They are still breathing, but they don't seem like they will last long.
부축해서 병원까지 간다: Support them and go to the hospital
The feeling of having saved someone lingered for a long time.
You tripped while supporting them and tumbled together.
You have become accustomed to passing things by.
A year where nothing happened. Years like this are rare.
Your hands have become faster from consistent practice.
You overexerted yourself and your muscles stiffened.
비가 쏟아지는 날, 사람들을 다른 구역까지 데려다 달라는 부탁이 들어온다: On a rainy day, you are asked to escort some people to another district. The roads are slippery and the alleys are dark.
앞장서서 길을 연다: Take the lead and clear the way

비를 맞으며 모두를 무사히 데려다 줬다. 이런 길쯤은 눈을 감고도 걷는다: You brought everyone safely through the rain. You could walk paths like this with your eyes closed. You received a generous reward.
You slipped and fell. Someone else finished the escort.
붐비는 시장 한가운데에서 누군가 지갑을 낚아채 달아난다. 당신 지갑은 아: In the middle of a crowded market, someone snatches a wallet and runs. It is not your wallet.
You caught up at the end of the alley. The opponent offered something useful from their pocket.
You lost them. You are out of breath and your knees ache.
Your voice was buried by the crowd. Instead, you gained one more person who knows your name.
Two dice lie on an old box. The stake is a single roll.

The numbers were off. You were left with a bruise instead of the winnings.
You learned something by watching others lose.

You picked up a remaining fragment at the end. Your blade has become sharper.
Something rose up at the end of the marks.
The scratching sound followed you from far behind, but it faded away.
운행이 끊긴 역 승강장에 사람 하나가 서 있다. 표 한 장을 내밀며 어디: A person stands on the platform of a station where service has been suspended. They hand you a ticket and tell you to go anywhere.
도착한 곳은 기억에 없는 거리였다. 돌아올 때 호주머니에 무언가 들어 있: You arrived at a street you don't remember. When you returned, there was something in your pocket.
You woke up on the same platform at dawn, having reached nowhere.
The ticket was blown away by the wind and fell onto the tracks.
오랫동안 소식이 없던 사람에게서 편지가 왔다. 봉투는 얇고 주소는 지워져: You received a letter from someone you haven't heard from in a long time. The envelope is thin and the address is smudged.
The night passed as you wrote and erased. Your heart settled a little.
The day will come when you read it.
The Nest factory is looking for night staff. If you can fight off the sleep, the daily wage is doubled.
You held out until the dawn bell rang. Your stamina increased.
You dozed off and hit your hand against the machine.
The Office board is full of requests. The higher the difficulty, the larger the payment.
It was an easy job. I bought something useful with the pay.
I thought it would be easy, but I sprained my ankle.
I finished a tricky job. The people at the Office remember my name.
The job went wrong. The target moved first.

I couldn't hold my ground even once.

I held the front line. People from the other Office asked for my name.

I learned a lot by watching the person in front.
The Office is in a tough spot. I need to decide what to do with this month's share.
The senior patted my shoulder without a word. They repaired my gear first.
I bought something useful with the money I received.

직원들이 고개를 숙였다. 다음 날 아침, 당신 장비가 말끔히 손질되어 있: The staff bowed their heads. The next morning, my gear was neatly maintained.
I bought something useful for myself. I didn't bother looking at the staff's expressions.
정해진 시간보다 늦게까지 남으라는 지시가 내려왔다. 이유는 적혀 있지 않: An order was issued to stay later than the scheduled time. The reason was not stated.

I dozed off and got hurt. I had to write an incident report.

I went to the end and came back. I found something along with my report.

Nothing happened. That is the best kind of patrol.

I passed the practical test. I'm Grade 9, but I can take requests now.
I tripped during the practical test. The next exam is next year.
I need more preparation. I spent the time recovering.
A senior Fixer offers to write me an Association recommendation. I have to do the interview myself.
