등불 아래 회색 머리카락이 은빛으로 보인다. 목소리를 들으면 이유 없이: Under the lamp, their gray hair looks like silver. Hearing their voice makes my heart flutter for no reason. More so than when the terminal rings.
푸른 눈과 마주치면 지령이 떠오르지 않는다. 가족을 꾸리라는 지령으로 온: When I meet their blue eyes, the directive doesn't come to mind. I came here under a directive to start a family, but now, I just want to stay by this person's side.
회색 머리에 푸른 눈, 식탁 맞은편에서 웃는 얼굴이 익숙해졌다. 지령으로: Gray hair, blue eyes—the smiling face across the table has become familiar. It started with a directive, but this feeling is something that was never in any directive.
The chair is empty. The blue eyes and low voice are still vivid in my memory.
The face with blue eyes that looked at me for the last time remains at the door.
It was the day the Rabbit Team of Section 4 and the Raven Team were sharing the same corridor in the R Corp sector. At the end of the hall, a gas mask helmet with rabbit ears waved first. When they took off the helmet, white short hair and red eyes were revealed. The face, which looked about twenty-nine, smiled mischievously. "The rabbits are here to graze! Ravens don't eat grass, right?" The tone was rough and the eyes were combative, but they added "hop-hop" to the end of every sentence. When I asked for their name, they tapped their helmet instead of answering. I only found out after the job was done. They were the captain of the team that had handled the most people in that sector.
{n}이 까마귀팀 대기실 문을 발로 열었다. 보급창에서 가져온 당근 맛: {n} kicked open the door to the Raven Team's waiting room. They placed a box of carrot-flavored rations brought from the supply depot on the desk. "The rabbit didn't steal it. Hop-hop, I borrowed it." Their eyes were smiling, but their hand was on the hilt of their blade.
빌려 온 거면 돌려주라고 한다: Tell them to return it if they borrowed it
{n}이 신이 나서 상자를 뜯었다. 당근 맛이 나는 건지 아닌지 한참 떠: {n} excitedly tore open the box. They talked for a long time about whether it actually tasted like carrots or not. For the first time, the waiting room was noisy.
{n}은 혀를 차고 상자를 도로 안았다. 돌아서면서 \"까마귀는 재미없다: {n} clicked their tongue and hugged the box back to themselves. As they turned away, they said, "Ravens are boring," but the next day, the same box was there again.
붉은 안개 이야기: The story of the Red Mist
{n}이 방독면 헬멧을 만지작거리며 말을 꺼냈다. 어느 전설적인 해결사: {n} started talking while fiddling with their gas mask helmet. It was a story about a legendary Fixer. A person who disappears like the Red Mist and appears like the Red Mist. They said their wish was to fight like that person someday. Unlike usual, they didn't add "hop" to the end of their sentence.
흉내만 내면 죽는다고 말한다: Tell them they'll die if they just try to imitate them
{n}은 이야기가 끝나도 한참 헬멧을 내려다보았다. 그러고는 \"토끼는: {n} stared down at their helmet for a long time even after the story ended. Then they muttered, "Rabbits know when it's time to return to the grass." Their voice was low.
{n} opened their eyes wide and then laughed. Only after laughing loudly did they straighten their face. "So, teach me how not to die. You, Raven."
합동 작전이 끝났다. 구역은 난장판이었고 {n}의 팀은 이미 철수한 뒤였: The joint operation was over. The sector was in shambles, and {n}'s team had already withdrawn. Only {n} remained, sitting down with their helmet off. Their shoulders were heaving. It was impossible to tell if they were laughing or catching their breath.
{n}은 고개를 들지 않았다. 대신 어깨를 당신 쪽으로 기울여 한참 기댔: {n} did not look up. Instead, they leaned their shoulder against you for a long time. They said, "The rabbit is resting."
{n}이 숨이 넘어가게 웃었다. 흉내가 너무 못했다고 했다. 웃음이 멎은: {n} laughed until they were out of breath. They said the imitation was terrible. Even after the laughter stopped, their red eyes were looking at you for a long time.
{n}이 헬멧을 무릎에 올려놓고 마주 앉았다. 말끝에 깡총이 없다. 평소: {n} sat across from you with their helmet on their lap. There was no "hop" at the end of their sentence. The usual rough tone was gone, too. After a long while, they spoke. They thought rabbits couldn't live without a pack, but it seems two is enough.
토끼 귀가 달린 방독면 헬멧이 현관 옷걸이에 걸려 있다. 아침마다 \"깡: The gas mask helmet with rabbit ears hangs on the coat rack in the entryway. Every morning, the door opens with a "hop-hop." The rough tone is still there, but now, that tone is the warmest sound in the house.
{n}의 헬멧만 현관에 남았다. 토끼 귀 한쪽이 조금 접혀 있다. 집이: Only {n}'s helmet remained in the entryway. One of the rabbit ears is slightly folded. The house was quiet for a long time.
One day, {n} left, leaving only the words, "The rabbit is returning to the grass." A box of carrot-flavored rations was left in the entryway.
흰색 단발머리에 붉은 눈을 가졌다. 토끼 귀가 달린 방독면 헬멧을 옆구리: They have white short hair and red eyes. They carry a gas mask helmet with rabbit ears tucked under their arm and are very mischievous.
붉은 머리의 낯선 해결사: The strange Fixer with red hair
어느 사무소에도 속하지 않고 혼자 의뢰를 받아 온 지 오래다. 그날 의뢰: It has been a long time since they stopped belonging to any Office and started taking requests alone. In the alley where requests overlapped that day, there was no one to watch their back. But the person they encountered was also alone. They had tied their flaming red hair roughly, and their forearms were thicker than any other Fixer's. The badge of a Grade 2 Fixer flashed briefly inside their sleeve. They didn't offer their hand first, nor did they avoid eye contact until the end. They smelled the same. The smell of someone who has become strong while being alone. Only after the work was done did they say, "Next time, I'll go first," instead of their name.
먼저 가겠다던 사람: The person who said they would go first
{n}이 약속한 대로 먼저 현장에 도착해 있었다. 혼자 일하는 사람끼리는: {n} had arrived at the scene first, just as promised. People who work alone don't usually make promises. That's why they remained in my memory longer. Sitting on the finished job, cleaning their blade, they said bluntly that I was late.
빨리 온 쪽이 이상하다고 받아친다: Retort that it's strange for them to have arrived so early
{n}은 미간을 찌푸렸지만 칼 닦는 손이 느려졌다. 사과를 받아 본 적이: {n} furrowed their brow, but their hand cleaning the blade slowed down. It was a face that hadn't received many apologies.
{n} laughed for a long time. Only after laughing loudly did they look surprised at themselves.
{n}이 찾아온 밤에는 안개가 짙었다. 평소처럼 센 척하던 사람이 문 앞: The night {n} visited, the fog was thick. The person who usually acted tough stood lingering in front of the door for a long time. They were covering a cut on their shoulder with their sleeve.

흑수 선인의 두 번째 방문: The second visit of the Seonin of the Black Water
흑수 선인의 마지막 문: The last gate of the Seonin of the Black Water
도시의 낡은 약방 뒷방에서 단서를 따라가다, 홍원 밖에서 홍원의 냄새를: Following the clues to the back room of an old pharmacy in the City, I caught the scent of Hongwon outside of Hongwon. Someone who knows how to brew the Black Water Pill sits there. The family calls them a Seonin. If a candidate wishes to command more Black Water, they must obtain the bit held by the Seonin.
단서의 길이 다시 선인에게 닿았다. 선인은 지난번 일을 기억하지 못하는: The trail of clues led back to the Seonin. The Seonin wears a face that does not remember the last time. Bits tied to hemp cords jingle in their sleeves. The Black Water only listens to the one who holds the bit.
마지막 단서를 쫓다 선인의 거처 앞에 다시 섰다. 문 안에서 쇠 냄새와: Chasing the final clue, I stood before the Seonin's dwelling once more. The smell of iron and medicine wafts from within. The Seonin speaks with eyes closed. "The bit for the Head of the Family is not here. Only the Head of the Family holds those four. If it is what remains, I can give it to you."
예물을 올리고 재갈을 청한다: Offer a gift and request the bit
선인이 삼끈에서 재갈 하나를 풀어 건넸다. 흑수 한 사람이 어디선가 나타: The Seonin untied a bit from the hemp cord and handed it over. A member of the Black Water appeared from somewhere and stood silently by my side.
The Seonin shook their head. They say the bit is only released to those worthy of holding it.
I paid my respects at the threshold and turned away. The Seonin did not open their eyes.
홍원에 들어온 지 두 해째 되는 해다. 가주 후보의 자리를 두고 가문이: It has been two years since I entered Hongwon. The family is slowly taking sides over the position of the heir. The elders laugh heartily again today, but behind their laughter, it is not uncommon for a name to be erased. One can remain a candidate, or step down from the succession and become one of the twelve Black Water. The Black Water cannot do everything. They hold only one name and one blade.
가주 승계의 길을 계속 간다: Continue on the path of succession
후보로 남는다 · 지금까지의 홍원 루트: Remain a candidate · Hongwon route so far
후보의 자리를 지키기로 했다. 웃는 얼굴들 사이로 한 번 더 밥상 앞에: I decided to keep my position as a candidate. I sat at the table once more among the smiling faces.
승계를 내려놓았다. 가주가 {n}의 재갈을 건네자 이름 하나가 가문의 장: I stepped down from the succession. As the Head of the Family handed over the bit of {n}, a name was erased from the family ledger. Now, this blade holds only one name.
유물고의 울림: The Echo of the Relic Vault
Since that winter when the treasure vault was empty, the sword at my waist has hummed lowly every night. One day, the revolver cylinder inside the scabbard turned on its own. Deep within the family's relic vault, the same echo responds. They say the door will open once more.
울림이 이끄는 곳으로 간다: Go to where the echo leads
The door to the relic vault has opened again.
검을 눌러 소리를 죽인다: Press the sword to silence the sound
I pressed the scabbard to silence the sound. The echo does not return.
홍원의 서고는 가문 사람이 아니면 들어오지 못한다. 먼지 앉은 계보와 오: The archives of Hongwon are off-limits to anyone not of the family. Dusty genealogies and ancient martial arts manuals are shelved in separate sections. No one visits throughout the afternoon.
It became clear in my mind who was subordinate to whom.
The characters overlapped. I have to write it all over again.
A line of secret instruction settled on the tip of my blade.
I only flipped through the pages.
I used the book as a pillow and slept for a while. My body felt lighter.
Before the lanterns of the Red Pavilion go out, someone's breathing can already be heard in the training grounds. The family candidates do not call each other brothers, but they take up their blades at the same hour.
Our moves matched. I began to see the opponent's wrists.
I was struck on the wrist and retreated.
As my breath settled, my blade settled as well.
I took a step back. Nothing happened.
부엌 뒤편 하인들의 목소리가 낮아진다. 누가 독을 들였고, 누가 가주의: The voices of the servants behind the kitchen grow low. Who brought in the poison, who visited the Head of the Family's sickbed—the servants are the first to know the rumors of this house.
I obtained a few useful names.
They seemed to have noticed. I kept my mouth shut.
넉넉히 쥐여 주고 입을 연다: Tip them generously and make them talk
The money is gone, but I gained information.
못 들은 척 지나간다: Pass by pretending not to hear
I did not learn anything new.
가주의 병상 앞에 후보들이 한 사람씩 불려 간다. 마른 손이 이마를 짚고: The candidates are called one by one to the sickbed of the Head of the Family. A withered hand touches my forehead, calls my name, and sometimes calls out another.
I stayed by their side for a long time. The Head of the Family nodded silently.
가주의 말을 몰래 적어 둔다: Secretly write down the words of the Head of the Family
These were not words to be brushed off. What I wrote down might be useful later.
An attendant entered and folded the paper away.
가문의 제사가 다가온다. 제기를 닦고, 위패를 옮기고, 후보들은 서열대로: The family's ancestral rites are approaching. We polish the ritual vessels, move the spirit tablets, and the candidates line up in order of rank. Some stand in front, some stand behind.
제기를 정성껏 닦는다: Polish the ritual vessels with care
An elder looked back with a satisfied expression.
서열 다툼에 끼어든다: Intervene in the struggle for rank
The back of my blade was faster than my words. My place in line moved up one spot.
I was pushed to the very back of the line.
뒷줄에서 조용히 선다: Stand quietly in the back row
The rites ended without me being noticed.
붉은 누각의 지붕 위로 오르면 홍원 전체가 보인다. 아래서는 서열이, 위: Climbing onto the roof of the Red Pavilion, one can see all of Hongwon. Below, one sees only rank; above, only lanterns.
등불을 하나씩 센다: Count the lanterns one by one
As I counted, my mind settled.
지붕 위에서 칼을 휘두른다: Wield the blade on the roof
My footing did not falter on the roof tiles.
해마다 한 번, 가문의 곳간 장부를 후보들이 번갈아 맡는다. 숫자는 정직: Once every year, the candidates take turns managing the family's storehouse ledger. The numbers are honest, but the hands that write them are not.
I balanced them without a single error. I received a small fee for my trouble.
The numbers were off, so I had to balance them from the start.
어긋난 숫자를 눈여겨본다: Take note of the mismatched numbers
It is a sign that someone has been stealing. I wrote down the name.
장부를 넘겨주고 물러난다: Hand over the ledger and withdraw
I only got dust on my hands.
가문의 후보끼리 연습 대련이 잡혔다. 목검이라지만 방계의 눈이 있는 자리: A practice sparring session was scheduled between the family candidates. They are wooden swords, but with the eyes of the collateral family upon us, no one holds back.
I landed a hit first. The eyes of the onlookers changed.
I was forced to my knees. Shame remained.
I stood until the end. That alone was enough.
몸이 안 좋다며 빠진다: Excuse myself, claiming to be unwell
It was recorded as an absence.
흑수 숙소의 오후: An Afternoon in the Black Water Quarters
흑수의 숙소는 본채에서 먼 별채에 있다. 오후에는 호출이 없다. 벽에는: The Black Water quarters are in a detached building far from the main house. There are no calls in the afternoon. On the walls hang bits, medicine boxes, and old roll-call ledgers. No one knows who will be called out tomorrow.
It became clear in my mind who had stood by which candidate.
The ink had bled, and the characters were unreadable.
The metal felt familiar in my hand. The blade tip was also tidied up.
I leaned against the wall and slept for a while. My body felt lighter.
당신이 모시는 후보의 몸이 좋지 않다는 말이 돈다. 흑수가 후보의 방 문: Rumors circulate that the candidate you serve is in poor health. There is little time for a Kurokumo Clan member to knock on the candidate's door. The smell of medicine leaks through the door crack.
I kept the fire for a long time by their side. The candidate nodded without a word.
문밖에서 안부만 전한다: Convey well-wishes from outside the door
I bowed briefly and stepped back.
후보가 흘린 말을 적어 둔다: Write down the words the candidate let slip
후보를 모시는 흑수끼리 뜰에서 대련이 잡혔다. 후보의 체면이 걸린 자리라: A sparring match was set in the courtyard between Kurokumo Clan members serving the candidate. Since the candidate's reputation is at stake, no one holds back. Things like scales and fur glint beneath their sleeves.
This is not the first time. The City returns in the same shape once more.
It is a scene I have seen somewhere before. This time, I am less surprised than the first.
Same alley, same faces, different year. You only count the differences.
It is a recurring event. It is you who has changed.
It is a memory I recall. The choice from back then still lingers in my hands.
Even as time passes, this event arrives in the same order.
At this point, I cannot tell if the City is testing me or if I am simply memorizing it.
It is familiar. Familiarity is the sense that survives longest in the City.
W사 입사 서류에는 배치 희망란이 있다. 본사 담장 안에서 일하는 길과,: The W Corp application form has a section for placement preference. There is a path to work within the headquarters walls and a path to work aboard the Warp Train. Next to the train option, there is small text: Time does not pass during your shift.
지금까지의 날개 직원 길 · 직급은 사원부터: The path of a Wing employee so far · Ranks start from Staff
I was assigned a desk inside the walls. The train could only be heard as a sound passing in the distance.
1등급 직원부터 5등급 직원까지 · 직급마다 무기가 바뀐다 · 열차 안: From Grade 1 to Grade 5 staff · Weapons change by rank · Events inside the train do not age the year · Sanity is depleted
제복과 함께 절단 공구가 지급되었다. 출발 신호음은 열 번을 세기도 전에: A cutting tool was issued along with the uniform. The departure signal ended before I could even count to ten.
승객이 좌석에 앉는 순간 스캔이 끝난다. 광고판에는 \"단 10초\"라고: The scan finishes the moment the passenger sits in their seat. The advertisement board reads, "Only 10 seconds." The clock on the platform where you stand hasn't even made a full rotation, yet the train is already traveling far away.
The numbers were not wrong. The fact that they weren't wrong was what felt strange.
기록 하나가 한 줄 어긋나 있었다. 어긋난 이유를 묻는 것은 업무가 아니: One record was off by a line. Asking why it was off is not part of the job.
광고 문구만 읽고 넘긴다: Read the ad copy and move on
The text "10 seconds" always glows in the same spot.
열차가 멈추자 일반석 문이 열린다. 안에서 원형을 알아볼 수 없는 것이: As the train stops, the economy class doors open. Something whose original form is unrecognizable moves slowly from within. The work of the cleanup crew begins now.
손은 알아서 움직였다. 끝난 뒤에는 어느 것이 누구였는지 구분하지 못했다: My hands moved on their own. After it was over, I could not distinguish who was who.
동료에게 맡기고 분류만 돕는다: Leave it to a colleague and only assist with sorting
Fitting flesh back according to the number tags was unexpectedly quiet.
고깃덩어리를 좌석 위치에 맞춰 끼운 뒤 복구 팩이 돌기 시작한다. 승객들: After placing the chunks of meat back into their seat positions, the restoration pack begins to run. The passengers return to how they looked 10 seconds before boarding the train. No one retains memories of the time in between.
한 사람이 눈을 떴다. 그 사람은 당신에게 감사 인사를 했다. 감사 인사: One person opened their eyes. That person thanked me. Receiving thanks is the hardest part of this job.
돌아서서 다음 작업으로 간다: Turn around and head to the next task
Cheers were heard from behind me. Those cheers are the receipt for this train.
일등석 캡슐 안에서 승객이 평온하게 잠들어 있다. 이 사람은 수천 년을: A passenger sleeps peacefully inside the first-class capsule. This person will arrive without knowing of the thousands of years that passed. Your face is reflected in the capsule glass.
유리에 손을 얹는다: Place a hand on the glass
캡슐은 차갑고 조용했다. 수천 년을 모르는 얼굴이 어떤 것인지 오래 보았: The capsule was cold and silent. I watched for a long time what a face that knows nothing of thousands of years looks like.
The payment amount was written next to the passenger's name on the checklist. The number was larger than the name.
일반석에서 눈을 뜬 채 움직이는 승객이 있다. 정리 요원 한 사람을 오래: There is a passenger in economy class who is awake and moving. They stare at one cleanup crew member for a long time. Their lips move. No sound comes out.
도와주세요가 아니라, 몇 번째입니까였다. 몇 번째로 내리는 것인지, 몇: It wasn't "help me," but "which time is it?" I couldn't tell if they meant which time they were getting off or which time they were experiencing this.
The lip movements were not readable. It was better that they weren't.
복구가 끝나면 이 승객은 아무것도 기억하지 못한다. 그렇게 생각하기로 했: Once restoration is complete, this passenger will remember nothing. I decided to think that way.
검은 코트를 입은 사람이 장부를 들고 객실을 지난다. 승객이 열차에서 보: A person in a black coat walks through the cabin with a ledger. The time the passenger spent on the train is recorded as a number, and that number is transferred to T Corp. That number is the fuel for this train.
숫자는 천 단위를 한참 넘었다. 열차에서 보낸 시간이 아니라 팔린 시간이: The number was well into the thousands. It wasn't time spent on the train, but time sold.
못 본 척 작업을 이어 간다: Continue working, pretending not to see
Work is work. The paycheck comes in exactly as expected.
복구에 실패한 좌석: A seat that failed to restore
한 좌석만 비어 있다. 끼워 맞출 살점이 모자라거나, 처음부터 아무도 앉: One seat is empty. Either there wasn't enough flesh to fit, or no one was sitting there to begin with. The passenger's name is written in the ledger.
수색 기록에 남긴다: Leave it in the search records
I left a line in the records. I do not know if this line will ever reach anyone.
좌석을 비워 둔 채 문을 닫는다: Close the door with the seat left empty
The sound of the door closing was always the same. The fact that it was always the same was the worst part.
교대 시간, 같은 제복의 사람들이 말없이 앉아 밥을 먹는다. 아무도 오늘: During shift change, people in the same uniforms sit and eat in silence. No one talks about today's work. The person next to you places a side dish on your tray.
The food had no taste, but there was warmth from the person beside me.
The hallway was long and quiet. No sounds from outside the train could be heard.
열차 한 칸이 끝없이 이어지는 구간이다. 걸어도 걸어도 같은 좌석이 반복: A section where one train car continues endlessly. No matter how much you walk, the same seats repeat. The checklist tells you to go to the next car.
점검표대로 끝까지 걷는다: Walk to the end as per the checklist
한참 뒤 끝이 나왔다. 걸은 시간은 짧았는데, 발은 오래 걸은 것처럼 아: After a long while, the end appeared. The time spent walking was short, but my feet ached as if I had walked for a long time.
칸 사이에서 한참 서 있는다: Stand for a while between cars
같은 좌석이 같은 자리에서 당신을 지켜보았다. 아무 일도 일어나지 않았다: The same seats watched you from the same spots. I only recorded the fact that nothing happened.
교육 담당은 열차 모형 앞에서 설명을 시작한다. 출발 신호음은 열 번을: The instructor begins the explanation in front of a train model. The departure signal ends before you can count to ten, and work begins upon arrival. The model has door numbers for the passenger cars. One of those numbers is erased.
지워진 번호가 무엇인지 묻는다: Ask what the erased number is
교육 담당은 모형을 한 번 돌려 놓았다. 지워진 번호는 설명하지 않는 번: The instructor turned the model once. They said the erased number is one that is not explained.
The question remained in the records. Questions left in records last a long time.
교본의 순서만 외운다: Memorize only the order of the manual
My hands remembered the order. I never asked a question once.
도착한 칸에서 나온 것들에 번호표를 붙이는 일이 맡겨졌다. 번호표는 좌석: I was assigned to attach number tags to the things that came out of the arrived car. The number tags do not come out in seat order, and sometimes the same number appears twice.
같은 번호는 뒤에 나온 쪽에 새 표를 붙인다: Attach a new tag to the one that appeared later for the same number
No one pointed out the new number. It was just one extra tag.
책임자에게 중복을 보고한다: Report the duplication to the supervisor
The report was received, and by the next day, the same numbers had been consolidated into one.
복구 팩에 끼운 객실의 문이 반 뼘 어긋나 있다. 열차는 그대로 달리고,: The door of the cabin fitted into the restoration pack is misaligned by half a span. The train continues to run, and passengers go in and out through that door.
공구를 꺼내 문틀을 맞춘다: Take out the tools and align the door frame.
The door slid into place. No discrepancy in time was recorded in the work log.
The door frame shifted again. A long scratch appeared on the back of my hand.
점검반이 올 때까지 그대로 둔다: Leave it as is until the inspection team arrives.
The inspection team arrived two days later. Two days is not a long time on this train.
교대 명단에서 이름 하나가 줄로 지워져 있다. 어제까지 같은 칸을 맡던: One name on the shift roster is crossed out. It was someone who shared this carriage until yesterday. The reason column is blank.
사유는 끝내 알 수 없었다. 대신 지워진 이름의 자리가 곧 채워진다는 것: The reason remained unknown. All I learned was that the spot left by the erased name would soon be filled.
The name of the person who asked moved up one line on the roster.
그 사람의 몫까지 맡는다: Take on that person's share of the work.
My workload increased, and my performance rating rose accordingly.
본사 담장 안에서 감사관이 올라탔다. 열차 안에서 일하는 사람의 기록을: An auditor boarded from within the Headquarters perimeter. They said they were here to cross-reference the records of those working on the train. The sun had yet to set, but the auditor's sleeves were already soaked.
기록을 그대로 내민다: Submit the records as they are.
기록은 한 줄도 틀리지 않았다. 틀리지 않았다는 이유로 감사관은 오래 머: The records were flawless. Because they were flawless, the auditor stayed for a long time.
One line was found to be incorrect. It did not state who had made the error.
담당 구역을 비운 채 자리를 피한다: Leave the assigned area and step away.
The auditor disembarked after seeing only the empty space. The empty space remained as a single line in the report.
일반석 승객 하나의 주머니에서 접힌 종이가 나왔다. 열차에 오르기 전에: A folded piece of paper was found in the pocket of a coach-class passenger. It was a letter written before boarding the train. The recipient's address is written on it.
주소로 편지를 보낸다: Send the letter to the address.
편지는 열차 밖으로 나갔다. 답장은 오지 않았고, 와도 열차에는 닿지 않: The letter left the train. No reply came, and even if it did, it would never reach the train.
복구 팩 서류에 끼워 넘긴다: Slip it into the restoration pack documents.
The paper became a numbered tag among the documents.
정리 요원장의 호출: Call from the Chief Cleanup Agent
정리 요원장이 칸 끝에서 손짓을 한다. 당신이 오래 맡아 온 구역을 다른: The Chief Cleanup Agent beckons from the end of the carriage. They tell me to hand over the sector I have managed for so long to someone else. They do not give a reason.
구역을 넘기고 새 구역으로 간다: Hand over the sector and move to a new one.
The door to the new sector was old, and the passengers were quieter.
The Chief Agent was silent for a long time before saying that work ends regardless of reasons.
The demand was recorded. The record will not be erased this time either.
열차 끝 칸의 열쇠가 당신 손에 쥐여졌다. 이 칸에서 나온 것은 아직 한: The key to the last carriage of the train was placed in your hand. Nothing from this carriage has ever been put into a restoration pack. A steady rhythm can be heard from beyond the door.
박자는 열자마자 멈췄다. 안에는 손에 맞게 닳은 낫 한 자루와, 비어 있: The rhythm stopped the moment I opened the door. Inside, there was a scythe worn to fit a hand and an empty seat.
열쇠를 돌려주고 칸을 봉한다: Return the key and seal the carriage.
The seal closed on its own. Since that day, the rhythm has been heard in other carriages.
승강장의 시계는 여전히 한 바퀴도 돌지 않았다. 그런데 당신의 손등에는: The clock on the platform has not moved a single tick. Yet, there are wrinkles on the back of your hand that were not there a year ago. The train runs without waiting for you.
손등의 주름을 세어 본다: Count the wrinkles on the back of your hand.
주름의 수는 근무한 해와 어긋났다. 어긋난 만큼이 열차가 가져간 시간이다: The number of wrinkles does not match the years worked. The difference is the time the train has taken away.
거울이 없는 칸으로 간다: Go to a carriage without mirrors.
The carriage without mirrors was quiet. Even in a quiet place, the wrinkles do not disappear.
새로 들어온 직원이 같은 칸에서 일하게 되었다. 당신이 처음 이 열차에: A new staff member has started working in the same carriage. They have the same look you had the year you first boarded this train. The junior asks quietly: how long can one do this job?
할 수 있을 때까지라고 답한다: Answer that you can do it as long as you are able.
The junior nodded and gripped their tools. Neither of us knew if that was the right answer.
내릴 수 있다면 내리라고 말한다: Tell them to get off if they can.
The junior did not answer. They worked in that carriage the next day as well.
도착 직후의 객실은 조각으로 가득하다. 정리 요원은 조각 하나하나의 유전: The cabin immediately after arrival is full of fragments. The cleanup agent reads the genes of each fragment to find their original seats. Two fragments with overlapping seat numbers appeared.
한 줄이 어긋나 있었다. 고쳐 놓자 두 조각은 서로 다른 좌석으로 돌아갔: One line was misaligned. Once corrected, the two fragments returned to different seats.
The cross-reference never matched. The mismatched fragments were attached to the nearest seat.
앞 번호부터 순서대로 끼운다: Insert them in order starting from the front number.
순서대로 끼운 좌석은 모두 채워졌다. 어느 쪽이 누구였는지는 묻지 않았다: The seats inserted in order were all filled. No one asked who was who.
복구된 승객들이 줄지어 소거실로 들어간다. 열차에 오른 직후까지의 기억만: Restored passengers line up to enter the erasure room. Only memories up to the moment they boarded the train remain; the rest are wiped. The erasure officer leaves the staff door open. They say the same service is provided to staff.
최근 몇 해의 기억을 지워 달라고 한다: Ask to have the memories of the last few years erased.
정신력이 크게 회복된다 · 승급 포인트를 잃는다: Sanity is greatly restored · Lose Promotion Points
My memories felt lighter. In exchange, where and what I had learned also became blurred.
기계는 승객 하나의 기억을 지우며 낮은 소리를 냈다. 당신은 지워지지 않: The machine made a low sound as it erased a passenger's memory. You were not erased.
작업 중 복구 팩의 모서리에 깊게 베였다. 상처는 깊은데 의식은 또렷하다: I was deeply cut by the edge of a restoration pack while working. The wound is deep, but my consciousness is clear. No injury can lead to death inside the train. Only the pain remains intact.
상처를 그대로 두고 작업을 마친다: Leave the wound as is and finish the work.
The work finished on time. The wound will not heal until I get off the train.
응급 지혈 후 후배에게 맡긴다: Apply emergency hemostasis and leave it to the junior.
The junior took over the work, and I caught my breath in the crew cabin.
일등석 동면 캡슐 아래쪽 점검구를 열었다. 배관 하나가 열차 벽을 뚫고: I opened the inspection hatch under the first-class hibernation capsule. A pipe pierces the train wall and leads outside. A single letter is engraved on the end of the pipe: T.
진실에 한 걸음 다가선다: One step closer to the truth.
배관은 열차 밖의 어떤 장치와 닿아 있었다. 그 장치는 이 열차가 보낸: The pipe was connected to a device outside the train. That device was feeding on the time this train had spent.
The inspection hatch closed. The sound of it closing was not made by me.
점검구를 닫고 보고서에 적지 않는다: Close the inspection hatch and do not write it in the report.
보고서에는 이상 없음이라고 적었다. 이상 없음은 이 열차에서 가장 흔한: I wrote "No issues" in the report. "No issues" is the most common sentence on this train.
일반석 한 칸의 승객들이 이상하게 조용하다. 몇 사람의 손이 같은 박자로: The passengers in one coach-class carriage are strangely quiet. Several people's hands move in the same rhythm. Someone has boarded coach class hiding their identity, and it looks like they have been taught by that person for a long time.
문 밖에서 승객들의 움직임을 기록한다: Record the passengers' movements from outside the door.
The record was accurate. It was so accurate that the higher-ups were silent for a while after reading it.
A gaze from the crack in the door turned toward me. The back of my hand hurt first.
보고만 올리고 칸을 봉쇄한다: Submit only the report and seal the carriage.
The sealed carriage became even quieter. The silence will not last long.
점심 도시락 아래에 접힌 쪽지가 있다. 웨이페어러 컴퍼니라는 이름과 연락: There is a folded note under my lunchbox. It contains the name Wayfarer Company and contact information. It is a startup dealing with spatial opening technology. Rumors say that if the train keeps shaking, they could threaten the position of W Corp's Wing.
쪽지를 보고도 모른 척한다: Pretend not to see the note.
The note was cleared away with the lunch trash. No one asked.
쪽지를 보고서에 넘긴다: Submit the note in the report.
보고서에 올라간 쪽지는 인사팀에서 한참 머물렀다. 윗선의 인사는 부드러워: The note submitted in the report stayed with the HR team for a long time. The higher-ups' greetings became softer.
일등석 한 칸이 통째로 비었다는 소문이 정리 요원들 사이에 돈다. 캡슐은: Rumors circulate among the cleanup agents that a first-class carriage is entirely empty. The capsule is open, and only broken doll parts remain inside instead of a passenger. There is no numbered tag to indicate where the parts came from.
부품 하나를 가져와 감식에 올린다: Take one of the parts and submit it for identification.
감식 결과는 일등석 승객의 뼈와 일치했다. 일치한 것이 이 일의 시작이었: The identification results matched the bones of a first-class passenger. The match was the beginning of this matter.
The part slowly turned to ash on the identification table. Turning to ash is not in the regulations either.
빈 캡슐을 닫고 번호를 지운다: Close the empty capsule and erase the number.
The capsule with the erased number seemed as if it had never existed.
일반석 객차 하나의 불이 꺼졌다. 시간이 뭉친 자리에 살덩이가 불어 있다: The lights in one coach-class carriage went out. Flesh has grown in the place where time has clumped together. One cleanup agent is missing, and my name is written in the ledger.

I put on my gloves and opened the carriage door. Something stirred beneath the seat.

Another staff member went in with the equipment. The door closed, and it only grew quiet after a long while. It is not my job today.
일등석의 조명이 한 칸씩 꺼진다. 개조된 승객들이 제자리를 벗어났다. 점: The lights in First Class flicker out one by one. The modified passengers have left their seats. The checklist says not to touch them, but someone has to perform the inspection.

점검표를 접어 넣고 일등석 문을 열었다. 가장 앞의 승객이 고개를 돌린다: I folded the checklist and opened the First Class door. The passenger at the very front turned their head.
일반석 맨 끝 칸에서 수련자들이 열차의 시간을 먹으며 몸을 만든다. 서로: In the last carriage of General Class, the practitioners feed on the train's time to hone their bodies. It is the sound of them cutting each other. Breaking up their fights is part of the cleanup job.
수련자 연전 · 열차 안이라 해가 넘어가지 않는다 · 끝나면 정리 수복: Practitioner consecutive battles · The sun never sets inside the train · Clean up and repair when finished
The sound stopped the moment I opened the training ground door. The practitioners all looked my way at once.
수련자들의 연무장 안쪽 벽에 마른 핏자국이 길게 이어져 있다. 쓰러진 수: Long, dried bloodstains run along the inner wall of the practitioners' training ground. Two small bite marks are imprinted on the necks of the fallen practitioners. Rumor has it that a Grade 5 Fixer who has been swinging a blade for hundreds of years stands in the center of the training ground.

장갑을 고쳐 쥐고 핏자국을 따라갔다. 연무장 안쪽에서 무언가 부풀어 오르: I tightened my grip on my gloves and followed the bloodstains. A sound of something swelling comes from deep within the training ground.
핏자국에서 눈을 돌렸다. 오늘은 내 일이 아니다. 하지만 그 일은 어딘가: I turned my eyes away from the bloodstains. It is not my job today. But that work will begin again somewhere else.
{n}의 흑수는 가문의 구역을 돈다. 낮은 마루의 먼지에 발자국이 겹쳐: {n}'s Black Water patrols the family's district. Footprints overlap in the dust of the low porch. Someone entered through a different path last night.
발자국은 곳간 뒤에서 끊겼다. 숨어 있던 방계의 심부름꾼을 잡아 가주 앞: The footprints ended behind the storehouse. I caught the branch family's errand boy who was hiding and brought him before the Head of the Family.
The footprints vanished in front of the pond. I sprained my ankle on the way back.
Nothing happened today. A report stating that nothing happened is still a report.
후보 하나가 밀서를 건넨다. 가문의 눈을 피해 다른 후보에게 전하라는 것: A candidate hands me a secret letter. They want me to deliver it to another candidate, avoiding the family's eyes. The seal on the letter is loose. Whatever the task, the work of the Black Water is to deliver without a word.
The letter was delivered without anyone knowing. The candidate who received it threw it into the fire without even reading it. The Black Water turned away, watching only the light of the flames.
I ran into a branch family assassin on the way. I protected the letter, but my sleeve was slashed.
안에는 아무것도 적혀 있지 않았다. 아무것도 적히지 않은 밀서를 후보들은: There was nothing written inside. The candidates keep sending each other empty secret letters.
가주 후보의 잔에 술이 따라진다. 흑수는 잔 곁에 서 있다. 술에서 약: Wine is poured into the candidate's glass. The Black Water stands by the glass. The wine smells of medicine. The candidate does not know yet.
먼저 입을 대 보았다. 독은 약했고, 몸은 견뎠다. 후보는 한참 흑수를: I took a sip first. The poison was weak, and my body endured it. The candidate stared at the Black Water for a long time.
The poison was stronger than expected. I was ill for a few days, but the candidate's glass was emptied.
The candidate set the glass down. The Black Water's hint is the cheapest favor in the family.
열두 흑수 중 한 자리를 먼저 쥐었던 사람이 칼 쥐는 법을 묻는다. 말은: The one who first held a seat among the twelve Black Water asks how to hold a blade. Words are few, and hands are fast. Teaching between Black Water is not in the family's code.
선배는 한 번만 보여 주었다. 한 번이면 충분하다는 얼굴이었다. 칼끝이: The senior showed me only once. Their expression said once was enough. The tip of my blade felt a fraction lighter.
몇 합 만에 칼을 떨어뜨렸다. 선배는 아무 말 없이 칼을 주워 건네주었다: I dropped my blade after a few exchanges. The senior picked it up and handed it back without a word.
A blade mastered alone is slow, but it lasts a long time.
곳간 열쇠를 지키는 밤이다. 문밖에서 발소리가 겹친다. 후보들의 흑수들이: It is the night to guard the storehouse key. Footsteps overlap outside the door. The Black Water of the candidates knock on the same door on the same night.
문은 한 번도 열리지 않았다. 새벽에 보니 문 앞에는 칼이 세 자루 놓여: The door never opened. At dawn, I saw three blades left in front of the door. The people who were supposed to retrieve them never came.
The door opened. I protected the storehouse, but I could not protect myself.
As the door opened, the footsteps fell silent. The open door does not belong to either side.
후보의 일로 홍원을 잠시 나선다. 바깥 골목은 낯선 냄새가 난다. 흑수의: I leave the Hongwon briefly for the candidate's business. The outside alleys smell unfamiliar. The face of the Black Water is unknown outside.
바깥에서의 일은 의외로 간단했다. 돌아오는 길에 흑수 하나가 지나가다 고: The work outside was unexpectedly simple. On the way back, a Black Water passed by and bowed their head.
The outside was not the Hongwon. I finished the job, but the way back was long.
The outside goes on as the outside. The Hongwon goes on as the Hongwon.
흑수의 이름: The name of the Black Water
{n}의 흑수로 활동한 지 몇 해가 지났다. 가문의 어른이 장부를 펼친다: Several years have passed since I began serving as {n}'s Black Water. An elder of the family opens the ledger. A line is added under my name. Now, you are called {n}'s Black Water.
장부의 한 줄을 받는다: Receive a line in the ledger
장부에 이름이 올랐다. 열두 흑수 중 한 자리가 이제 공식으로 이 칼의: My name is on the ledger. One of the twelve Black Water seats is now officially this blade's.
흑수의 필두: The Head of the Black Water
열두 흑수가 한 방에 모인다. 서열을 가리는 자리다. 당신 앞에 {n}의: The twelve Black Water gather in one room. It is the place where the hierarchy is decided. The seat indicating the head of {n} is empty before you. For the first time, the family calls the Black Water by name.
필두의 자리에 앉는다: Take the seat of the head
{n}의 필두가 되었다. 다른 흑수들이 고개를 숙였다. 이제 후보 하나를: I became the head of {n}. The other Black Water bowed their heads. Now, the power to make a candidate the Head of the Family is in my hands.

Yet this candidate called the head's name and held out a hand that had not yet been given a Black Water. The candidate has no bridle to use, and you have no one who has called your name.
허리춤의 재갈을 풀어 건넸다. 흑수에게 재갈은 목줄이자 이름표다. {c}: I untied the bridle from my waist and handed it over. To a Black Water, a bridle is both a leash and a name tag. {c} received it with both hands. Now, this blade is used only for this one person. It was the first day laughter ceased among the family elders.

도시의 바깥은 아니다. 외곽이라고 부르기에도 어긋난 곳이다. 여기는 도시: It is not outside the City. It is a place too misaligned even to be called the Outskirts. This is a spot the City failed to align. There are no lit windows, no people walking, yet the road stretches on endlessly. Even as years pass, you do not age, and the same face returns, a little more hardened. You need a place to lay your body down.
외곽에 집을 짓는다: Build a house in the Outskirts
도시의 바깥에서 가장 가까운 빈터에 작은 집을 올렸다. 못이 들어가는 소: I built a small house on the vacant lot closest to the outside of the City. The sound of the nails entering returned half a beat late, and the finished house looked slightly misaligned from every angle. Still, the door opened. Now, this house is the place you return to. Nothing in this place is aligned, but you decided to live with that misalignment.
백 해가 지났다. 외곽의 바람은 처음 불던 모양 그대로다. 모든 것이 제: A hundred years have passed. The wind of the Outskirts has the same shape as when it first blew. Everything is in its place, but you seem to arrive a beat late. I stopped counting the years, but my body has hardened as if it had counted them.
몸이 한 겹 더 두꺼워졌다. 칼끝이 닿는 자리가 이전보다 깊어졌다. 어색: My body has grown another layer thicker. The spot where the blade tip touches is deeper than before. It is not this place that is awkward, but you.
같은 얼굴의 불순물이 한 걸음 가까이 와 있다. 이 자리의 것들은 모두: An impurity with the same face is one step closer. Everything in this place recognizes each other, but only you do not fit in. That which does not fit endures for a long time. So, you too become one step more hardened.
My breath has deepened. The rhythm of this place and your rhythm walk side by side, misaligned.
외곽의 가장자리가 어디인지 이제 아무도 기억하지 못한다. 길이 당신을 따: No one remembers where the edge of the Outskirts is anymore. The road seems to stretch following you. Strength accumulates in the place where you have stood for a long time. It is strange that this place does not push you away.
발밑에서 올라오는 것이 있다. 밀어내지도, 받아들이지도 않는 자리가 당신: Something is rising from beneath your feet. The place neither pushes you away nor accepts you; it simply lets you stand.
불순물은 이제 당신의 걸음 모양까지 닮았다. 같은 칼, 같은 호흡. 그런: The impurity now even resembles the shape of your stride. Same sword, same breath. Yet, you are the only one here who does not resemble this place. There is no one to call your name, but the name is still within you.
A name has gained weight within you. The sword has become that much heavier.
해는 매번 같은 곳에서 지고 당신은 매번 조금 더 오래 남는다. 얼마나: The sun sets in the same place every time, and you remain a little longer each time. How much time has passed, how much is left—I can no longer tell. In a place where time is misaligned, to endure for a long time is to be strong. To endure for a long time is also to be strange.
My body has almost aligned with the rhythm of this place. I learned how to fit while not fitting in. One swing now surpasses two from before.
불순물의 그림자가 당신보다 먼저 도착한다. 두려움은 없다. 이 자리에서: The impurity’s shadow arrives before you. There is no fear. In this place, fear is shorter than a single breath. Only your shadow has yet to follow.
The shadow finally reached my feet. My body grew lighter, and my blade grew heavier.
도시의 소리가 아주 먼 곳에서 들린다. 당신이 돌아갈 곳이 있었다는 사실: The sounds of the City reach me from very far away. The fact that you once had a place to return to is now faint. Still, simply by enduring, this place tilts toward you.
The distant sound became a beat and seeped into my body. My body grew solid once more.
불순물의 눈이 당신을 정확히 바라본다. 같은 얼굴이 이쪽의 호흡을 따라: The eyes of the Impurity look directly at you. The same face breathes in time with my Poise. We both know that everything in this place reflects you, and that the one doing the reflecting is the one who feels awkward.
As the end comes into view, my body has grown lighter. What I have endured for so long finally becomes a blade.
끝이 다가온다. 이 자리가 당신을 담기에는 모자란다. 넘치기 전에 한 번: The end approaches. This place is too small to contain you. You only need to endure one more time before it overflows. What was awkward from the start was not the size of this place, but your own size.
몸의 마지막 한 겹이 풀렸다. 이제 남은 것은 끝에 닿기 전까지 버티는: The last layer of my body has unraveled. Now, all that remains is to endure until I reach the end.
The sound of footsteps returns half a beat late.
The shadow is offset from the path by a span.
The face reflected in the window closes its eyes before you do.
It feels as if the wind blows only to avoid you.
Everything on the roadside is in its place, but you alone do not fit somewhere.
The sound of breathing does not sound like your own.
The door of the house opens half a beat late every day.
The nail driven into the wall seems to be in a different spot than yesterday.
The memory of counting the years is blurry. The names I know are growing shorter.
No one is looking at you, yet everything seems to be waiting for you.
Only your footprints do not fade.
Time flows, but you seem to remain in the same place.
I tried to call someone, but I cannot recall the name to call.
The face in the mirror takes a little too long to recognize you.
Only the clock in the house is accurate. It is so accurate that it is strange.
The path outside the window is a span further than yesterday.
The rules of this place do not fit anyone but you.
The path you walk stretches along with you.
When you breathe, this place breathes a beat late.
모든 것이 제자리인데 당신만 어색하다. 어색한 쪽이 당신이라는 걸 이제는: Everything is in its place, but you alone are awkward. I know now that you are the awkward one.
The lights of the City are moving away. No, you are moving away.
The fingers that counted the years no longer fold.
It is a familiar house, but every time I cross the threshold, it feels like the first time.
The house is becoming accustomed to this place before you are.
The number one thousand is loosening before my eyes.
Your name is trying to disappear before you do.
This place is now too small to contain you.
The numbers are about to overflow. There is not enough space.
The floor you are standing on has become one layer thinner.
It will overflow soon. This place, and you as well.
The house door seems a bit lower than your height. No, perhaps you have grown.
This house will also overflow soon. The threshold, the roof, and the name.
집으로 찾아온 괴수: The monster that visited the house.
외곽의 작은 집 앞마당이 어긋난다. 문턱 너머로 도시가 걸러 내지 못한: The front yard of the small house in the Outskirts is misaligned. Beyond the threshold stands something the City could not filter out. When I try to name it, my thoughts slip away. It has come to this house once again.
집의 창에 불이 켜져 있는데 그림자는 한 걸음 늦게 따라온다. 도시가 걸: The lights are on in the house's window, but the shadow follows a step behind. What the City could not filter out stands before the fence and looks this way. We both know that this house alone has not misaligned in this place.
문을 두드리는 소리가 없다. 대신 마당의 풀이 한 방향으로 눕는다. 이름: There is no sound of knocking on the door. Instead, the grass in the yard lies down in one direction. An unnamed Impurity stands before the door of this house. It is a place you have guarded for a long time, and a place the other side has visited for a long time.
곁에는 {n}이(가) 있다. 이 어긋난 자리에서 어긋나지 않은 것은 그: Beside you is {n}. In this misaligned place, the only thing that is not misaligned is that person's voice.
사령관의 자리를 지킨 채 도시 밖의 임무에 나섰다. 불순물의 흔적을 따라: I set out on a mission outside the City while keeping my position as commander. The path misaligned in the place where I followed the traces of the Impurity. I retraced my steps many times, but the place I arrived at was not the City. The dimensions of the Outskirts had twisted the direction, and the City was no longer a place I could return to.
도시의 굴뚝에서 뿜어져 나오던 검은 연기가 옅어졌다. 창문의 빛이 밤을: The black smoke that used to pour from the City's chimneys has thinned. The landscape where the window light pushed back the night is growing dark little by little.
외곽의 흙바닥 위로 익숙한 문자가 적힌 간판이 나뒹군다. 바람에 깎인 글: A sign with familiar letters lies scattered on the dirt floor of the Outskirts. The characters, worn away by the wind, no longer convey any meaning.
길의 경계가 무너져 평평한 들판이 접힌다. 발자국은 뒤를 돌아볼 때마다: The boundaries of the path collapse, and the flat fields fold. Every time I look back, my footprints twist and continue in random directions.
도시의 높다란 성벽이 허물어지고 그 자리에 녹슨 철골이 솟았다. 당신은: The City's towering walls have crumbled, and rusted steel frames have risen in their place. You have given up on gauging their height.
멀리서 들려오던 기계의 톱니 소리가 잦아든다. 대신 낮게 깔린 모래바람이: The sound of the machine's gears, which used to be heard from afar, has faded. In its place, a low-lying sandstorm gnaws at the ground and screams without rest.
마주쳤던 이들의 온기가 묻어있던 돌덩이가 가루가 되었다. 기억에 남은 얼: The rocks that held the warmth of those I encountered have turned to dust. The faces left in my memory are now formless, achromatic stains.
지평선 너머로 거대한 톱니바퀴가 굴러가는 환영이 보인다. 도시의 흔적은: Beyond the horizon, I see a phantom of giant gears rolling. The traces of the City now flicker like heat haze and vanish.
당신의 그림자가 뒤로 길게 늘어지다 스스로 끊어졌다. 시간은 둥글게 말려: Your shadow stretched long behind you and then severed itself. Time began to curl into a circle, biting its own tail.
낡은 철문이 모래 속에 반쯤 잠겨 입을 벌리고 있다. 그 속에서 흘러나오: An old iron door is half-buried in the sand, its mouth agape. The noise of the City that once flowed from within it stopped long ago.
바닥에 고인 웅덩이가 하늘의 빛을 반사하지 않는다. 이곳의 시간은 액체처: The puddle pooled on the ground does not reflect the light of the sky. Time here clings like a sticky liquid and does not flow.
길이 끝나는 지점을 찾으려 했으나 다시 시작점과 맞닿아 있다. 도시는 이: I tried to find the end of the path, but it meets the starting point again. The City now rotates silently beneath your feet.
한때 견고했던 건물들의 잔해가 둥글게 마모되었다. 이곳에는 날카로운 모서: The remains of once-sturdy buildings have worn down into rounded shapes. There are no sharp edges or set directions here.
해를 세는 손가락이 무뎌져 셈을 잊었다. 붉은 태양이 뜨고 지는 간격이: The fingers that count the years have grown dull, and I have forgotten the count. The interval between the rising and setting of the red sun has grown shorter, leaving only dazzling afterimages.
바람은 이제 소리를 내지 않고 피부를 스친다. 외곽의 가장자리는 당신의: The wind now brushes against my skin without making a sound. The edges of the Outskirts expand and contract in time with your breathing.
하늘의 색이 매순간 뒤바뀌며 기묘한 무늬를 그린다. 도시는 기억 속의 연: The color of the sky changes every moment, drawing strange patterns. The City has scattered like smoke in memory and now has no form.
당신이 밟고 서 있는 대지가 투명하게 비치기 시작했다. 아래로 비치는 것: The ground you are standing on has begun to shine transparently. What is reflected below is an endless void or a cold abyss.
시간의 감각이 닳아 없어진 자리에 정적만이 고였다. 당신은 멈춰 있는 것: Silence has pooled where the sense of time has worn away. You cannot tell if you are standing still or running very fast.
먼 곳의 불빛이 찰나의 점처럼 흩뿌려진다. 그 모든 빛은 당신의 기억보다: Distant lights are scattered like fleeting dots. All that light is the debris of stars that vanished even before your memories.
도시의 끝자락에서 받은 첫 의뢰가 낡은 칼날을 닳게 했다. 외곽의 거친: The first request I received at the edge of the City wore down my old blade. Seasons have changed many times before the footprints I made while braving the harsh winds of the Outskirts could even fade.
도시 안쪽의 소음이 희미해질 때까지 칼을 벼렸다. 수백 번의 의뢰를 수행: I sharpened my blade until the noise inside the City grew faint. During the hundreds of requests I carried out, my footprints became deeply embedded in the land of the Outskirts like calluses and would not come off.
도시의 기억은 풍화되었으나 외곽의 칼은 여전히 주인을 기다린다. 이제는: The memories of the City have weathered, but the blade of the Outskirts still waits for its master. Now, in the silence where no requests remain, only your footprints take the place of the path.
조직의 서열을 익히며 검은 장갑에 묻은 얼룩을 닦았다. 대부의 명령 한마: I learned the hierarchy of the organization and wiped the stains from my black gloves. In the days when everything was decided by a single word from the Godfather, you were merely a blind shadow.
조직의 위계가 뒤바뀌는 동안 검은 장갑은 닳고 헤어졌다. 대부의 명령은: While the hierarchy of the organization shifted, the black gloves wore thin and frayed. The Godfather's orders scatter like echoes, but the body's instinct to maintain rank remains sharp.
모든 조직의 이름이 잊힌 자리에도 검은 장갑의 흔적은 남는다. 서열 없는: Even in a place where the names of all organizations are forgotten, the traces of the black gloves remain. I try to recite the Godfather's orders into the rankless void, but only silence returns.
사원증을 목에 걸고 날개의 그늘 아래에서 처음으로 부서를 배정받았다. 본: I hung my employee ID around my neck and was assigned a department for the first time under the shadow of a Wing. Light poured behind your back as you followed the headquarters' guidelines and dreamed of promotion.
부서의 문턱이 닳도록 오가며 사원증의 번호를 수없이 바꾸었다. 승진이 거: I went back and forth until the threshold of the department wore down, changing the number on my employee ID countless times. As promotions continued, the Wing grew heavier, and the giant gears of the headquarters ground you down.
날개는 꺾이고 사원증은 부식되어 흔적도 없다. 본사의 문은 굳게 닫혔으나: The Wing is broken and the employee ID has corroded without a trace. The doors of the headquarters are firmly shut, but you still guard the empty space of the vanished department, waiting for a promotion.
협회에 첫 발을 들이고 배지를 가슴에 달았다. 등급을 올리기 위한 의뢰서: I took my first step into the Association and pinned the badge to my chest. Requests to raise my grade poured in, and I had to prove myself every time during the evaluation process.
배지의 색이 바랠 만큼 수많은 의뢰서를 처리했다. 심사를 통과할 때마다: I processed so many requests that the color of the badge faded. Every time I passed an evaluation, my grade rose, but the scenery of the Association showed no signs of changing.
이제 협회는 사라지고 녹슨 배지만이 외곽에 굴러다닌다. 등급을 나눌 의뢰: Now the Association is gone, and only rusted badges roll around in the Outskirts. There are no requests to divide grades and no evaluators, but you still struggle to remember your final request.
작은 간판을 내걸고 첫 직원을 맞이했다. 등급 높은 의뢰를 따내기 위해: I hung up a small sign and welcomed my first staff member. The clamor of the days when I organized ledgers and shared profits to land high-grade requests is vivid in my ears.
사무소의 간판은 빛이 바래고 직원은 세월을 따라 떠나갔다. 등급은 올랐으: The Office sign has faded, and the staff have left with the passage of time. My grade rose, but the profits written in the ledger were far from enough to fill your loneliness.
간판이 떨어져 나간 자리에는 먼지만 쌓여 있다. 직원은 없지만 습관처럼: Dust has piled up where the sign once hung. There are no staff, but as you calculate profits in the ledger out of habit, fleeting time flows through your fingertips.
작업대 위에서 첫 번째 의수를 설계하며 불을 지폈다. 재료가 녹아내리는: I lit a fire while designing my first prosthetic limb on the workbench. In the intense heat where materials melted, you realized the value of forging something.
수많은 의수를 설계하고 납품하는 동안 작업대의 불은 꺼질 줄 몰랐다. 재: The fire on the workbench never went out while I designed and delivered countless prosthetic limbs. As materials piled up and scattered repeatedly, your hands became harder than machines.
작업대는 부서졌고 납품할 곳조차 사라진 불길 속에서 당신은 홀로 서 있다: The workbench is broken, and you stand alone in the flames where even the places to deliver have vanished. The blueprints that no one looks for anymore crumble faintly beyond memory.
병기로 시술받고 군체의 일부가 되어 처음 눈을 떴다. 부품의 유기적인 연: I was operated on as a weapon and opened my eyes for the first time as part of a swarm. The organic connection of the parts dominated my body, and the instinct for consumption slowly encroached upon your thoughts.
군체의 일원으로 살아가며 몸을 구성하는 부품을 끊임없이 교체했다. 시술의: Living as a member of the swarm, I constantly replaced the parts that made up my body. The traces of the surgery gradually faded, and only the memory of consumption fills the inside of the old weapon.
몸은 녹슬고 병기의 기능은 한계에 다다랐다. 군체는 해체되었으나 부품 속: My body is rusted, and the weapon's functions have reached their limit. The swarm has disbanded, but the memory of consumption engraved within the parts makes you walk without stopping.
배양조의 닫힌 문이 열리고 번호가 부여된 첫 새벽을 맞이했다. 팀의 일원: The closed door of the culture tank opened, and I welcomed my first dawn with an assigned number. Becoming a member of a team, you tried to find your own senses among the identical clones.
새벽의 빛이 바뀌는 동안 배양조를 거쳐 온 번호들은 모두 흩어졌다. 팀을: While the light of dawn changed, the numbers that passed through the culture tanks all scattered. The footprints of the clones that moved as a team no longer remain anywhere.
번호조차 퇴색된 몸으로 당신은 홀로 새벽을 맞이한다. 배양조의 기억은 가: With a body where even the number has faded, you welcome the dawn alone. The memories of the culture tank are dim, but only the silence engraved as a clone sustains your time.
단말기가 울리고 지령에 따라 정해진 장소로 향했다. 카두세우스의 문장이: The terminal rang, and I headed to the designated place according to the instructions. Every time I gripped the handle engraved with the emblem of Caduceus, you accepted the weight of the mission with your whole body.
지령은 끊임없이 이어졌고 당신은 그저 단말기에 의존해 장소를 옮겼다. 카: The instructions continued endlessly, and you simply relied on the terminal to move to different locations. Every time your hand holding the Caduceus trembled, the meaning of the mission grew blurred.
지령을 내리던 단말기는 침묵하고 당신은 마지막 장소에 멈췄다. 더 이상: The terminal that gave the instructions is silent, and you have stopped at the final location. There are no more instructions to carry out, but only the shape of the Caduceus holds onto your time.
서가의 먼지를 털며 문을 열고 첫 손님을 맞이했다. 책을 펼쳐 내밀 때마: I dusted the bookshelves, opened the door, and welcomed my first guest. Every time I opened a book and handed it over, you became someone's story and obtained their key.
수천 명의 손님이 거쳐 간 서가에는 셀 수 없이 많은 책이 쌓였다. 문: Countless books piled up on the shelves where thousands of guests had passed through. Recording the truth inside the door, you forgot yourself and focused on polishing the keys.
서가는 텅 비고 문은 닫혔으나 당신은 여전히 그 자리에 머문다. 이제 아: The shelves are empty and the door is closed, but you still remain in that place. In a room that no guests visit anymore, you remember the last sentence of the last book.
머리의 명을 받고 선 밖으로 기척을 숨기며 다가갔다. 그들의 문을 닫는: Following the Head's orders, you approached from outside the line, concealing your presence. The moment you closed their door, you raised your Claws and perfectly upheld the order of the City.
머리가 내린 선을 지키기 위해 수없이 문을 닫았다. 기척을 죽이고 발톱을: You closed countless doors to protect the line drawn by the Head. As you stifled your presence and swung your Claws, your existence faded like a shadow of the City.
모든 문은 닫혔고 머리의 기척조차 느껴지지 않는 외곽의 끝이다. 세워진: Every door is closed, and you are at the edge of the Outskirts, where not even the presence of the Head can be felt. Beneath your raised Claws, you stare only at the boundary of the line you created yourself.
추를 들어 세상의 균형을 맞추는 법을 익혔다. 머리의 권한 아래 조율을: You learned how to balance the world by lifting the weight. As you began the adjustment under the Head's authority, your first tremor silenced the ground of the Outskirts into stillness.
조율의 과정에서 일어나는 모든 흔들림을 추로 억눌렀다. 머리의 권한은 절: You suppressed every tremor that occurred during the adjustment process with the weight. The Head's authority was absolute, and at the center of that balance, you gradually lost your emotions.
추는 멈추고 균형은 무너진 지 오래다. 머리의 권한조차 닿지 않는 적막: The weight has stopped, and the balance has long since collapsed. In the silence where even the Head's authority does not reach, you remember only the faint tremors of your days as an Arbiter.
첫 갈증을 느끼며 어둠 속에서 영생의 몸을 얻었다. 피의 향기가 감각을: Feeling your first thirst, you gained a body of eternal life in the darkness. When the scent of blood dominated your senses and your fangs emerged, you finally opened the door to endless time.
영생은 갈증의 연속이었고 어둠은 당신의 유일한 안식처였다. 수백 년의 세: Eternal life was a series of thirsts, and the darkness was your only sanctuary. For hundreds of years, you drank blood and accepted the dullness of death with your entire being.
송곳니는 닳고 더 이상 갈증조차 느껴지지 않는 기나긴 어둠이다. 영생의: Your fangs are worn down, and you are in a long darkness where you no longer even feel thirst. Within the cycle of eternal life, you face a boredom more terrible than death.
배를 띄워 대호수의 물결 위로 첫 항로를 개척했다. 선원들의 노 젓는 소: You launched your ship and pioneered the first route over the waves of the Great Lake. Feeling the sound of the crew rowing and the wind catching the sails, you yearned for the end of the lake.
호수는 변함없이 넓고 배는 끝없이 물결을 가르며 나아갔다. 선원들은 바뀌: The lake remained vast, and the ship cut through the waves endlessly. Though the crew changed, the route was carved into your body, reviving every time you raised the sails.
배는 낡아 침몰하고 선원들의 목소리는 이제 들리지 않는다. 호수의 물결만: The ship has aged and sunk, and the voices of the crew are no longer heard. When only the waves of the lake dampen your feet, you no longer seek the route.
총사령관의 자리가 외곽의 배양 시설로 옮겨 갔다. 복제체의 길은 도시 안: The Commander-in-Chief's position was moved to a cultivation facility in the Outskirts. The path of the clones did not end within the City. Time does not flow in the cultivation tanks.
수행 완료 뒤에도 단말기는 꺼지지 않았다. 새 지령이 장소만 말하고 이유: Even after the mission was completed, the terminal did not turn off. The new order stated only the location, not the reason. The place indicated by the order was a misplaced spot. As long as orders arrive, time does not flow.
지령이 끊긴 아침에도 단말기는 꺼지지 않았다. 목적지가 없는 걸음은 어디: Even on the morning when the orders stopped, the terminal did not turn off. Every step taken without a destination led to a misplaced spot.
도서관은 닫히지 않았다. 서가가 도시의 바깥, 어긋난 자리까지 이어져 있: The Library did not close. The bookshelves extended outside the City, to the misplaced spot. Guests continue to arrive from either side, and the Librarian leaves the door open. No one grows old in this Library.
문을 닫았지만 서가는 어긋난 자리에 남았다. 닫힌 문 앞에 찾아오는 손님: You closed the door, but the bookshelves remained in the misplaced spot. The task of turning away guests who come to the closed door never ended. No one grows old in this Library.
도서관을 추출한 뒤에도 서가가 있던 자리는 도시의 지도에 돌아오지 않았다: Even after extracting the Library, the place where the bookshelves stood did not return to the City's map. The door leading outside the line remained open. The Head's final command, "Close it," did not end. Standing at the crossroads, the sun does not accumulate.
도서관을 무너뜨렸지만 선 바깥은 닫히지 않았다. 머리의 마지막 명령 \": You collapsed the Library, but the area outside the line did not close. The Head's final command, "Close it," did not end. Standing at the post guarding the door, the sun does not accumulate.
균형의 한쪽을 도시에 남기면 다른 한쪽을 선 바깥에 두어야 균형이 맞는다: If one side of the balance is left in the City, the other must be placed outside the line for it to be balanced. The Arbiter took charge of the outer weight. The weight only sways; it does not wear out.

인간으로 남은 몸은 도시에 어울리지 않았다. 병기의 몸은 외곽으로 물러났: The body that remained human did not suit the City. The weapon's body retreated to the Outskirts. The weapon's body had no predetermined lifespan from the start.
선 바깥의 기척이 문틈으로 밀려온다. 발톱은 문을 닫아 왔다. 닫는 일은: The presence from outside the line pushes through the door gap. The Claws have been closing the door. The act of closing is repeated endlessly in a place where the sun does not accumulate.

틈 너머의 소리는 도시의 말이 아니었다. 그래도 이쪽을 부르는 것 같았다: The sound from beyond the gap was not the language of the City. Yet, it seemed to be calling out to you.
머리의 명령서가 한 장도 오지 않는다. 마지막 명령 \"닫아라\"만 남아: Not a single order from the Head arrives. Only the final command, "Close it," remains. The reason was never written from the start.
The blade was brought back to life on the whetstone.
While sitting, the sun did not accumulate.
오가는 길목에 도시에서 온 걸음이 선다. 아는 얼굴은 없다. 길목은 열려: A step from the City stands at the crossroads. There is no familiar face. The crossroads are open. The Head speaks to neither this side nor that.
The visitor passed through. The scent of the City remained where they had been.
The visitor turned back. The turning steps continued for a long time.
Even on a body where the sun does not accumulate, the blade rusts. The act of closing wears down the blade. It is the blade that wears out. The hand holding the blade does not.
The rust was stripped away. The blade was as cold as it was in the beginning.
녹을 그대로 둔다: Leave the rust as it is
Even a rusted blade closed the door.
바깥쪽 추가 한 번 크게 흔들린다. 도시 쪽에서 균형이 기울고 있다는 뜻: The outer weight sways heavily once. It means the balance is tilting on the City's side. The Arbiter does not hold the weight. They only adjust it as it sways.
The weight found its place. In some alley of the City, a person caught their breath.
The swaying subsided only after a long time.
장부에 칸이 하나 비어 있다. 쓴 적 없는 칸이다. 조율은 칸을 채우는: There is one empty space in the ledger. It is a space you have never written in. Adjustment is not about filling the space. It is about recording in the ledger the fact that the space is empty.
빈칸을 그대로 적는다: Record the blank space as is
The blank space was entered into the ledger as a blank space.
빈칸에 한 줄을 적는다: Write a line in the blank space
The line you wrote had changed into different handwriting by the next day.
도시 쪽에 남긴 한쪽에서 안부가 온다. 답은 쓰이지 않는다. 안부는 장부: Regards come from the side left in the City. No answer is written. The regards arrive like the wind, without passing through the ledger.
It was unknown if the answer reached the City. Your body felt light while writing.
The received regards were quiet inside the drawer.
맞추지 않아도 되는 날이 하루 이어진다. 쉬운 하루가 아니다. 균형은 흔: A day where no adjustment is needed continues. It is not an easy day. The balance sways, but it does not wear out.
The day was long, and because it was long, your body felt light.
The sun passed over the open ledger without accumulating.
서가 끝의 손님: Guest at the end of the shelf
A guest walks from the end of the misplaced shelf. You do not ask which side they came from. The Librarian leaves the door open.
The guest received the invitation and went inside the shelf.
The guest chose a book without a word.
서가 한 칸에 읽히지 않는 책이 있다. 펼쳐도 글자가 흐른다. 사서는 이: There is an unreadable book on one shelf. Even when opened, the letters flow. The Librarian cannot remember the owner of this book.
The closed book was in the same place the next day.
While the letters were flowing, you read a few names.
There is one more name on the spine of the shelf. You cannot know whose name it is. It is not that of the person who became a book, but of the person who wrote it.
The name I read felt a little warm.
At the end of my gaze, a light was lit.
도서관 문 앞에 초대장이 놓여 있다. 보낸 사람 칸은 비어 있다. 이 도: An invitation lies before the library door. The sender's field is blank. In this library, sometimes guests invite the librarians.
A cup of tea was set at the place where I was invited.
초대장을 서가에 꽂는다: Place the invitation on the shelf
The placed invitation settled on the shelf like a book.
장소만 있는 지령: A directive with only a location
지령이 장소만 말한다. 이유도 시한도 없다. 어긋난 자리에서는 장소가 곧: The directive only states a location. There is no reason, no deadline. In a place gone wrong, the location becomes the reason itself.
There was nothing at the place I arrived at. It rang once more on the way back.
The terminal waited while the sun did not set.
"Training complete" arrives, and a new directive follows immediately. There is no end. Not ending is the shape of the directive.
The training continued, and my body did not tire.
The terminal remained on even where I had set it down.
화면에 처음 받았던 지령과 같은 문장이 뜬다. \"오늘 해가 지기 전에: The same sentence as the first directive I received appears on the screen. "Cross the northern bridge before the sun sets today." There is no bridge anywhere.
I could not find the bridge. A path formed while I was looking.
문장을 읽고 지나친다: Read the sentence and pass by
The sentence I passed by flickered once more behind me.
꺼지지 않는 화면: The screen that does not turn off
화면이 밤새 꺼지지 않는다. 문장은 오지 않는다. 빈 화면이 가장 긴 지: The screen does not turn off all night. No sentences arrive. An empty screen is the longest directive.
My own face was reflected on the empty screen.
화면을 천으로 덮는다: Cover the screen with a cloth
A vibration was felt once beneath the cloth I used to cover it.
어긋난 자리 어디서나 군체의 소리가 들린다. 시술을 받은 몸이 먼저 반응: The sound of the swarm is heard everywhere in this place gone wrong. My augmented body reacts first. This sound is not a call, but an answer.
An answer returned. The inside of my body felt a little thicker.
The sound subsided but did not disappear.
오늘은 아무것도 먹지 않았다. 몸은 먹지 않아도 버틴다. 병기의 몸은 배: I did not eat anything today. The body endures even without eating. The body of a weapon was made to not know hunger.
The day passed without hunger. It was light.
My body grew once more while I ate.
멀리서 도시의 불빛이 보인다. 이쪽에서는 닿지 않는 거리다. 도시는 이: The city lights are visible in the distance. It is a distance that cannot be reached from here. The city does not accept this body.
I watched the lights until they went out. They remained in my eyes even after they faded.
The lights followed me for a long time from behind my back.
거울에 비친 몸이 병기의 모양이다. 이음매가 처음 만들어진 때와 같은 자: The body reflected in the mirror is the shape of a weapon. The seams are in the same places as when it was first made. The body does not age. Only the heart ages.
A low sound came from the tightened seams.
Dawn begins at the incubation facility in the Outskirts. Every dawn, the number changes by one line. Time does not flow, but the numbers do.
The memorized number appeared in my dreams. In the dream, I had a name.
The ignored number was in the same place the next day.
처분 판정서의 빈 줄: The blank line on the disposal form
판정서에 빈 줄이 하나 있다. 이름을 쓸 칸이다. 이 시설에서는 이름을: There is one blank line on the form. It is a space to write a name. In this facility, the one who writes the name is the one doing the disposing.
빈 줄을 그대로 둔다: Leave the blank line as is
The blank line went into the filing cabinet as a blank line.
The name I wrote had been erased by the next day.
번호가 불리는 아침: The morning when numbers are called
아침마다 번호가 불린다. 아무도 대답하지 않는다. 대답하지 않는 것이 이: The numbers are called every morning. No one answers. Not answering is this facility's answer.
The answer echoed in the hallway for a long time.
The silence continued to the end of the hallway.
대기실 문 안쪽에 이름표가 한 줄로 걸려 있다. 이쪽은 이름표를 달지 않: Name tags hang in a row inside the waiting room door. I did not wear a name tag. Therefore, there is nothing to be taken away.
I found a familiar handwriting among the names I read.
The sound of the door closing continued in the room for a long time.
배가 호수에 들어서자 소리가 사라졌다. 파도 소리도, 돛이 스치는 소리도: As the boat entered the lake, the sounds vanished. The sound of waves, the sound of sails brushing—all gone. The captain held a finger to his lips and gave instructions only through gestures. The veteran sailors held their breath in unison. No one asked for the reason.
손짓과 눈짓으로만 움직인다: Move only through gestures and glances
밧줄 한 번 스치는 소리 없이 호수를 건넜다. 선장이 말없이 엄지를 세웠: We crossed the lake without the sound of a single rope brushing. The captain silently gave a thumbs up. They say sailors who have lived on this lake for a long time learn to speak with their hands first.
발끝이 갑판을 스쳤다. 아주 작은 소리였지만 호수가 그것을 들은 것 같았: My toes brushed the deck. It was a very small sound, but it seemed the lake had heard it. The lake took its price.
필담으로 선원들의 움직임을 조율한다: Coordinate the sailors' movements through written notes

눈동자들과 눈을 맞춘 채 한 시간이 지났다. 호수를 벗어났을 때 눈가에서: An hour passed while maintaining eye contact with the pupils. When you left the Lake, tears streamed from your eyes. The pupils never blinked until the end.
눈이 시려 한 번 깜빡였다. 그 순간 수면 아래의 눈동자 하나가 웃는 것: Your eyes stung, so you blinked once. At that moment, one of the pupils beneath the surface seemed to smile.
옆 선원의 어깨를 잡고 함께 버틴다: Grab the shoulder of the sailor next to you and endure it together
둘이면 덜 무섭다 · 돈 +60: It is less scary with two · Money +60
서로의 어깨를 잡고 눈을 뜬 채 걸었다. 손이 떨리는 것이 서로에게 전해: You grabbed each other's shoulders and walked with your eyes open. You could feel each other's hands trembling. Still, you did not close your eyes.

눈을 감자 수면이 조용해졌다. 너무 조용했다. 눈을 떴을 때 눈동자들이: As you closed your eyes, the surface grew quiet. Too quiet. When you opened your eyes, the pupils had risen close to the ship.
신입 선원이 눈을 비볐다. 한 번, 아주 짧게 감았다 떴다. 수면 아래의: The new recruit rubbed his eyes. Once, he closed and opened them very briefly. One of the pupils beneath the surface is now looking up from a spot where it wasn't before. No one else has noticed yet.
신입 선원의 얼굴을 손으로 돌려 시선을 끊는다: Turn the new recruit's face away to break his gaze
신입 선원의 턱을 잡고 눈을 맞추게 했다. 눈동자는 잠시 이쪽을 보다가: You grabbed the new recruit's chin and forced him to look at you. The pupil looked this way for a moment, then slowly sank. The new recruit gasped for air for a long time.

늙은 선원에게 눈짓으로 알린다: Signal the old sailor with a look
늙은 선원이 무겁게 고개를 끄덕였다. 눈을 부릅뜬 채로 숨만 길게 내쉬었: The old sailor nodded heavily. He kept his eyes wide open and only let out long breaths. The pupil is already close to the ship.
눈을 피하지 않고 앞만 보았다. 나중에 신입 선원이 돈 몇 푼을 슬며시: You didn't look away and kept your eyes forward. Later, the new recruit slipped you some money. The pupil had been watching you until the very end.
갑판이 천장이 되었다가 다시 갑판이 되었다. 나침반 바늘이 제멋대로 돈다: The deck became the ceiling, then the deck again. The compass needle spins wildly. The sailors grab onto each other, arguing about what is up and what is down. No common sense works in this Lake.

위아래를 따지다가 어디가 어딘지 알 수 없게 되었다. 간신히 배에 매달려: While arguing about up and down, you lost track of where you were. You barely managed to cling to the ship and escape the Lake.
