큰형님이 직접 식탁을 차렸다. 사람 하나가 모자란다고 했다. 같은 상을: The Big Brother set the table himself. He said one person was missing. It was an invitation to become family and share the same table. A spoon was placed before you instead of a name.
The spoon was held in your hand. No one said you had become family.
큰형님은 일어서는 당신을 잡지 않았다. 문 밖에서 상 치우는 소리가 났다: The Big Brother did not stop you from standing up. You heard the sound of the table being cleared from outside the door.
숟가락을 들지 않고 있는다: Do not pick up the spoon
2년 뒤 다시 부른다: They will call you again in 2 years
The Big Brother did not clear the table and left one seat empty.
큰형님이 되고서 식구는 늘 많았다. 오늘 상에는 비어 있는 자리가 하나: Since becoming a Big Brother, there were always many family members. Today, there was an empty seat at the table. He said it was your job to teach the person who would sit there.
The empty spoon was moved in front of you. It meant you had taken it on.
One family member is missing. No one asked why.
화실 한쪽에 천이 덮인 작품이 있다. 마에스트로가 천을 걷고 이것이 무엇: There is a cloth-covered work in one corner of the studio. The Maestro said he wanted to remove the cloth and hear what it wants to become. The name "Spider's Web" came after that.
천 아래의 윤곽이 조금 움직인 것 같았다. 마에스트로는 아무 말 없이 붓: The outline under the cloth seemed to move slightly. The Maestro handed you a brush without a word.
작품을 보지 않고 나온다: Leave without looking at the work
The gaze behind you did not waver until you closed the door.
2년 뒤 다시 보여 준다: They will show it to you again in 2 years
The cloth was covered again. It remained in the same spot, covered.
마에스트로가 된 당신 앞에 지난 작품의 도면이 놓였다. 틀린 곳에 붉은: The blueprint of the previous work was placed before you, now the Maestro. Red lines are drawn where it was wrong. This time, the request was for you to refine the new materials yourself.
붉은 줄을 따라 고친다: Fixing it along the red lines
Each red line became a new path. A piece of work had begun again.
The blueprint was left covered on one side of the desk. The red lines were not yet dry.
같은 별자리가 세 번 눈에 띄었다. 담벼락의 낙서, 우편함의 압지, 길바: The same constellation caught my eye three times. Graffiti on a wall, blotting paper in a mailbox, chalk marks on the street. The final trace ended in front of an iron door. The door was open.
문턱을 넘자 흔적이 사라졌다. 길은 이미 당신 앞에 놓여 있었던 것 같았: As I crossed the threshold, the trace vanished. It felt as if the path had been laid out before me all along.
I turned my back, but the feeling of footsteps following me lingered for a long time.
흔적을 지우고 돌아선다: Erase the trace and turn away
분필 자국은 비에 지워졌다. 같은 별자리가 다른 곳에 다시 나타날 것이다: The chalk marks were washed away by the rain. The same constellation would appear elsewhere again.
별 하나를 이은 뒤로 성도는 조용했다. 어느 밤 별 하나가 제 자리에서: The star chart had been quiet since I connected one star. One night, a star tilted slightly from its place. Following the tilt, I found an iron door. Something inside was pulling at the star. No one had called, and no one had ordered it. It was I who saw that there was something there to be taught.
별 하나가 방향을 바꾸었다. 인도받은 것인지 유도된 것인지는 알 수 없었: One star changed its direction. I could not tell if I was being guided or led. It was I who judged that there was something there.
The star remained, tilted slightly. The iron door did not close.
철문이 닫히자 바깥의 소음이 끊겼다. 열쇠를 쥔 손바닥에 땀이 배어 있었: As the iron door closed, the noise from outside ceased. Sweat beaded on the palm holding the key. The gatekeeper checked my shoes once and said only, "Follow the rules." The Underboss stood in the training room at the end of the hall. He hadn't moved a step, yet all the marks on the floor seemed to gather beneath his feet. There were no wrinkles on his cuffs. "I heard the Boss sent you." His voice was low and unhurried. "Here, your standing place comes first, and your name comes later." The place where you are to stand has not yet been revealed.
허리를 굽히고 자리가 주어지길 기다린다: Bow and wait for a place to be given
당신은 허리를 굽힌 채 말을 아꼈다. 언더보스는 고개를 끄덕이지 않았지만: You bowed and kept your words to a minimum. The Underboss did not nod, but his gaze pointed to one spot. It was a mark three steps away from the door. You placed your feet upon it. The Underboss looked at the angle of your toes and tugged at his cuff once. He said neither that it was wrong nor that it was right. To those who waited, a place was given.
먼저 구조를 눈으로 읽는다: Read the structure with your eyes first
당신은 대답 대신 바닥의 표시를 눈으로 따라갔다. 선들은 언더보스의 발밑: Instead of answering, you followed the marks on the floor with your eyes. The lines started from beneath the Underboss's feet and led to a low door in the corner of the training room. The door was closed. The Underboss waited for you to avert your gaze. "Watching is permitted. I do not answer what is not asked." You etched the location of the low door into your mind.
훈련은 검을 쥐기 전에 서는 법부터 시작되었다. 언더보스는 당신의 발끝: Training began with how to stand before even gripping a sword. The Underboss drew a chalk line in front of your toes. "Angle. Once more." Only after the same words were repeated three times were you given a sword. Mission reports were posted on the wall in chronological order, and one sheet had a corner sticking out. Even during training, the Underboss would walk over to that paper, align the corner, and return. He did not explain why. You realized that the rules were upheld not just with the sword, but with the papers as well.
시키는 각도를 말없이 맞춘다: Silently adjust to the requested angle
당신은 이유를 묻지 않고 발끝을 선에 맞췄다. 세 번째 시도에서 언더보스: You aligned your toes with the line without asking why. On the third attempt, the Underboss's hand tapped your wrist once. That was his acknowledgment. When training ended, the chalk line had faded. The next day, the same line was drawn again in the same spot. You understood that the fact that the line could not be erased was the nature of the rules.
규칙의 쓰임을 몸으로 익힌다: Learn the application of the rules with your body
당신은 쉬는 틈에 벽의 종이로 가서 튀어나온 모서리를 맞췄다. 언더보스는: During a break, you went to the paper on the wall and aligned the protruding corner. The Underboss paused for half a beat and tugged at his cuff. There was no praise. Instead, the next day, there was one more paper with an aligned corner. The words that one should correct what is visible first were never spoken aloud.
당신이 종이에 손을 대자 언더보스가 검을 거두고 분필 선을 한 줄 더 그: As you touched the paper, the Underboss sheathed his sword and drew one more chalk line. The line was narrower than before. The price for the unrequested adjustment returned as the width of your stance. You had to endure on the narrow line for an hour.
맞은편의 열린 문: The open door across the hall
배정된 방은 훈련실과 복도 하나를 사이에 두고 있었다. 침대와 책상, 잠: The assigned room was separated from the training room by a single hallway. It had a bed, a desk, and a drawer with a lock. The key was shaped differently from the one received at the iron door. The door to the room across the hall was open, but the inside was dark and hard to see. In the evening, the Underboss received and read your first report. His finger stopped at one line. "Is this something you saw, or something you guessed?" When you answered, a short line was drawn through that sentence. As you passed the hall, you could only see the backrest of the empty chair in the open room. The chair was placed facing the wall.
방 열쇠와 서랍을 직접 확인한다: Check the room key and drawer yourself
당신은 문을 잠그고 서랍의 잠금장치까지 당겨 보았다. 열쇠는 베개 밑이: You locked the door and even pulled on the drawer's lock to check it. You placed the key on the desk, not under the pillow. The next day, the Underboss passed by your room and tugged at the door handle once. "You are the one who checks." It was not a reprimand. You began to divide what you could protect and what you had to entrust. The empty chair in the hall did not move that night either.
빈 의자의 용도를 살핀다: Examine the purpose of the empty chair
당신은 문턱에서 걸음을 멈추고 안쪽을 보았다. 의자 말고는 아무것도 없었: You stopped at the threshold and looked inside. There was nothing but the chair, and the floor was swept clean of dust. It was a room someone cleaned every day. Behind you, there was the sound of a cuff being tugged. The Underboss was standing in the hall. "You did not cross the threshold, so I do not ask." You withdrew your foot. From that day on, your pace quickened by a beat whenever you passed that room.
당신이 안쪽을 보려고 몸을 기울이는 순간 문이 안에서 반쯤 닫혔다. 손잡: The moment you leaned in to see inside, the door half-closed from within. You could not see who held the handle. At the end of the hall, the Underboss was looking this way. He said nothing, but a line was added to your report. The open door was not an open door. Only the fact that you had looked inside remained in the record.
손에서 빠진 검: The sword slipped from my hand
The training sword slipped from your hand and hit the floor. The sound lingered long against the training room walls. You immediately reached to pick it up, but the Underboss raised his palm to stop you. "Stop." The sword lay a span away from your toes. No one explained that the sword had slipped only after your posture had collapsed. The Underboss picked up the sword, checked the angle of the blade, and handed it over. "Again." The same movement continued. Your palms turned red. Even on the final attempt, the tip of the sword missed the mark. When training ended, a report form was handed to you. You were told to write not your successes, but the points where you failed.
빠진 순간의 손과 발을 그대로 적는다: Write down the hands and feet at the moment of the slip
당신은 검이 빠진 순간의 엄지 위치와 발의 각도를 그대로 적었다. 문장은: You wrote down the position of your thumb and the angle of your feet at the exact moment the sword slipped. You did not refine the sentences. The Underboss corrected one line. "The wrist, too." You added the omitted item. The next day, that report was spread out on the training room floor. The failure did not become something that never happened, but a standard was created to check for the same mistake again.
무너진 원인을 따져 다음 동작에 연결한다: Analyze the cause of the collapse and connect it to the next movement
실패에서 규칙을 찾는다: Find the rule in the failure
당신은 검이 빠진 순간보다 직전의 발 움직임을 먼저 적었다. 언더보스는: You wrote down the movement of your feet just before the sword slipped, rather than the moment it happened. The Underboss looked back and forth between the report and the marks on the floor. "Verify that." When you reproduced the movement slowly and in parts the next day, the first attempt failed, but on the second, the sword did not slip from your hand. You were told to record the difference. You learned for the first time how to find the place where a failure begins.
당신은 원인을 너무 일찍 하나로 정했다. 언더보스는 보고서를 반으로 접어: You decided on a single cause too early. The Underboss folded the report in half and placed it on the table. "What is not verified is not a fact." In the next training session, the sword slipped once more. You had to erase the cause you first wrote and rewrite it starting from the fact that you did not know.
해의 마지막 날 기록원이 훈련실 구석에서 종이를 펼쳤다. 잉크 묻은 손가: On the last day of the year, the recorder spread out paper in the corner of the training room. Ink-stained fingers pressed the edges of the page. The recorder did not ask questions. Training hours and the number of corrections were read out in turn. In the place where your name should have been, an observation number was written. The Underboss adjusted his cuff once while listening. "Is anything missing?" The recorder turned the page without looking up. Your first failure remained as a short sentence. There was no record regarding the empty chair in the room across the hall. Only after the paper was covered did the Underboss speak. "Tomorrow is the same time."
번호 대신 이름을 쓰게 해 달라고 청한다: Ask to have my name written instead of the number
호칭의 자리를 바로잡는다: Correct the place of the title
당신은 허리를 굽히고 기록의 호칭을 청했다. 기록원은 펜을 멈췄다가 언더: You bowed and requested the title for the record. The recorder paused his pen and looked at the Underboss once. The Underboss did not nod, nor did he stop it. A name was added in a line next to the number. The number was not erased. Two notations remained side by side over one person.
기록을 읽고 틀린 곳만 짚어 서명한다: Read the record and sign only after pointing out errors
당신은 훈련 시간 하나가 잘못 적힌 것을 짚었다. 기록원은 말없이 고쳤고: You pointed out that one training hour was recorded incorrectly. The recorder corrected it without a word, and you signed. The number remained a number. The Underboss checked the signed paper and returned it. "It is a record you have verified." You took the copy and brought it to your room. The first year closed not with achievements, but with a list of what had been done.
훈련실에 낯선 사람이 들어왔다. 다른 손가락의 사람이었다. 방문자는 벽에: A stranger entered the training room. It was someone from another Finger. The visitor scanned the reports on the wall and looked at your sword for a long time. The Underboss stepped aside one pace without a word, clearing the path. It was not the posture of dealing with a superior, but the posture of dealing with someone of equal standing. "Interesting." The visitor asked you to show a short movement. The Underboss did not answer for you. At the threshold, the visitor stopped. "The record will remain, won't it?" As the door closed, the Underboss examined your posture from the beginning again.
당신은 지금까지 배운 동작을 순서대로 보였다. 방문자는 검끝의 각도와 발: You showed the movements you had learned so far in order. The visitor watched the angle of the sword tip and the position of your feet closely. When the final movement ended, he said, "You have the basics," and wrote a line on the paper. It was impossible to know what he had written. The fact that your posture could be evaluated even outside the training room became clear.
시범 대신 방문자의 쥐는 법을 관찰한다: Observe the visitor's grip instead of demonstrating
당신은 시범을 마친 뒤 방문자가 검을 받아 쥐는 모양을 지켜보았다. 손잡: After finishing the demonstration, you watched the way the visitor took and held the sword. He held the handle loosely and kept his wrist relaxed. It was a grip not found in the rules. After the visitor left, the Underboss corrected your wrist. "What you see and what you are taught are different." You wrote down what you saw separately in the margins of the report.
You stared at the visitor's hand for too long and missed the sequence of the demonstration movement. The sword tip missed the target. The visitor left, leaving only the words, "Interesting." The Underboss corrected your wrist. "Just because you saw it doesn't make it yours." The note you intended to write in the margin was erased.
처음으로 정식 임무에 이름이 올랐다. 전당포 뒷방에서 상자 하나를 회수해: For the first time, your name was on an official mission. It was a job to recover a box from the back room of a pawnshop. The order sheet contained the route and the return time, and your share was to follow half a step behind the Underboss. It was raining, and the stone floor of the alley was dark. In front of the back door, the owner opened the door halfway and tried to haggle over the price. The Underboss did not respond, only brushing the rainwater from his cuffs. The door was closing little by little. If you stepped forward, things might go faster, or they might get complicated.
당신은 발을 움직이지 않았다. 문이 닫히기 직전에 언더보스가 손을 문틈에: You did not move your feet. Just before the door closed, the Underboss put his hand into the gap. The owner finally closed his mouth and handed over the box. The rain did not stop. On the way back, the Underboss said only one thing. "Keeping your place is also a mission." You held the box with both hands. It was light in weight, and the signature was the Underboss's share.
한 걸음 나서서 문틈을 가로막는다: Step forward one pace and block the door gap
닫히기 전에 일을 끝낸다: Finish the job before it closes
당신은 어깨로 문틈을 막고 주인의 손목을 잡았다. 주인이 놀라 상자를 떨: You blocked the door gap with your shoulder and grabbed the owner's wrist. The owner was startled and almost dropped the box. The job ended in an instant. The Underboss took the box without a word and brushed the rainwater from your shoulder once. "Next time, move after receiving a signal." The reprimand was short, and the mission was a success. You learned for the first time what the value of one step was.
당신이 문틈을 막으려 한 순간 주인이 문을 안에서 걸어 잠갔다. 어깨가: The moment you tried to block the door gap, the owner locked the door from the inside. Your shoulder hit the door frame. The Underboss pushed you one step back and knocked on the door twice. The door opened half an hour later, and the return time was delayed. The report recorded the time you stepped forward.
문 앞의 그릇: The bowl in front of the door
방문 앞에 덮개를 씌운 그릇이 놓여 있었다. 식사 시간이 한참 지난 뒤였: A bowl with a lid was placed in front of your door. It was well past mealtime. It was still warm, and it was clear that it was a portion someone had set aside. There was no name or note. The bowl was placed facing the direction of the room with the empty chair at the end of the hall. You could not tell if it was for you or if the portion meant for that room had been placed incorrectly. There was no one in the hall. The Underboss stopped as he passed by and looked down at the bowl once. He continued walking without saying a word.
그릇을 열린 방의 문턱에 가져다 놓는다: Bring the bowl to the threshold of the open room
주인이 있을 자리로 돌려보낸다: Return it to the place where the owner would be
당신은 그릇을 들어 맞은편 방의 문턱 바깥에 놓았다. 문턱을 넘지 않았다: You picked up the bowl and placed it outside the threshold of the room across the hall. You did not cross the threshold. The next day, the bowl returned to the front of your room, empty. It had even been washed. You could not tell who had eaten it or who had brought it back. You only confirmed the fact that portions were being exchanged.
그대로 받아 먹는다: Accept and eat it as is
받은 몫을 거절하지 않는다: Do not refuse the portion received
당신은 방으로 그릇을 들고 들어가 문을 잠그고 먹었다. 식사는 식지 않았: You took the bowl into your room, locked the door, and ate. The meal had not gone cold, and the portion was small. As you emptied the bowl, your throat tightened for no reason. The next day at the same time, the same bowl was placed in front of your room. You did not ask if it was a promise or a favor. A place where you were allowed to receive a portion had been created.
낮은 문 앞의 새벽: Dawn in front of the low door
훈련이 끝난 뒤에도 훈련실에 남는 날이 늘었다. 낮은 문 앞 바닥만은 분: The days you remained in the training room even after training ended increased. Only the floor in front of the low door had no marks because the chalk did not reach it. In that empty space, you tested the visitor's grip by yourself. It was a movement of keeping the sword tip low and then twisting your wrist. You failed twice and grazed the target on the third try. There was the sound of a door opening. The Underboss was standing at the threshold. His hand, which usually tugged at his cuff, was still. "Who taught you?" You could not find the words to answer.
보고 따라 한 것이라고 말한다: Say you saw it and followed it
당신은 방문자의 쥐는 법을 보고 혼자 따라 했다고 말했다. 언더보스는 검: You said you saw the visitor's grip and followed it on your own. The Underboss did not take the sword. "Here, we do it in the way we are taught." He looked at the low door once and added, "Do not use the front of that door." The next day, the Underboss made you show the movement again and pointed out the spots where gaps were created. He said it was not a matter of prohibition, but a matter of sequence.
현재 훈련의 범위를 지킨다: Keep to the current training scope
당신은 검을 거두고 훈련실을 정리했다. 언더보스는 바닥의 표시를 다시 맞: You sheathed your sword and tidied the training room. The Underboss realigned the markings on the floor and noted the next day's training sequence. "Start with the basics tomorrow." You did not hide the fact that you had practiced other movements in your report. The Underboss told you to write down the learned techniques and the movements you tested on your own separately.
같은 동작을 다시 보이고 빈틈을 찾는다: Demonstrate the same movement again and look for openings
만든 것을 몸으로 검증한다: Verify what you have created with your body
당신은 같은 동작을 다시 보였다. 이번에는 목표에 닿았지만 돌아오는 동작: You demonstrated the same movement again. This time, you reached the target, but your stance opened up during the recovery. The Underboss crossed swords with you, exposing the opening. "You shouldn't look only at the successful parts." You lowered your sword and pointed out where you had opened up. The Underboss waited until you spoke. The instruction not to use the space in front of the low door came afterward.
당신이 동작을 재현하려다 검끝이 낮은 문 쪽으로 벗어났다. 쇳소리가 길게: As you tried to replicate the movement, the tip of your sword strayed toward the low door. A long metallic sound rang out, and there was a stir of movement from inside the door. The Underboss immediately stopped the training. "Stop." The two of you did not move an inch until it was quiet inside the door again.
두 번째 해의 기록을 위해 기록원이 훈련실에 섰다. 이번에는 훈련 시간뿐: The Recorder stood in the training room for the second year's record. This time, not only the training hours but also the mission reports were read aloud. The Underboss checked the documents over the Recorder's shoulder. "Is anything missing?" The Recorder did not answer and turned the page. You looked down at the marks on your palms. They had faded since the beginning, but lines stood out again when you gripped your sword. The Recorder did not write about your hands. Only the number of corrections and mission results remained on the paper. A hand shape was drawn in pencil on the edge of the last page, then quickly covered. The Recorder bound the documents.
덮이는 그림에서 시선을 거두고 기다린다: Look away from the covered drawing and wait
You looked away from the covered drawing and waited for the Recorder to bind the documents. The Underboss tugged at the end of his sleeve once. There were no words. Only the impression that the hand shape in the drawing resembled your own remained. A line was left in the record about the work that was decided not to be read.

당신은 언더보스와 함께 레테의 기록 중 공개되어서는 안 될 항목을 골랐다: Together with the Underboss, you selected items from Lethe's records that should not be made public. The recorder verified the two's choice and received the signatures. The records did not disappear, but they were not for just anyone to read. You signed on the same knot. The two of you became responsible for the result together.
열쇠를 문 앞에 두고 혼자 떠난다: Leave the key at the door and depart alone
스승을 거미집에 남긴다: Leave the mentor in the spiderweb
당신은 열쇠를 문턱 위에 내려놓았다. 언더보스는 손을 뻗지 않았다. 당신: You placed the key on the threshold. The Underboss did not reach out. You bowed and stepped out the door first. The recorder only noted that you had left. Whose place was left behind was not written in the document. The key lay just as it was under the morning sun.
절차와 누락된 기록을 밖으로 넘긴다: Pass the procedures and omitted records to the outside
당신은 프로젝트의 절차와 누락된 기록을 외부로 넘길 수 있도록 문서를 모: You gathered the documents so that the project's procedures and omitted records could be passed to the outside. The Underboss did not stop you, nor did they join you. The gatekeeper stepped aside. There was no guarantee what results this would bring. A severed thread is not easily reconnected.
공개 절차는 중간에 막혔고 일부 기록만 밖으로 전달되었다. 언더보스는 남: The disclosure procedure was blocked midway, and only some records were delivered outside. The Underboss said while organizing the remaining documents, "Severing a thread does not untie every knot." You kept the list of undelivered records separately. The attempt to sever was only half-completed.
철문 앞의 문지기는 당신의 신발부터 살폈다. 몇 해 전 걸려 있던 자물쇠: The gatekeeper in front of the iron door examined your shoes first. The padlock that had been hanging years ago was gone, and the hinges had been freshly oiled. "By the rules." The inner hallway was excessively clean. The markings that had been on the walls left only traces of being torn off, and new spots for feet were drawn on the training room floor. Not many people knew how the previous affair had ended. The message sent by the Godfather had only one line. It was to take the position of teaching people in the new project. It was not written who you were to teach. The rooms on both sides of the hallway were all empty.
뜯긴 표시의 자국을 살핀다: Examine the traces of the torn-off markings
당신은 벽의 자국을 손끝으로 짚었다. 접착제가 덜 마른 곳이 있었다. 지: You traced the marks on the wall with your fingertips. There were places where the adhesive had not yet dried. It had not been long since they were erased. The gatekeeper saw your hand but did not stop you. Instead, they stepped back toward the door to clear the path. This place had not been emptied; it had been hurriedly wiped clean. You wrote that fact on the first line of your report.
이전 일이 남긴 것을 센다: Count what the previous events left behind
방은 모두 비어 있었다. 침대와 책상, 잠금장치가 달린 서랍이 갖춰진 방: The rooms were all empty. A few rooms remained equipped with beds, desks, and drawers with locks, and the bottom of a drawer in one room had long scratch marks. There was no record of whose room it had been. You wrote the number and condition of the rooms on the form. There were more rooms left behind by the previous events than you had thought.
대부의 사람이 규칙을 적은 종이 한 장을 가져왔다. 규율을 어긴 값으로: A person of the Godfather brought a sheet of paper with the rules written on it. It was someone who had offered a finger joint as the price for breaking the rules and had since taken on the task of carrying the Godfather's words. The Godfather's person bowed before you. The previous project's rules had been over five lines, but this time there were three. What to teach, what to record, what not to send outside. The last line did not say what was not to be sent out. "You were told to leave the task of teaching people to the Underboss." One signature line was empty.
세 줄을 그대로 받아들인다: Accept the three lines as they are
규칙이 적은 쪽이 지킬 것이다: The side with the rules will keep them
당신은 서명란에 이름을 적었다. 세 줄은 짧아서 어길 구석도, 빠져나갈: You wrote your name on the signature line. The three lines were so short that there was plenty of room to break them or slip through them. The Godfather's person bowed their head as they took the paper. Having few rules also meant there was only one person who had to keep them. That night, you memorized the three lines. Even after memorizing the last line, the meaning would not take hold.
마지막 줄의 뜻을 묻는다: Ask the meaning of the last line
당신은 서명하기 전에 밖으로 내보내지 않을 것이 무엇인지 물었다. 대부의: Before signing, you asked what it was that was not to be sent outside. The Godfather's person looked down at the paper for a long time. "The records." That was all. You repeated the word 'records' once more. Whether 'records' referred to people or documents was never decided. You signed, but you also left the fact that you had asked in your report.
당신이 마지막 줄의 뜻을 따져 묻자 대부의 사람은 마디 없는 손을 소매: When you pressed for the meaning of the last line, the Godfather's person hid their jointless hand inside their sleeve and bowed lower. "It is not something I can say with my own mouth. Please forgive my insolence." They were someone who had offered a finger and carried the Godfather's words. You told them that was enough and sent them back. The signature line remained empty, and the question could have been read as a refusal.
프로젝트와 분리해 보호한다: Protect them by separating them from the project
며칠 지켜본다: Watch them for a few days
실패한 순간을 함께 되짚는다: Review the moment of failure together
관찰 번호를 이름으로 고치게 한다: Have the observation number corrected to a name
기록의 호칭을 바로잡는다: Correct the title in the record
기록이 정확하면 그대로 서명한다: Sign as is if the record is accurate
형식은 기록원의 몫이다: The format is the recorder's duty
당신은 시간과 횟수를 확인하고 서명했다. 훈련은 정확히 적혀 있었고 틀린: You checked the time and repetitions and signed. The training was written accurately, and there were no errors. The recorder saw the signature and bound the documents. The number remained a number. You knew that an accurate record did not say everything, but you decided not to confirm anything more than that in the first year.
배운 만큼만 보여 준다: Show only as much as they have learned
검을 뽑지 않고 대치한다: Confront them without drawing your sword
이유를 묻지 않고 그릇을 그대로 둔다: Leave the bowl as is without asking why
누구를 위한 몫인지 확인한다: Confirm who the portion is for
규칙 밖의 일을 파악한다: Grasp the matters outside the rules
새벽 훈련실에서 칼날 스치는 소리가 났다. 문틈으로 들여다보니 {제자}가: The sound of blades brushing against each other echoed in the dawn training hall. Peering through the gap in the door, I saw {제자} practicing alone. Following the grip shown by the previous visitor, they kept the sword tip low and rotated their wrist. They failed twice, but on the third attempt, they grazed the edge of the mark. It was a move I hadn't taught, nor had I permitted. {제자} gasped, noticed the shadow at the door, and lowered the sword. {제자}'s gaze dropped to the floor first.
틀린 것이 아니라 이르다고 일러 준다: Tell them it is not wrong, just premature
금지하지 않고 순서를 정한다: Do not forbid it, but set an order
당신은 동작이 틀린 것이 아니라 앞뒤가 비어 있다고 말했다. 시작과 마무: I told them the move wasn't wrong, but that it lacked the necessary foundation. I explained that it was a technique that could only be used after mastering the beginning and the end. {제자} pointed out the gaps in their form and noted them in the report. The move that wasn't forbidden became homework, and I set no deadline for it.
기본이 갖춰질 때까지 쓰지 말라 한다: Tell them not to use it until the basics are set
당신은 기본 자세가 완성될 때까지 그 동작을 쓰지 말라고 했다. {제자}: I told them not to use that move until their basic posture was perfected. {제자} bowed their head without a word. It was my way not to explain the reasons at length. The training returned to basics, and the sword tip stabilized quickly. The unauthorized move simply vanished from the training sequence.
같은 동작을 한 번 더 보이게 한다: Make them show the same move again
직접 빈틈을 보게 한다: Make them see the gap themselves
당신은 {제자}에게 같은 동작을 한 번 더 보이게 했다. 이번에는 목표에: I made {제자} show me the same move again. This time it reached the target, but their posture opened up the moment they returned. I crossed swords to expose the gap and waited until {제자} could say for themselves where they had faltered. {제자} noted the opening after the attack in the report.
{제자}는 동작을 재현하다 검끝을 제어하지 못했다. 쇳소리가 길게 울렸고: While recreating the move, {제자} lost control of the sword tip. A long, metallic screech rang out, and I immediately stopped the training to check their wrist. There was no injury, but {제자} kept their gaze lowered, unable to shake the fact that they had tried.
두 번째 해의 기록을 위해 기록원이 훈련실에 섰다. 이번에는 {제자}의: The recorder stood in the training hall for the second year's record. This time, the space for {제자}'s name was filled from the start. I listened to the voice reading the record until the end. Training hours, number of corrections, number of missions accompanied. The numbers were accurate. Beside me, {제자} was looking down at the marks on their palm. They were fainter than before, and {제자} seemed not to notice the change. The recorder covered the edge of the final page with their hand and bound the document. I did not know what was written on the covered spot.
덮인 자리를 보여 달라고 한다: Ask to see the covered spot
언더보스의 권한을 쓴다: Use the authority of an Underboss
당신은 직위를 입에 올리지 않고 문서의 마지막 장을 가리켰다. 기록원은: Without mentioning my position, I pointed to the last page of the document. The recorder paused for a moment before lifting their hand. On the paper, the shape of {제자}'s hand was drawn, with only the date written below. There was no explanation. The recorder closed the document again and said, "You have seen it." I could not ask for the meaning of what I had seen.
As I reached out, the recorder held the document with both hands and bowed. "I cannot show you without the Godfather's approval. My apologies." I withdrew my hand. The position of Underboss did not open every record. That fact told me the weight of what lay in the covered spot.
당신은 덮이지 않은 쪽만 읽고 서명했다. 숫자는 맞았고 {제자}의 이름: I read only the uncovered pages and signed. The numbers were correct, and {제자}'s name was spelled properly. The recorder wrote the date below my signature and bound the document. The covered spot remained covered. To ensure I would not forget it, I returned to my room and placed a single dot in the margin of the report.
먼 곳의 일로 열흘 넘게 거미집을 비웠다. 돌아와 훈련실 문을 열자 바닥: I was away from the Spider's nest for over ten days due to a matter in a distant place. When I returned and opened the training hall door, there was one more mark on the floor. {제자} had drawn it alone. Even while I was away, {제자} trained at the appointed time and never missed a session. However, the training record contained only the time, with no name of the person who corrected them. As {제자} greeted me, they looked at my wrist first. In those ten days, our eye levels had become the same. The angle of their sword was half a span lower than what I had taught.
당신은 새 표시 위에 서서 발끝을 맞추어 보았다. 반 뼘 낮은 각도는 틀: I stood on the new mark and aligned my toes. The angle, half a span lower, was not wrong. "Leave it as it is."{제자} did not answer but tugged at their sleeve once. What the absence had left behind was not the empty time, but a line {제자} had drawn themselves. On the training hall floor, the marks of two people were now overlapping.
원래 표시로 돌려놓는다: Return it to the original mark
I rubbed out the newly drawn line with an eraser and made them place their feet in the original spot. {제자} followed without a word. I could see the sense they had built over ten days being thrown off all at once. The training started over from the beginning. The standard was maintained, and whose standard it was could not be read in {제자}'s eyes.
문 앞을 지킨 흔적을 말없이 받아들인다: Silently accept the traces of them guarding the door
고마움이 어디까지인지 묻지 않는다: Do not ask how far their gratitude goes
문턱 안쪽 바닥에 누가 앉았던 자국이 남아 있었다. {제자}는 훈련을 했: There was a mark on the floor inside the threshold where someone had been sitting. {제자} only said they had been training, and I pretended to believe them. The water on the table was still warm. I thought about when this person had become accustomed to waiting, then stopped my thoughts. We both knew that something else was mixed in with the gratitude, but neither of us gave it a name.
{제자}의 방을 정리하던 날, 침대 밑에서 낡은 매듭 끈이 나왔다. {제: On the day I was tidying {제자}'s room, an old knotted string came out from under the bed. It was not {제자}'s. The string was old and faded, and it looked as if the knot had never been tied properly. It was an object found at the same height as the scratches on the bottom of the drawer. It meant someone had used this room before. {제자} held the string in their hand before offering it to me. The recorder's files had no entry regarding the previous occupant of this room.
끈을 방에 도로 둔다: Put the string back in the room
당신은 끈을 서랍 안쪽에 넣고 잠금장치를 걸었다. {제자}는 잠금 소리를: I put the string inside the drawer and locked it. {제자} let out a long breath upon hearing the sound of the lock. The past remained inside the drawer. In the report, I wrote only one line: Room tidying complete. Covering up what was found was also a choice, and that choice remained under my name.
끈을 기록원에게 가져간다: Take the string to the recorder
당신은 끈을 가지고 기록원을 찾았다. 기록원은 끈을 받아 한참 들여다보았: I took the string and sought out the recorder. The recorder took the string and stared at it for a long time. "This is not an item on the inventory list." That was the only answer. The string was not returned. Instead, the recorder wrote a new line on the inventory list. Who the previous occupant of this room was remained unwritten.
지령서가 이번에는 당신이 아니라 {제자}의 이름으로 도착했다. 대부의 사: The directive arrived this time in {제자}'s name, not mine. It was delivered directly by one of the Godfather's people. The mission was a short-range retrieval, and the risk was not high. However, the space for a companion was empty. {제자} looked at me while holding the directive. Their eyes were asking if it was a task they were allowed to refuse. I checked the signature on the directive. It was the Godfather's handwriting. Whether this mission was for {제자}'s sake or a test for {제자} could not be determined from the document alone.
당신은 매듭이 풀리지 않았는지 확인한 뒤 {제자}를 보냈다. {제자}는: I checked that the knot was not loose before sending {제자} off. {제자} looked back once before stepping out the door. They returned half an hour earlier than scheduled. The retrieved item was undamaged, and there were no blank spaces in the report. I had not sat down once while waiting. The price of trust was paid on my end.
{제자}는 경로를 벗어난 사람과 마주쳐 복귀가 늦어졌다. 회수는 끝냈으나: {제자} was delayed because they encountered someone off the path. The retrieval was finished, but their sleeve was torn. I waited at the door and only sat down once I saw {제자} returning. The reason for the delay was written in detail in the report. The responsibility for the decision to send them remained with me.
당신은 {제자}가 문을 나선 뒤 일정 거리를 두고 따라갔다. {제자}는: I followed {제자} at a distance after they left the door. {제자} never looked back once. The mission ended safely, and there was no need for me to intervene. However, on the way back, {제자} stopped and looked back once. They looked at the empty alleyway and then walked on. Whether {제자} had noticed I was following remained unknown.
정해져 온 훈련: The training that was already set
대부의 사람이 새 훈련 계획서를 가져왔다. 지금까지 훈련은 당신이 정했는: The Godfather's person brought a new training plan. Until now, I had set the training, but this time the items and frequency were already written down. Precision swordsmanship, posture maintenance, repeated demonstrations. The demonstration items required the recorder's attendance. I read the plan twice. It matched almost perfectly with what {제자} needed. That was why it was even stranger. It was a plan written by someone who had watched {제자} for a long time. The Godfather's person pointed to the signature line.
계획서를 그대로 따른다: Follow the plan as it is
위에서 정한 일정을 맞춘다: Meet the schedule set from above
당신은 서명하고 계획서를 훈련실 벽에 걸었다. {제자}는 항목을 하나씩: I signed and hung the plan on the training hall wall. {제자} read the items one by one and tugged at their sleeve. The training proceeded in the set order, and {제자} did not fall behind. The fact that the plan was correct was rather uncomfortable. I did not ask who the training was aimed at.
당신은 시연 횟수를 줄이고 휴식 시간을 한 줄 덧붙였다. 대부의 사람은: I reduced the number of demonstrations and added a line for rest time. The Godfather's person read the changes and did not open their mouth for a while. "I will convey this to the recorder." The plan was accepted with the modifications. Whether the parts I changed were accepted or held in reserve could not be known.
계획서 여백에 {제자}의 하루를 적는다: Write {제자}'s day in the margins of the plan
공식 기록 밖의 사람을 남긴다: Leave behind someone outside the official record
당신은 서명하기 전에 계획서 여백에 {제자}의 하루를 적어 두었다. 밤마: Before signing, I wrote {제자}'s day in the margins of the plan. The back of them turning off the training hall lights every night, the day they first made a joke, the winter they turned from nineteen to twenty. While writing, I was confused about whether this was a note for the plan or something else. The Godfather's person saw the margins but did not erase them and only took the signature.
세 번째 해의 기록이 열렸다. 기록원은 당신의 장기 임무와 {제자}의 단: The third year's record was opened. The recorder wrote my long-term mission and {제자}'s solo mission on the same page. The contents of the box were not recorded. Beside me, {제자}'s gaze had become firmer. They no longer tugged at their sleeve. The recorder wrote the two names side by side at the end of the document and set the pen down as if asking for the order of signatures. The only thing that signaled the passing of the year was the mark on the floor. The two marks were now overlapping in a single line.
당신은 펜을 {제자}에게 밀었다. {제자}는 이름을 적고 펜을 당신에게: I pushed the pen toward {제자}. {제자} wrote their name and returned the pen to me. The recorder bound the document with the changed signature order without a word. My name had moved below. What that small change in position became between the two of us could only be known after the year had turned.
당신은 평소처럼 먼저 서명하고 펜을 건넸다. {제자}는 이름을 적는 동안: I signed first as usual and handed over the pen. {제자}'s hand trembled slightly while they wrote their name. The recorder bound the document. The order did not change, and {제자} did not object to that order. The fact that not objecting had become comfortable was no longer strange between the two of us.
서명 옆 여백에 곁이라고 적는다: Write "by your side" in the margin next to the signature
직위가 아닌 말로 남긴다: Leave it in words, not a title
당신은 서명 옆 여백에 곁이라는 한 글자를 적었다. 기록원은 보았으나 지: I wrote the word "by your side" in the margin next to my signature. The recorder saw it but did not erase it. {제자} read the words and stood for a long time without raising their head. It was a word that was neither a title nor a name. I decided not to question whether that word was appropriate to be used between master and disciple.
임무를 마친 {제자}가 보고서를 들고 훈련실에 섰다. 지령서에 없는 상황: {제자} stood in the training hall with the report after finishing the mission. In a situation not covered by the directive, {제자} had made a judgment without being able to ask me, abandoning the set path and leaving a narrow road open for others to pass. The retrieval was half an hour late, and the box was safe. The wall was covered in recording paper, and the recorder was standing in the corner. An order had come down that from today, I must teach not how to wield the sword, but how to sheathe it. I read {제자}'s report twice.
판단을 인정하고 거두는 법을 가르친다: Acknowledge the judgment and teach how to sheathe it
기술이 아니라 판단을 가르친다: Teach the judgment, not the technique
당신은 {제자}의 판단이 옳았다고 말하고 검을 거두는 순간의 판단을 가르: I told {제자} their judgment was correct and taught them the judgment of the moment of sheathing the sword. It was a move that did not involve swinging, and it was difficult to record. The recorder paused their pen longer than usual. "Sheathing is also a move."{제자} repeated my words. The final education remained not in {제자}'s hands, but in words.
지령을 어긴 것부터 짚는다: Point out the violation of the directive first
당신은 지령서를 가리키고 어디가 달랐는지부터 설명했다. {제자}는 고개를: I pointed to the directive and started by explaining where it had differed. {제자} listened with their head bowed. I asked for the reason for their judgment afterward, and {제자} answered calmly. I could not find fault with it, but I did not retract the statement that rules come first. {제자} wrote both things in the report.
당신은 {제자}에게 지금까지 익힌 모든 동작을 순서대로 보이게 했다. 한: I made {제자} show me all the moves they had learned so far in order. They did not make a single mistake. The recorder left a mark on the paper for every move. When the final move ended, {제자} gasped and looked up at me. I nodded. It was not praise, but confirmation.
시연 도중 {제자}의 손목이 먼저 한계에 닿았다. 검이 빠졌고 {제자}는: During the demonstration, {제자}'s wrist reached its limit first. The sword slipped, and {제자} hid their hand with their sleeve. I stopped the demonstration and called out the reason for the interruption to the recorder myself. The final education remained as the shortest record.
기록원이 별관의 닫힌 방 문을 열었다. 오래된 문서가 여러 겹으로 쌓여: The recorder opened the door to a locked room in the annex. Old documents were stacked in multiple layers. The recorder unfolded the paper without asking as usual. Neither training nor missions were written there. The posture and hand shape of a being, and the traces of judgments recorded repeatedly, continued on every page. In the middle of the document was a name I had never seen before. Lethe. Below the name, instead of completion status, observation items were written. A familiar drawing caught my eye. It was the shape of {제자}'s hand that had been in the covered spot of the previous record. That hand had been transferred exactly to Lethe's item.
그림이 옮겨진 경위를 따진다: Question how the drawing was transferred
당신은 {제자}의 손 그림이 이곳에 있는 이유를 물었다. 기록원은 대답하: I asked why the drawing of {제자}'s hand was here. The recorder did not answer and pointed to the date. The same hand had been recorded every year since the first year. The recorder lowered their voice. "I need the hand from during the teaching." I could not grasp the meaning of those words all at once. The hand holding the document trembled once.
레테의 관찰 항목을 끝까지 읽는다: Read Lethe's observation items to the end
당신은 이름보다 반복되는 항목을 먼저 읽었다. 자세의 각도, 동작을 익히: I read the repeated items before the name. The angle of the posture, the time taken to learn the move, the pause before making a judgment. The record was following the process of learning, not the completed technique. On the last page, my habit of speech was transcribed. Sheathing is also a move. The words I had said to {제자} had been moved here for Lethe's share.
번호를 지우고 이름으로만 서명하겠다고 말한다: Say I will erase the number and sign only with the name
문서 앞에서 한 사람을 지킨다: Protect one person in front of the document
당신은 이 서명란에서 번호를 지우고 이름만 남기겠다고 말했다. 기록원은: I said I would erase the number from this signature line and leave only the name. The recorder could not answer. {제자} gasped beside me. It was the moment I decided to call a person by their name in a place where the document called a person by a number. Whether that was protection or another feeling, I could not distinguish either.
대부가 직접 별관의 방에 나타났다. 열쇠를 굴리는 손은 처음 만난 날과: The Godfather appeared in the annex room in person. The hand rolling the key was the same as the day we first met. They said it was a plan to gather the techniques and judgments of five fingers into one being. The previous method failed because it used people directly as materials, and this time, they said they would only record and transfer the changes that grow from the master-disciple relationship. A demand followed to show the demonstration one last time in front of Lethe. The statement that there was the freedom not to cooperate was written small in the margins of the document. There were two signature lines, and one was {제자}'s share.
사람을 재료로 쓰지 않는 선을 긋는다: Draw a line against using people as materials
당신은 {제자}를 직접 재료로 쓰는 절차를 제외하는 조건을 문서에 적었다: I wrote a condition in the document excluding the procedure of using {제자} directly as material. The Godfather read the condition and was silent for a long time. Then, they stopped the hand rolling the key and signed. "If the condition can be kept." Two signatures remained side by side on the document. Whether the condition would be kept was a matter for later.
당신은 서명란에 손을 대지 않았다. 대부는 열쇠를 안주머니에 넣고 말했다: I did not touch the signature line. The Godfather put the key in their inner pocket and said, "The way back is open." The gatekeeper opened the door but did not step aside. The refusal was recorded, and the recorder wrote the date. {제자}'s signature line was empty. Whether I had emptied it on their behalf or {제자} had emptied it could not be distinguished.
목적은 남기고 방식을 바꾼다: Keep the purpose but change the method
당신은 이전 방식의 실패를 하나씩 짚어 말했다. 대부는 끼어들지 않고 끝: I pointed out the failures of the previous method one by one. The Godfather did not interrupt and listened to the end. I spoke of the inconsistencies in the records, {제자}'s questions, and even the string left in the room. The Godfather set the key down on the table. "Take it." Whether that was consent or retreat was not written in the document. I took the key.
당신의 설득은 끝까지 읽혔지만 결정은 바뀌지 않았다. 대부는 열쇠를 거두: My persuasion was read to the end, but the decision did not change. The Godfather took back the key and shook their head. "Words are recorded." The cooperation condition remained as the original plan. I left the room without signing. Only the fact that I had persuaded them remained as a line in the record.
마지막 교육의 날이 되었다. 훈련실 한가운데에 검을 놓을 자리가 마련되었: The day of the final education arrived. A place to set the sword was prepared in the middle of the training hall, and Lethe was sitting in a chair. Their clothes were neat, and their hands were clean. When I set the sword down, Lethe's fingers folded slowly in the same shape. {제자} looked at me while holding the sword. "Was teaching me for my sake, or for this work?" The voice was small but did not waver. Lethe's overlapping voice repeated the same words in a low tone.

If it misses, ③~⑤ do not occur.
\"(2d6+3) × 3타\"는 괄호 안(주사위 2개를 굴려 3을 더한: "(2d6+3) × 3 hits" repeats the action in parentheses (roll 2 dice and add 3 damage) 3 separate times (repeating ②~⑤ 3 times). Both the accuracy roll and damage dice are rolled anew for each hit. Since targets with Bleed take damage per hit, cards with more hits deplete Bleed faster.
\"6d8\"은 8면체 주사위 6개를 굴려 합친다는 뜻이다. \"3d6\: "6d8" means rolling six 8-sided dice and summing them. "3d6" means three 6-sided dice. The first number is the quantity, the second is the number of sides. More dice result in values closer to the average, while more sides increase the range of outcomes. Cards without a specified side count use 6-sided dice.
The +2 in "2d4+2" is fixed damage added to the sum of the dice.
카드의 \"명중 +N\"은 그 카드의 명중 굴림에만 더해지는 값이다(마이: "Accuracy +N" on a card is added only to that card's accuracy roll (negative values make it easier to miss). "Roll Accuracy Twice" rolls the accuracy check twice and uses the higher result.
명중 굴림에 이겼을 때만 일어나는 효과다. 색이 있는 칩이 키워드이고,: Effects that trigger only when winning an accuracy roll. Colored chips represent keywords, and effects like "Bleed +2" are applied to the target by default. Effects with "Self" at the end (e.g., Poise +3 Self) are applied to you.
방어 카드의 \"회피 +N\"은 이번 라운드 상대의 명중 굴림에 맞서는: "Evasion +N" on a defense card is added to your value when opposing the opponent's accuracy roll this round. Shields are values that absorb damage before your HP. Buff cards do not deal damage but apply effects to you.
카드 이름 앞의 작은 표시다. 공격은 피해 주사위를 굴리는 카드, 회피는: Small icons before the card name. Attack cards roll damage dice, Evasion cards increase evasion for the round, Defense cards set up shields, Buff cards apply effects to you, and Debuff cards apply keywords to the opponent.
주사위 면이 아니라 4부터 10 사이의 값 중 하나가 같은 확률로 나온다: Means any value between 4 and 10 has an equal probability of occurring, rather than using dice sides.
"Cannot use consecutively" means the card cannot be played in the very next round. "Once per combat" means it can only be played once per battle. "After use, next round ○○" means the ○○ card is added to your hand in the round following the use of this card.
