소지 표식을 가진 채 손가락 조직원이 아닌 곳(사무소·협회·날개·무소속): If you hold a Mark and reside in a place that is not a Finger organization (Office, Association, Wing, Unaffiliated), a quiet person will make eye contact first.
하드 완주 보상 · 모든 엔딩의 정확한 조건이 열려 있습니다: Hard Mode Completion Reward · Exact conditions for all endings are unlocked.
Overall Balance: Currently considering adjustments to monsters and items (including effects).
테섭에서 시험 중인 새 시스템의 수치는 의견을 보고 조정하고, 본섭에 넣: Figures for new systems being tested on the test server will be adjusted based on feedback before deciding when to push to the main server.
Please report any inconveniences regarding auto-battle speed and visual settings.
가방: 화면 오른쪽 네모 칸(능력치·장비·카드·전리품)을 누르면 가방이: Bag: Press the square box on the right side of the screen (Stats, Gear, Cards, Loot) to open the bag.
카드 정리: 카드마다 종류(공격·디버프·버프·회피·방어)가 색으로 표시되: Card Management: Each card type (Attack, Debuff, Buff, Evasion, Defense) is color-coded and can be searched by type, keyword, or name.
출생 화면: 주사위와 함께 결과 이름이 굴러가고, \"출생 규칙\"에서: Birth Screen: Results roll alongside dice; the full table can be viewed in "Birth Rules."
덱 최대 12장: 남는 카드는 카드함에 두고 전투 밖에서 넣고 뺄 수 있: Max 12 Cards: Keep excess cards in the card box and swap them in or out outside of combat.
받을지 고르기: 보상 카드와 새 장비는 받을지 고르고, 장비는 지금 것과: Choose to accept: Choose whether to accept reward cards and new gear; compare gear with your current equipment before equipping or storing it. Gear will not be swapped secretly.
전용 책장: 정해진 카드팩으로만 싸우는 덱입니다. 덱이 고정되어 지우기·: Exclusive Pages: A deck that fights only with designated card packs. The deck is fixed, preventing deletion or movement, and new cards are purchased with money.
암시장 카드 상자: 가끔 열리고, 원하는 테마의 카드를 한 장 얻을 수: Black Market Card Box: Opens occasionally, allowing you to obtain one card of your desired theme.
Worldview Office: Offices matching your current grade will open.
내 사무소: 5급 이상 해결사는 직접 사무소를 차려 이름을 짓고, 3년마: My Office: Fixers of Grade 5 or higher can open their own office, name it, and receive referrals for specialized cards and gear every 3 years.
Fingers: Separate events, evaluations, and passives have been created for Thumb, Index, Middle, and Ring.
Color/Senior Seat Evaluation: You can challenge up to 3 times.
공방 거리: 공방을 이용하지 않고 쉬어 가며 정신력을 회복할 수 있습니다: Workshop Street: You can rest and recover Sanity without using the Workshop.
중반·후반 적: 세력별 일반 적과 보스가 크게 늘었습니다(약 3배). 후: Mid/Late-Game Enemies: The number of regular enemies and bosses for each faction has increased significantly (approx. 3x). Named enemies appear in the late game.
Enemy Traits: Each enemy now has traits such as Horde, Coward, Callous, or Regeneration.
격리 실패: 환상체는 이제 특수 사건으로만 나타납니다. 종류가 늘고 더: Containment Breach: Abnormality now only appear as special events. There are more types and they are stronger; you can choose to confront or hide.
A hidden route and 2 hidden origins have been added.
There are rumors that, very rarely, something unmanageable appears.
Find out where they are yourself.
Balance is still being adjusted, so values may change slightly in the future.
5버전에서 하던 \"이어서 하기\" 저장은 새 규칙과 맞지 않을 수 있어: "Continue" saves from version 5 may not be compatible with the new rules, so starting a new game is recommended.
사무소에 들어간 해결사가 1급에 올라도 승급 심사만 반복되고 특색 심사가: Fixed an issue where Fixers who joined an Office would only repeat promotion evaluations and never trigger Color evaluations even after reaching Grade 1. Performance calculations for promotions have been corrected and overall requirements slightly lowered.
카드를 받을 때 \"덱의 카드와 바꾼다\"로 뺄 수 없는 고정 카드를 카: Fixed an issue where fixed cards that could not be removed via "Swap with deck card" when receiving cards could be moved to the card box. Fixed cards already removed will return to the deck the following year.
단테의 노트·검지 단말기 배경에서 PC 화면 오른쪽의 가방 네모 칸(능력: Fixed an issue where the bag square (Stats, Gear, Cards, Loot) on the right side of the PC screen was not visible in the background of Dante's Note or Index Terminal.
PC 창이 좁을 때(약 900~1020px) 가방 칸이 본문을 가리던 문: Fixed an issue where the bag square would cover the main text when the PC window was narrow (approx. 900–1020px). At this width, the bag square now fits inside the top information area.
재능 \"타고난 완력\"과 성장기 \"어깨너머 손질\"의 \"피해 주사위: Fixed an issue where the "Damage Dice Minimum 2" effect from the "Natural Strength" talent and "Shoulder-to-Shoulder Maintenance" growth period was erased when equipping birth weapons during character creation. This applies to all turns where the effects were obtained but not applied.
두 효과는 이제 각각 \"피해 주사위 최소 +1\"입니다. 둘이 겹치면: Both effects are now "Damage Dice Minimum +1" each. If both overlap, they add up to +2, and they also add to the gear's damage minimum (e.g., Master's Greatsword 3). The total is capped at 4.
이미 진행 중인 판은 다음 해로 넘어갈 때 재능·성장기를 확인해 자동으로: Ongoing games will automatically reflect these changes to talents and growth periods when transitioning to the next year.
날개에서 무언가 일어나는 것 같습니다. 오래 살아남은 날개의 사람에게 낯: Something seems to be happening at the Wings. Those who have survived in a Wing for a long time might receive an unusual proposal.
소지의 얼굴을 한 사람들 사이에서도 이상한 소문이 돕니다. 한참 뒤에야: Strange rumors are circulating among those who share Soji's face. It is said that someone is waiting in a place that takes a long time to reach.
Check for yourself what kind of path it is and where it leads.
맞아야 강해지는 중지가 후반에 버티기 어렵다는 의견이 있어 서열 패시브를: Following feedback that the Middle, which grows stronger by being hit, is difficult to sustain in the late game, a hierarchy passive has been added.
중지의 세 번째 서열 이름이 \"형님\"에서 \"작은형님\"으로 바뀌었고: The name of the Middle's third rank has been changed from "Hyung-nim" to "Little Brother," and the "Grit" passive now reduces damage taken by 10%.
The Big Brother's "Super Grit" passive reduces damage taken by 30%.
속도의 영향이 커졌습니다. 선공 판정이 \"1d100 + 속도\"에서 \: The impact of Speed has increased. The initiative check has changed from "1d100 + Speed" to "1d100 + Speed×2".
The pursuit bonus for those who miss the initiative has been reduced from +10 to +5.
공격하는 쪽의 속도가 상대보다 5 높을 때마다 명중이 +1 오릅니다. 최: For every 5 points of Speed the attacker has over the opponent, Accuracy increases by +1. The maximum is +4, and the same rule applies to enemies.
정신력 보정 구간이 세분화되었습니다. 11 · 15 · 20 · 26 ·: Sanity bonus brackets have been refined. Poise and Evasion bonuses are applied in stages at 11, 15, 20, 26, 32, and 40+. The maximum bonus remains the same, and bonuses are now received at lower Sanity levels as well.
정신력이 20 · 25 · 30 · 35 · 40 · 45 이상일 때마다: Every time Sanity is 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, or 45+, all stats (Attack, Evasion, Speed, Max HP, Checks) increase by +1. At 45, it is +6.
E.G.O 개화 판정 난이도가 낮아졌습니다. 보정이 없을 때 개화 확률이: E.G.O manifestation check difficulty has been lowered. Without bonuses, the manifestation probability increases from approx. 14% to approx. 40%.
전투 중 자동으로 HP를 크게 회복하는 효과가 너무 강하다는 의견이 있어: Adjusted due to feedback that the effect of automatically recovering a large amount of HP during battle was too strong.
The price has been standardized to 5,000 Ahn. This remains the same even after Endless Mode.
지닐 수 있는 수는 그대로 최대 3개입니다. 한 판에 살 수 있는 수는: The maximum number you can carry remains 3. The number you can buy in a single turn is limited to 5.
The automatic recovery amount has been reduced from 60 to 50.
날개에서 해고되어도 날개를 세우는 길(특이점 개발)이 이어지던 문제를 고: Fixed an issue where the path to building a Wing (Singularity development) continued even after being fired from a Wing. If you lose a Wing, development stops.
직접 세운 날개의 대표가 소속이 비어 있으면 공방이 1등급으로 잠기고 해: Fixed an issue where if the representative of a self-built Wing had no affiliation, the Workshop would be locked at Grade 1 and they would be registered as a Fixer. Representatives receive the same Workshop grade as Wing executives and cannot also be a Fixer. Already registered saves will be cleaned up when moving to the next year.
Fixed an issue where rank and Fixer grade did not match in some hidden paths.
Thank you to everyone who provided feedback and reports.
Adjusted the stats and loot weapons of some late-game hidden bosses.
검은 침묵의 장갑이 주는 카드 Furioso가 크게 강해졌습니다. 주사위: The Furioso card granted by the Black Silence's gloves has been significantly buffed. All 9 dice are fixed at 3–14 with +30 Accuracy.
Singularity reinforcement is capped at 3 times; it will not increase further once filled.
금기 실험은 강화와 따로 최대 8번까지 할 수 있습니다. 8번을 채우면: Taboo experiments can be done up to 8 times, separately from reinforcement. Upon reaching 8, the Head sends Claws and an Arbiter; defeating them grants a reward. For those who have already defeated them, a tougher test that occasionally grants money and EXP without gear appears with each taboo experiment, and it is guaranteed on the 8th. Filling 8 times makes the Singularity 2 stages stronger (2nd reinforcement). Committing a taboo while married carries the risk of the spouse dying.
엄지의 \"상납 마감\"이 상석 대부에게도 나오던 문제를 고쳤습니다. 이: Fixed an issue where the Thumb's "Tribute Deadline" appeared for the Senior Godfather. It now only appears for Soldatos, while an event regarding responsibility for subordinates' shares appears for Capos and above.
홍원 가주의 자리에서 얻는 흑수 재갈이 카드와 전리품으로 지급되지 않던: Fixed an issue where the Black Water Gag obtained from the Hong-won Master's seat was not provided as a card or loot. Applies to new games started.
무한 모드(73년차 이후)에서 한 해가 지날 때마다 플레이어의 기본 회피: In Endless Mode (after Year 73), the player's base Evasion decreases by 1 each year (stops at 0). Evasion gained from gear, Sanity, etc., does not decrease and is displayed as "(Endless -N)" in the stat window.
Enemies gain +1 Accuracy bonus every 2 years.
한 전투에서 공격을 한 번 맞을 때마다, 맞은 쪽이 받는 피해가 3%씩: In a single battle, every time an attack is landed, the damage taken by the target increases by 3% (up to 2x). This applies equally to both the player and enemies and resets when the battle ends.
중지는 이 규칙이 다르게 적용됩니다. 회피를 쓰기 어려워 맞는 일이 많으: This rule applies differently to the Middle. Since they are hit often due to difficulty using Evasion, damage taken does not increase; instead, damage taken decreases by 1%p each time they are hit (accumulated within battle).
근성·초근성, 하나 협회의 곤, 출생·전리품 효과, 호위의 막아섬 등 받: Damage reduction from Grit/Super Grit, Hana Association's Gon, birth/loot effects, and Guarding, etc., is capped at a total of 70%. Even if the sum is higher, it remains 70%.
The rule where damage taken increases each time you are hit in battle has been changed to compound interest. Each time you are hit, the previous multiplier is multiplied by 3%; the player's damage can increase up to 4x, and the enemy's up to 30x. The longer the fight, the more fatal it is to be hit.
중지는 맞을 때마다 받는 피해가 1%p씩 줄어드는 규칙이 그대로이고, 이: The rule where the Middle's damage taken decreases by 1%p each time they are hit remains, and this cumulative reduction stops at 20%.
The maximum stack of Bleed the player can inflict on enemies has increased from 10 to 40. Bleed inflicted by enemies on the player remains at 10.
날개 대표에게 \"날개 채용 공고\", \"조직의 손짓\", \"협회 추: Fixed an issue where "Wing Recruitment Notice," "Organization's Gesture," and "Association Recommendation" appeared for Wing representatives. These events no longer appear for Wing representatives.
이미 1급인 해결사에게 \"급수 심사\"와 \"승급 추천\"이 나오던 문: Fixed an issue where "Grade Evaluation" and "Promotion Recommendation" appeared for Fixers who were already Grade 1. They now only appear for Grade 2 and below.
도서관을 이미 잡았거나 두 번째 초대장에 이미 답한 뒤에도 \"두 번째: Fixed an issue where the "Second Invitation" continued to appear even after the Library was already captured or the second invitation had already been answered, and nothing happened even after the end-of-year event was announced.
혈귀의 혈찬 회복량을 줄였습니다. 상대 출혈이 5번 발동할 때마다 HP: Reduced the Bloodfiend's Blood Cup recovery amount. It now recovers 8 HP instead of 15 HP every time the opponent's Bleed triggers 5 times. This adjustment aligns with the increased maximum Bleed stacks.
Hit Effects: Effects like slash, pierce, and impact appear when an attack lands. Can be set to Off, Light, Normal, or Strong in settings.
배경음악: ♪ 버튼으로 켜고 끕니다(기본은 꺼짐). 고요·불길·도서관 세: BGM: Toggle on/off with the ♪ button (default is off). There are three styles: Calm, Ominous, and Library, with separate battle tracks.
Sound Effects: Remade to distinguish between slash, pierce, and blunt sounds.
A new job, "Warp Train Cleanup Crew," has been added to W Corp.
There are exclusive weapons and pages for the Cleanup Crew.
흑수 루트가 추가되었습니다. 흑수 전용 카드와 무기가 있습니다. 어디서: The Black Water route has been added. Includes exclusive Black Water cards and weapons. Find out where it opens yourself.
One special event for the Bloodfiend race has been added.
공격 수치 규칙을 바꿨습니다. 공격 2당 명중 1, 공격 6당 피해 1이: Changed attack stat rules. Every 2 Attack grants 1 Accuracy, and every 6 Attack grants 1 Damage. Conversions can be viewed on the status screen.
Workshop Fixers start with exclusive gear and continuously strengthen it by melting down stored gear.
Early-game enemies have increased, and reasons for fighting have been added for each enemy.
Some hidden elements have been added/revamped. Find out where they are yourself.
기록실의 엔딩 힌트가 더 분명해졌습니다. 엔딩으로 이어지는 갈림길을 한: Ending hints in the Records Room have become clearer. Once you pass a fork leading to an ending, the introduction text for that ending changes to the exact conditions.
Fixed issues with proposal and marriage checks.
무한 모드에 전공 승급과 전용 사건이 추가되었습니다. 덜 본 사건이 먼저: Added major promotions and exclusive events to Endless Mode. Unseen events appear first, and repeated events now feature different text.
Removed the 90% Thumb text that remained in the description for those from the Bonyatelli family.
일부 문구를 다듬었습니다. (웃는 가로등 설명, 기록실 엔딩 힌트 표기): Refined some text (Laughing Lamp description, Records ending hint display).
Added reasons for fighting to about 40 types of enemies.
협회 직원도 \"본부 직속\"에 오르면 해결사 1급이 되고, 특색 심사를: Association staff can now become Grade 1 Fixers upon reaching "Headquarters Direct" status and can undergo separate Color trials.
무기 흡수(미미크리 등)의 횟수 제한을 전투당 5번에서 턴당 5번으로 바: Changed the usage limit for weapon absorption (e.g., Mimicry) from 5 times per battle to 5 times per turn.
배경 테마(단테·검지 단말기·도서관)의 보조 글자 색을 밝혀 읽기 쉽게: Brightened the secondary text color for background themes (Dante, Index Terminal, Library) for better readability.
자동 전투가 0코스트 버프 카드(방어막·명중 보정·빛 획득 등)를 쓰지: Fixed an issue where auto-battle would not use 0-cost buff cards (shields, accuracy boosts, Light gain, etc.).
Fixed an issue where the candidate's name appeared as {c} in the Black Water route.
Advanced the timing for meeting a partner to between age 27 and 40.
회복 카드(재생 조직 등)는 한 번 쓰면 몇 턴 동안 손패에 들어오지 않: Recovery cards (e.g., Regenerative Tissue) will not return to the hand for several turns after use. Fixed an issue where they were used every round when the deck was small.
Fixed the deployment description and lover text for those from the R Corp Hatchery.
아이폰 무음 모드에서 배경음악·효과음이 나지 않던 문제를 줄이는 수정을: Implemented a fix to reduce issues where BGM/SFX would not play in iPhone silent mode. (SFX now play even when animations are off.)
Adjusted Workshop Fixer balance. Re-calibrated base item stats.
전투 2번마다 랜덤 재료 아이템을 주는 기능이 제대로 동작하지 않던 버그: Fixed a bug where the feature that grants random material items every 2 battles was not working properly.
Added a section where stats increase significantly every 5 levels up to level 15. Subsequent infinite enhancements do not have 5-level bonuses.
공방 해결사가 전투를 두 번 이길 때마다 재료용 장비(무기·방어구·의수): Workshop Fixers now provide one material equipment (weapon, armor, prosthetic) every two battle victories. Fixed a bug where this reward did not appear in previous versions. In Endless Mode, it appears once every 5 years.
강화 15단계까지 5·10·15단계에서 크게 오르는 특수 강화를 추가했습: Added special enhancements that provide significant boosts at levels 5, 10, and 15. Subsequent infinite enhancements do not have 5-level bonuses.
의수도 강화할 수 있습니다. 5·10·15단계마다 공격·회피·명중 중 하: Prosthetics can now be enhanced. Choose one of Attack, Evasion, or Accuracy every 5, 10, and 15 levels.
Workshop Fixers can also open their own Office starting from Grade 5.
Removed equipment sales; instead, you can now sell up to 3 cards at once (300 Credits + 30 Credits per card cost).
재생 조직 등 회복 카드가 덱이 작을 때 매 라운드 손패에 들어오던 문제: Fixed an issue where recovery cards like Regenerative Tissue would enter the hand every round when the deck was small. They now stay out of the hand for several turns after use.
기록실의 \"아무것도 없이 시작해 결혼한 채 55년\" 엔딩 설명에서 앞: Fixed an issue where the beginning of the description for the "Start with nothing and stay married for 55 years" ending in the Records was cut off. Required birth choices are now displayed correctly.
협회 직원이 2급에서 더 오르지 못하던 문제를 고쳤습니다. 본부 직속에: Fixed an issue where Association staff could not promote beyond Grade 2. Upon reaching Headquarters Direct, they become Grade 1 and can undergo Color trials.
아이폰 무음 모드에서 배경음악·효과음이 나지 않던 문제를 줄이는 수정을: Implemented a fix to reduce issues where BGM/SFX would not play in iPhone silent mode. SFX now play even when animations are off.
Fixed an issue where Workshop Fixers could not open an Office starting from Grade 5.
문구를 다듬었습니다. (웃는 가로등, 승급 추천·급수 심사, R사 연인: Refined text (Laughing Lamp, promotion recommendations/grade evaluations, R Corp lover text).
무기 주사위가 카드 주사위를 덮어쓰던 문제를 고쳤습니다. 이제 카드 주사: Fixed an issue where weapon dice would overwrite card dice. They are now added to card dice.
가방의 \"정보\" 칸이 길어서, 항해 기록 · 성장기 · 태어났을 때의: The "Information" section in the bag is now collapsible for Voyage Records, Growth Periods, and Birth Stats. The open/closed state is maintained.
전투 판정에서 주사위 눈 아래에 명중·회피를 올린 요소(버프 +)와 깎은: In combat checks, the sum of factors increasing (buff +) or decreasing (debuff −) Accuracy/Evasion is displayed below the dice roll. Long-press the line (or hover with a mouse on PC) to view details.
한 번에 굴리는 피해 주사위가 많아도 화면 밖으로 넘치지 않고 줄바꿈됩니: Damage dice now wrap to the next line instead of overflowing the screen when many are rolled at once.
Added a compendium for special equipment and exclusive card packs to the Records.
Adjusted weapons and pages for some hidden bosses.
Check results are now displayed even when animations are turned off.
Fixed errors related to card packs.
BGM이 변경 및 추가됩니다. 불길이 새 곡으로 변경되고, 물결이 추가됩: BGM changed and added. "Omen" changed to a new track, and "Waves" has been added.
Added Sinking to the specializations for My Office.
Adjusted Workshop Fixer equipment enhancements and artifacts.
Adjusted the starting affiliation for those Chosen by the Star.
기록실의 특수 장비 칸이 제자리에 표시되어 어디쯤의 장비인지 짐작할 수: Special equipment slots in the Records are now displayed in their proper place, making it easier to gauge the equipment's tier.
You can now fold and unfold each section title in the Records.
Adjusted equipment and difficulty for some hidden bosses.
Adjusted appearance conditions and text for some hidden bosses.
Fixed an issue where check animations would replay during unrelated events.
결과 화면에서 세상을 떠난 아이가 살아 있는 것처럼 보이던 문제가 수정됩: Fixed an issue where a deceased child would appear alive on the results screen.
Fixed an issue where volume controls were obscured on PC.
의수 칸이 보조 장비 칸으로 바뀌고, 의복·지팡이·단말기·계약서·장치가: Prosthetic slots changed to Auxiliary Equipment slots; added clothing, staves, terminals, contracts, and devices to the Workshop.
Each affiliation provides standard-issue equipment, which disappears upon leaving the affiliation.
The Index and Kurokumo Clan receive tattoos, while N Corp receives enhancement procedures.
You can now choose the type of Color-exclusive equipment.
Added a story about creating works for the Thumb to submit to an appraisal.
New connections are now available for those with the Thumb mark.
Added an event for those whose promotions are blocked in the Outskirts.
Adjusted Ampule values for Workshop Fixers and added events to earn money.
Reinforced connection hints in the Records.
장인·명장 공방 장비와 암시장 장비가 조정되고, 명장의 공방에 4등급 보: Adjusted Artisan/Master Workshop equipment and Black Market equipment; added Grade 4 auxiliary equipment to the Master's Workshop.
공방 해결사에 특수 강화와, 장비를 사자마자 재료로 쓰는 기능이 추가됩니: Added special enhancements to Workshop Fixers and the ability to use equipment as materials immediately upon purchase.
The Thumb must go through the artwork story to become a Maestro.
In Endless Mode, you cannot join new affiliations or change jobs.
In Endless Mode, the text that appears at the top now only appears once every 100 years.
Some standard-issue equipment and N Corp enhancement procedures have been buffed.
해금 출생이 늘어납니다. 까마귀팀 복제체 · 신탁대행자 헤르메스 · 도서: Increased number of unlockable births. Raven Team Clone, Oracle Hermes, Library Librarian, Claw of the Head, Arbiter, and G Corp Weapon origins now have their own stories and endings.
해금 출생마다 이어 살아갈 이유가 생겨, 엔딩 뒤에도 무한 모드로 계속할: Each unlockable birth now has a reason to continue living, allowing you to continue in Endless Mode after the ending.
Added exclusive connections for some unlockable births.
Growth stories continue for each birth, and a departure scene appears in the first year.
Added category tabs to the Records, and descriptions are now displayed vertically.
하드 모드로 이야기를 끝내면 엔딩·칭호·인연의 정확한 조건과 히든 상대의: Completing the story in Hard Mode unlocks a guide that reveals the exact conditions for endings, titles, connections, and the locations of hidden opponents.
Cleaned up basic ending hint text.
혈귀가 시작할 때 피로 만든 무기를 고를 수 있고, 이긴 횟수에 따라 무: Bloodfiends can choose a weapon made of blood at the start, which grows stronger in stages based on the number of victories.
In Endless Mode, you can use money to engrave effects onto equipment.
소속 서열이 오를수록 공격 카드가 강해집니다. (엄지·검지·중지·약지·소: Attack cards grow stronger as your affiliation rank increases (Thumb, Index, Middle, Ring, Little, Kurokumo Clan, Blade Lineage, Night's Awl).
Buffed Blade Lineage and Night's Awl.
Reduced promotion requirements for the Middle.
Some jobs moved to unlockable births, and starting bonuses adjusted.
Refined text and repetitive expressions in growth stories.
Fixed an issue where the Haegeum origin would not appear due to conflicting disposal requests.
나이 100부터 50해마다 제약 3개 중 하나를 받고, 이어서 버프 3개: Starting at age 100, you receive one of three constraints every 50 years, followed by choosing one of three buffs. There are 6 types of constraints and 7 types of buffs, and the same type can stack up to 5 times.
The rule where Evasion decreased every year in Endless Mode has been removed.
Applied constraints and buffs are now displayed on the ending screen and saved images.
The momentum mechanic, where damage dealt increases as the battle drags on, remains unchanged.
엔딩 화면의 저장이 「엔딩 그대로 저장」과 「정리해서 저장」으로 나뉩니다: Saving the ending screen is now split into "Save Ending As Is" and "Save Organized." Save Organized compiles summary cards, stats, battle records, constraints, buffs, and your deck into a single image.
검지 단말기 · 도서관 초대장 · 단테의 노트 테마에 맞는 모양으로 저장: Images are saved in a style matching the Index Terminal, Library Invitation, or Dante's Note themes. Fixed an issue where the background of saved images would appear white in the Terminal theme.
A brief story of your growth period is now added to the ending history.
가방의 「정보」 탭에 「흡수한 능력치」 칸이 생겼습니다. 장비를 먹어 오: An "Absorbed Stats" section has been added to the "Info" tab in your bag. You can view the total stats gained from consuming equipment and a list of consumed items.
Added bonuses for consuming Hidden-grade equipment and subsequent growth.
무한 모드에서 일부 출신은 나이 100을 넘긴 뒤 가족의 죽음 앞에서 새: In Endless Mode, some origins now have new choices when facing the death of a family member after age 100. As this is a temporarily applied system, text and conditions may change.
Clicking the BGM button now expands the track list for quick selection.
기록실의 칭호 힌트 6개에 정확한 조건이 추가되고, 하드로 완주하면 해금: Accurate conditions have been added to 6 title hints in Records, and completing a Hard run will reveal the specific conditions for the Haegeum origin.
The "Deep Breath" growth trait now appears only 4 times per run.
Cleaned up the names of Hermes-exclusive cards.
Cleaned up entries that could not be encountered in the Records opponent list and reduced file size.
엔딩 행적이 플레이 중의 선택으로 엮입니다. 승급·특색 시험의 낙방과 통: Ending history is now woven together by your choices during gameplay. Promotions, Color Trial results, relationship encounters, marriage proposals, marriage, bereavement, titles, and victories against famous opponents are summarized chronologically. For the Great Lake, the initial escape from the waves and the eventual whale hunt are now linked.
휴대폰 출생 화면에서 해금 출생이나 직업을 누르면 맨 위로 올라가 굴림을: On the mobile origin screen, clicking the Haegeum origin or occupation scrolls to the top to view the rolls immediately, and the Reroll and Start buttons are fixed at the bottom of the screen.
가족의 죽음 앞 선택지가 홍원의 가주가 된 경우에만 열리도록 정리했습니다: The choice regarding the death of a family member is now restricted to cases where you have become the Head of the Hongwon.
보관함에서 장착할 수 없는 장비의 설명이 세로로 짜부라지던 표시, 기록실: Fixed issues where descriptions for unequipable gear in the storage would appear vertically compressed, inconsistent display positions in the Records Haegeum list, and incorrect text when a child's occupation info was missing.
접속 속도: 배경음악 mp3를 따로 불러옵니다. 음악 파일을 받지 못하면: Connection speed: BGM mp3 files are now loaded separately. If music files fail to download, a prompt to "Refresh" will appear.
공방·암시장 비교 줄: 물건 목록과 구매 확인 창에서 지금 끼고 있는 장: Workshop/Black Market comparison lines: Shows the stat difference compared to currently equipped gear in the item list and purchase confirmation window.
R사 순록팀 카드 개편: 3코스트 버프를 받아치는 회피 카드로 바꿨습니다: R Corp. Reindeer Team card rework: Changed the 3-cost buff into an Evasion card that counters. Two other Reindeer Team cards have also been adjusted.
영생 동행(일부): 가족 죽음 앞에서 ??? 따르면 판이 끝나지 않고 가: Eternal Companionship (Partial): If you follow ??? when facing the death of a family member, the run does not end, and the family member gains eternal life to remain by your side. The guide text for this choice has been made less explicit.
G Corp. Weaponry consumption adjustment: Prevented copying max HP using cheap equipment. The amount gained is now determined by equipment grade and type, and the gain is previewed before consumption.
행적 일지 확대(일부): 엔딩에 시험, 인연, 결혼, 아이, 대호수의 고: History Log expansion (Partial): Trials, relationships, marriage, children, and the Great Lake's waves and whales are now woven into the ending log, and sentence errors have been fixed.
일대기·명예의 전당: 펼쳐 보기에서 \"정리해서 저장 · 공유\"가 됩니: Biography/Hall of Fame: "Save Organized/Share" is now available in the expanded view.
화면 오류 수정: 해금 출생 목록의 표시 정렬, 보관함 안내가 길게 늘어: Screen error fixes: Fixed alignment in the Haegeum origin list, storage guide text stretching, child occupation displaying as 'undefined', and G Corp. Weaponry receiving the "Forbidden Illusion" choice during family death.
엄지 \"예의를 지킬 것\"의 명중 감소가 전투 화면에서 잘못 표시되던: Fixed an issue where the accuracy reduction for Thumb's "Observe Etiquette" was displayed incorrectly on the battle screen.
\"붉은 밤의 초대\"로 혈귀가 된 경우에도 가족의 죽음 앞에 \"강물에: "Offer Name to the River" now appears upon the death of a family member even if you have become a Bloodfiend through "Invitation of the Red Night."
부화장 히든 보스에게 받은 \"나는 존재한다\"를 부화장 출신이 아니면: "I Exist," received from the Hatchery hidden boss, can now be removed from the deck if you are not from the Hatchery.
해결사가 사무소에 들어가거나 자기 사무소를 열 수 있습니다. 사무소는 1: Fixers can now join an office or open their own. There are 12 offices, and office rank increases by hiring and training staff.
직원마다 신뢰가 있고, 직원 이벤트에서 고른 선택에 따라 신뢰와 자산이: Each staff member has a trust level, and choices made during staff events affect trust and assets. Money is displayed as -(red) for expenses and +(green) for income.
다른 사무소로 옮기는 \"이직\"과 사무소에서 쌓는 \"평판\"이 생겼습: Added "Job Change" to move to other offices and "Reputation" earned within an office. Moving reduces reputation, and low reputation increases equipment costs.
직원은 호위·정보·전투·의뢰 전문해결사 네 종류입니다. 직원이 최대 단계: Staff members come in four types: Escort, Intelligence, Combat, and Request-specialized Fixers. Once a staff member reaches max level and consistently completes requests, they can take the "Color Trial." Passing grants a Color name like "Red Butterfly" and a unique ability matching that name.
An "Office" tab has been added to the bag.
After closing a Rift, you can choose whether to enter a "Place Where Time Has Gone Awry." Entering advances time in 25-year increments.
25해마다 가속 없이 지냈을 때의 40~70% 정도의 성장을 한꺼번에 받: Every 25 years, you receive roughly 40–70% of the growth you would have had without acceleration, and a summary of assets, materials, and office changes accumulated during that time is displayed.
\"변화\": 변화의 파편(스텝마다 5개)으로 낀 장비의 깡스탯을 확률로: "Change": Use Fragments of Change (5 per step) to increase the base stats of equipped gear by chance. Costs start at 1 per item and increase with each upgrade; using it on different gear resets the cost to 1. Lower-grade gear has a higher chance of significant increases.
가속 중 100해마다 \"세월의 풍경\"이 나옵니다. 도시가 변해 가는: During acceleration, "Scenery of Time" appears every 100 years. It shows the changing state of the City and a line matching your origin and path.
소속·출생·직업·사무소 등에 맞는 심볼 55종이 생겼습니다. 이야기(2막: 55 types of symbols matching affiliations, origins, occupations, and offices have been added. They are obtained based on the affiliation/origin of a run that completed the story (Act 2), and collected symbols can be viewed in the "Symbol" section of the Records. Unobtained symbols are hidden as black squares.
꾸미기에서 이름 앞 모양으로 심볼을 달 수 있습니다. 목록은 크기가 고정: In customization, you can attach symbols as icons before your name. The list has been changed to a fixed-size grid; if there are many, you can scroll through them and adjust the window height.
심볼을 25%·50%·100% 모으면 꾸미기 모양이 열립니다. 이미지로: Collecting 25%, 50%, and 100% of symbols unlocks customization icons. 6 types of image-based battle card borders have been added, unlocked via titles, endings, and symbol collection.
공방 해결사: 재료로 강화하거나 의수 종류를 바꿀 때 전용 장비의 인챈트: Workshop Fixers: Fixed an issue where enchantments on exclusive gear would disappear when reinforcing with materials or changing prosthetic types.
Cleaned up the backgrounds on the sides of the PC start screen.
일본어 번역: 새 내용을 번역해 넣었습니다. 아직 완벽하지 않고 Gemi: Japanese translation: New content has been translated. It is not yet perfect and was refined twice (Gemini → Claude), so some words may be missing or awkward.
테섭 안내: 사무소·가속·변화의 수치는 측정 중입니다. 쓰면서 느낀 점을: Test Server Notice: Values for Offices, Acceleration, and Change are currently being measured. Please report your feedback via "Feedback/Bug Report."
이 공지는 업데이트 이후 처음 새로 고침한 분께 한 번만 표시됩니다. 확: This notice is displayed only once to those who refresh after the update. Once confirmed, it will not reappear and can be viewed again under "This Update" on the main screen.
연출 강도 차이가 나지 않던 것 수정: Fixed an issue where there was no difference in visual intensity.
세이브 불러오기 시 해금 목록이 바로 적용되지 않던 문제 수정: Fixed an issue where the Haegeum list was not immediately applied when loading a save.
공방 해결사 보조 장비 종류 선택 · 강화 개편: Reworked Workshop Fixer auxiliary equipment selection and reinforcement.
R사 팀별 시작 무기 변경: Changed starting weapons for each R Corp. team.
호흡이 최대치를 넘어 쌓이던 버그 수정: Fixed a bug where Poise would stack beyond the maximum.
보호막이 최대치를 넘은 상태에서 카드로 보호막을 얻으면 줄어들던 버그 수: Fixed a bug where shields would decrease if gained via cards while already at maximum.
1000해 달성 이후 불순물 너프: Nerfed Impuritas Civitatis after reaching 1000 years.
무기와 보조 장비로 부여할 수 있는 키워드량을 정리했습니다. 한 키워드당: Standardized the amount of keywords that can be applied by weapons and auxiliary equipment. Each keyword can be applied up to 5 times per round by weapons and 5 times by auxiliary equipment, for a maximum of 10 combined.
공방 해결사 지팡이의 집중 키워드는 이 제한을 받지 않습니다. 강화 단계: The Workshop Fixer Staff's Focus keyword is exempt from this limit. The maximum stackable amount increases as the reinforcement level rises.
Added the above limitation to the rule summary, as it was previously missing.
카드 보상을 받을 때 함께 주는 돈을 500안에서 200안으로 조정했습니: Adjusted the money given with card rewards from 500 Ahn to 200 Ahn.
Rupture applied by weapons now grants up to 5 per hit instead of a round limit. This fixes the issue where Rupture was difficult to stack high due to rapid consumption. The maximum stack limit remains the same.
흑운회 전용 카드 흑운도를 낼 수 없던 문제를 고쳤습니다. 이제 구름이: Fixed an issue where Kurokumo Clan-exclusive card "Kurokumo Blade" could not be played. It can now be used if Cloud is 3 or higher; if Cloud is insufficient when it is time to play, it will misfire (previous cards will fill the Cloud).
The Cloud required for a card to take effect is now displayed on the card.
상대 HP 조건이 있는 카드(내부 숙청 · 처형 선고)를 낼 수 없을 때: When a card with an opponent HP condition (Internal Purge, Execution Sentence) cannot be played, the reason is now displayed on the card.
검계·흑운회 보상 패치: 흑운도 강화, 육참·골단 조정, 폭발·반격 배율: Blade Lineage/Kurokumo Clan reward patch: Kurokumo Blade buff, Flesh/Bone adjustments, and fixed display of Explosion/Counter multipliers.
Today's seed is changed to a combination of special origins and innate traits until November 5th. There are days when two innate traits appear together.
Adjusted the difficulty of Blue Reverberation.
Slightly increased the visibility of the "Equipment Prohibited" status.
Adjusted the personalities and speech patterns of relationship characters and increased route-specific exclusive events.
무한 모드 성장(주는 피해·일격·받는 피해·연륜)을 가방의 \"정보\": Endless Mode growth (Damage Dealt, Single Strike, Damage Taken, Seniority) can now always be viewed in the "Info" tab of your Bag. Added an explanation for Seniority to the Rules Summary.
한계 돌파의 공격 선택지가 눌리지 않던 문제를 고쳤습니다. 일격 설명 문: Fixed an issue where the attack selection for Limit Break could not be clicked. Clarified the description text for Single Strike.
새로운 이야기에서 싸우기로 하면 다음 해로 미루지 않고 바로 전투가 시작: Choosing to fight in a New Story will now start the battle immediately instead of postponing it to the next year.
Reduced the frequency of previously defeated opponents reappearing in Endless Mode.
Combined the Fragment and Residue rewards received after defeating Impurities into a single line.
Fixed an issue where the Sanity bar fill was not visible.
엔딩 이미지에서 같은 히든 보스가 반복해 찍히거나 카드 장수가 줄바꿈되던: Fixed an issue where the same hidden boss would appear repeatedly in the ending image or card counts would wrap to a new line.
Renamed the first tab of the Bag from "Birth" to "Info".
공방 거리의 \"소지품\"에서 붕대·간식·진정제를 살 수 있습니다. 종류: You can purchase Bandages, Snacks, and Sedatives at "Belongings" in Workshop Street. You can carry up to 3 of each type.
소모품은 가방의 \"소모품\" 칸에 들어가고, 전투 중에도 쓸 수 있습니: Consumables are stored in the "Consumables" tab of your Bag and can be used during battle.
The price increases by 100 Ahn every 10 years, up to a maximum of 5,000 Ahn.
인연이 있으면 전투를 이긴 뒤 가끔 도시락을 받아 HP와 정신력을 회복합: If you have a Bond, you may occasionally receive a Lunchbox after winning a battle to restore HP and Sanity.
새로운 이야기가 하나 추가되었습니다. 오늘의 시드에서 만나 볼 수 있습니: A new story has been added. You can encounter it in today's Seed.
Shared links have been shortened. Long records will now be shared via much shorter URLs.
Added "Disable Endless Mode Text" to Settings.
Cleaned up the hidden birth screen and the "Place of Birth" display.
Fixed an issue where passive effects from card packs would persist even after changing packs.
무한 모드의 회피 표시가 \"무한 −N · 0에서 멈춤\"으로 바뀌었습니: The evasion display in Endless Mode has been changed to "Infinite −N · Stops at 0".
Fixed issues related to Hongwon affiliation locking and prosthetic limb materials in the Workshop.
Changed the R Corp team deployment rules and the Hatchery team selection.
Fixed a display issue where Charge and Sinking stacks would disappear during battle animations.
Fixed an issue where the Overflow ending text was displayed incorrectly.
창이 전체화면이 아닐 때 오른쪽 가방 칸이 위쪽 옵션 버튼을 가리던 문제: Fixed an issue where the right-side Bag tab would obscure the top option buttons when the window was not in full-screen mode.
「붉은 밤의 초대」가 나오는 조건을 정리했고, 선택지에 얻는 것과 치르는: Clarified the conditions for "Invitation of the Red Night" and detailed the costs and rewards in the choices.
Blood Charm is now displayed in the passive slot.
Fixed issues with Bond and child settings when becoming a Bloodfiend through an invitation.
In the card screen, you can now group identical cards as ×N and sort them.
"Reason for Fighting" is now applied to more enemies.
별에 선택받은 자가 무기를 강화할 때 처음 가진 \"맨손\"이 재료로 뜨: Fixed an issue where the initial "Bare Hands" weapon would appear as a material when a Star-Chosen One upgraded their weapon. Bare Hands will no longer remain in the storage.
출생 화면의 \"다시 태어난다\"가 다시 굴릴 때마다 위쪽 내용 높이가: Fixed an issue where the "Reborn" button on the birth screen would shift position as the content height changed during rerolls. It is now fixed in place.
제 1막 종료 화면에 \"여기서 끝낸다\" 버튼을 넣었습니다. 제 2막으: Added an "End Here" button to the Act 1 end screen. You can end the run without proceeding to Act 2, which will erase the save for this run. Pressing "Reborn" will also immediately erase the previous save.
Fixed an issue where the title of the settings popup appeared split vertically.
PC 화면(폭 900px 이상)에서 본문, 왼쪽 능력치 칸, 오른쪽 가방: On PC screens (900px width or more), the main text, left stats panel, right bag panel, buttons, and popups have been scaled up. They grow larger as the window widens, and the scale decreases if the window height is low to prevent clipping. The initial screen and mobile view remain unchanged.
금기 실험으로 찾아오는 \"강화체\"의 이름을 \"발톱 · 재시험\",: Renamed the "Reinforced Entities" encountered during Forbidden Experiments to "Claw · Retest" and "Arbiter · Retest".
무한 모드 불순물의 최대 HP 상한을 1000만에서 1500만으로 늘렸습: Increased the maximum HP cap for Endless Mode Impurities from 10 million to 15 million.
특이점 루트에서 금기 실험 8/8을 채워도 아무 일도 일어나지 않던 문제: Fixed an issue where nothing happened even after completing 8/8 Forbidden Experiments on the Singularity route. Saves already stuck in this state will proceed when moving to the next year.
Fixed an issue where trade events with Soji would trigger incorrectly in some births.
배경음악에서 \"타탁\" 하는 잡음과 이어폰에서 들리던 떨림을 줄였습니다: Reduced the "crackle" noise in background music and the trembling sound heard in earphones.

They now appear directly in the birth roll, and your Talents, Flaws, and Growth Period are determined accordingly.
\"어떤 출생 보정도 없이 시작한다\"를 고르면 운명 선택 없이 아무것도: Selecting "Start without any birth bonuses" begins the game as Nothingness without a Fate choice. Instead, you receive the Empty-Handed bonus (+25%p chance for hidden boss loot equipment, 25% chance to see an E.G.O manifestation when Sanity breaks).
카드 보상 화면에서 카드마다 이미 가진 장수(보유 ×N)나 새 카드 표시: The card reward screen now displays the number of copies you already own (Owned ×N) or marks new cards, and you can expand your current deck and card storage to view them.
가방의 카드 목록에서 키워드 필터를 누르면 그 색으로 채워지고 ✓가 붙어: In the Bag's card list, clicking the keyword filter fills it with that color and adds a ✓, making it easy to see if it is active.
2막·무한 모드에서 공방 거리의 \"다음 기회\"가 55년차로 잘못 나오: Fixed an issue in Act 2/Endless Mode where "Next Opportunity" at Workshop Street was incorrectly displayed as Year 55.

Every 2 years after Distorting, there is a 40% chance that "Distortion Subsides." Once stabilized, you can use your equipment and card packs again and receive a "Strengthened Distorted Card Pack" containing stronger cards that manipulate Distortion. Inflated stats remain.
선택지 이름이 \"정신을 붙잡는다\" · \"나는 나로서 새로운 모습을: Choice names have been changed to "Hold onto your sanity" and "I accept this new form as myself."
엄지의 서열 이름 \"소토카포\"를 \"언더보스\"로 바꿨습니다. 솔다토: Renamed the Thumb rank "Sottocapo" to "Underboss." The order is Soldato → Capo → Underboss → Godmother/Godfather. It is the rank directly above Capo.
후반의 어떤 보스를 쓰러뜨린 뒤에는 공방 장비 정비 횟수가 장비마다 10: After defeating certain late-game bosses, the number of Workshop equipment maintenance slots increases by 10 for each piece of equipment. Equipment provided by those bosses can only be maintained for the base number of times. Increased the stats of some late-game bosses.
가방에 \"카드팩\" 탭이 생겼습니다. 기본 4장으로 시작하는 기본 카드: A "Card Pack" tab has been added to the Bag. It stores 3 basic card packs starting with 4 cards each (which can be renamed) and your Origin card pack. You can swap them without limit outside of battle, but not during battle.
전용 카드팩을 받아 덱이 통째로 바뀌어도 이전 덱이 보관함에 남아, 실수: Even if your entire deck is replaced by receiving an exclusive card pack, the previous deck remains in storage, allowing you to revert if you swapped by mistake.
출신 보정 카드는 출신 카드팩에만, 의수·승진·궁니르 같은 소속 카드는: Origin-specific cards only go into the Origin card pack, while affiliation cards like Prosthetics, Promotion, or Gungnir only go into their respective packs. Fixed cards like E.G.O follow you in all packs.
보상 카드는 편집할 수 있는 모든 팩(기본 카드팩 3개, 고정 없는 출신: Reward cards are copied to all editable packs (the 3 basic packs and Origin packs without fixed cards). While using an exclusive card pack or a fixed deck, you receive money and cards, which are then stored in your basic card packs.
\"?\" 설명 창: 전투 중에도 카드 읽는 법, 키워드(최대 스택 포함: "?" Help Window: You can view how to read cards, keywords (including max stacks), and rules even during battle.
일대기·명예의 전당, 기록실 판 통계, 오늘의 시드 도전 기록, 첫 화면: Added buttons for Biography/Hall of Fame, Record Room statistics, Today's Seed challenge records, and returning to the title screen.
Hongwon: The Black Sword card obtained via Gag is now granted, and the Black Sword card has been significantly buffed. Soji's "Holy Sword" is now a piece of loot (passive) rather than a weapon. The dice for Bloom · Single Strike have been increased to 6.
같은 시드면 해금 상태와 상관없이 같은 타고난 것이 나옵니다. 지난 날: The same Seed will yield the same Innate Traits regardless of unlock status. Manually entering a past Today's Seed number will apply that day's designations.
\"균열이 닫혔다\" 엔딩 뒤에는 균열 고정 피해가 없고 적 공격 상한이: After the "The Rift Has Closed" ending, there is no fixed Rift damage, and the enemy attack cap is increased. The "Superior's Test" no longer appears for the highest-ranking Thumb members, and the Servant's Shield protection has been reduced from 6 to 3.
공방 거리에 치유소가 생겼습니다. 500안을 내면 HP 30을 회복합니다: An infirmary has been added to Workshop Street. Paying 500 Ahn restores 30 HP. You can receive this up to 3 times per visit.
K사 엠플을 공방에서 살 수 있습니다. 3,500안, 최대 3개까지 지닙: K Corp Ampules can be purchased at the Workshop for 3,500 Ahn; you can carry up to 3.
They are used automatically when HP drops to 30 or below during battle, restoring 60 HP. Only 1 can be used per battle, and it can be repurchased at the next Workshop. After Endless Mode, the price increases to 20,000 Ahn.
날개 입사와 협회 입회 때 들어갈 곳을 직접 고릅니다. 날개 6곳, 협회: When joining a Wing or an Association, you now choose your specific branch. You can choose from 6 Wings and 8 Associations.
사무소 견습에 성공하면 초반 사무소 4곳(윤 · 가로등 · 갈고리 · 새: Upon successfully completing an Office apprenticeship, you choose from 4 early-game offices (Yoon, Streetlight, Hook, Dawn). If you fail, you are randomly assigned to either Yoon Office or Streetlight Office.
초반 사무소 4곳은 해결사 급수와 상관없이 갈림길과 \"사무소 문을 두드: The 4 early-game offices can be chosen at crossroads and "Knock on the Office Door" regardless of your Fixer grade.
전용 책장이 없는 K사 · J사 · G사 날개는 카드팩 대신 입사 때 보: Wings without exclusive pages (K Corp, J Corp, G Corp) receive additional bonuses upon joining instead of a card pack. Decks are built using general cards.
타이틀과 출생을 제외한 모든 화면의 오른쪽 위에 설정 버튼(⚙)이 생겼습: A settings button (⚙) has been added to the top right of all screens except the Title and Birth screens. You can change animation and battle intervals from any screen. Opening it during auto-battle pauses the fight; closing it resumes it.
자동 전투 간격이 느림 · 보통 · 조금 빠름 · 빠름 네 단계가 되었습: Auto-battle intervals now have four stages: Slow, Normal, Slightly Fast, and Fast. Normal has been made slower than before.
The maximum stack for Rupture has been increased from 10 to 20. Bleed remains unchanged.
Added 5 Burn cards to the Liu Association exclusive cards.
From Year 8 onwards, you can meet Bonds in daily life. You choose their name. If you pass them by when you meet, the Bond will not appear for that run.
인연이 이어지면 청혼까지 사건이 오고, 결혼하면 보정을 받습니다. 결혼: If a Bond continues, an event for a proposal will occur; marriage provides bonuses. If you miss the chance before marriage, the partner will leave.
결혼 뒤에는 배우자의 죽음이 올 수 있습니다. 금기를 저지르면 그다음 해: After marriage, the death of a spouse may occur. If you commit a taboo, a 2% risk arises each year starting the following year, and the risk increases by 0.1% each time you defeat a hidden boss.
결혼 뒤에는 아이가 태어납니다. 아이는 함께 나이를 먹다가 20세에 사무: After marriage, a child may be born. The child ages with you and enters an Office, becomes a Fixer, or joins an Association at age 20. The spouse's grade also increases based on the years of marriage, and if you fail a Color trial or highest-rank promotion exam, the spouse will promote in your stead.
뒤틀린 뒤에는 가장 강한 가족(배우자 또는 아이)이 토벌 의뢰로 찾아옵니: After Distorting, your strongest family member (spouse or child) will come to hunt you down. The family member uses your cards, with stats 1.1x your own and a maximum grade 1.5x your own.
If you have a child, additional text is added to every ending.
3년차부터 능력치가 오르는 안정적인 일상 사건이 열립니다. 한 판에 최대: Starting from Year 3, stable daily events that increase stats become available. Up to 10 times per run.
⚡ 충전 · W사 날개 / R사 날개: ⚡ Charge · W Corp Wing / R Corp Wing
입사하면 충전 전용 책장 8장을 받고, 최고 직급에 오르면 4코스트 카드: Upon joining, you receive 8 Charge-exclusive pages, and upon reaching the highest rank, you gain 2 4-cost cards for a total of 10.
Charge is a resource that can be accumulated and consumed by cards to deal fixed damage.
W사 날개는 라운드마다 충전이 쌓이는 저장형입니다. 맞아도 충전이 줄지: W Corp Wing is a storage type where Charge accumulates every round. It does not decrease when hit.
R사 날개는 입사 때 1d3으로 토끼팀, 순록팀, 코뿔소팀이 정해지고,: R Corp Wing assigns you to the Rabbit, Reindeer, or Rhino team via 1d3 upon joining, with different exclusive pages and passives for each team.
🔨 N사 날개 · 못과 흐트러짐: 🔨 N Corp Wing · Nails and Stagger
N사 날개는 적중할 때마다 상대에게 못이 쌓입니다. 3코스트·4코스트 망: N Corp Wing accumulates Nails on the opponent with every hit. 3-cost and 4-cost Hammer cards convert accumulated Nails into Stagger.
흐트러짐이 쌓일수록 상대가 약해집니다. 3 · 6 · 10에서 단계가 오: As Stagger accumulates, the opponent weakens. Stages increase at 3, 6, and 10, reducing the opponent's accuracy by −8, −15, and −20, while decreasing their damage dealt and increasing damage taken.
When Stagger reaches the limit based on the opponent's grade, they are Stunned in the next round.
N Corp Wings do not use prosthetics.
상대에게 쌓으면 3스택마다 상대의 명중과 주는 피해가 줄어듭니다. 라운드: When applied to an opponent, every 3 stacks reduce their Accuracy and Damage dealt. Reduces by 1 at the end of the round. 8 new common reward cards added.
중지: 되갚음 스택 1당 받는 피해가 2 줄어들고, 다음 적중에서 스택을: Middle: Each stack of Repayment reduces incoming damage by 2. If stacks are consumed on the next hit, recover 1 HP per stack consumed. However, the bonus damage from Repayment has been reduced to 1 per stack.
약지: 적중할 때마다 \"작품\"이 쌓여 명중이 오르고, 가득 차면 다음: Ring: Each hit accumulates "Art," increasing Accuracy. When full, the next hit becomes stronger. Artistic Sense is not based on probability but increases every time you defeat 3 enemies.
Pinky: An incident occurs every 5 years for those who bear the mark.
출생 화면의 출신 · 재능 줄과 성장기 사이에 \"다시 태어난다\" 버튼: A "Reborn" button has been added between the Origin/Talent lines and the Growth Period on the Birth screen.
출생 화면 맨 아래의 \"어떤 출생 보정도 없이 시작한다\"를 누르면 출: Pressing "Start without any birth bonuses" at the bottom of the Birth screen starts you without any Origin, Talent, Flaw, Weapon, or Innate traits. Only Growth Period bonuses remain, starting empty-handed with 4 basic deck cards.
There is a unique ending if you clear Act 1 in this state.
각 칭호의 최고 등급에 오를 때마다 횟수가 쌓입니다. 기록실에서 \"본부: The count increases every time you reach the highest grade of each title. In Records, you can see how many times you have reached a status, such as "Headquarters Direct ×44." Titles not yet obtained are displayed as ???.
엔딩이 4종 늘어 기록실의 엔딩이 7종에서 11종이 되었습니다. 인연 ·: 4 endings have been added, bringing the total in Records from 7 to 11. These can be seen on the path starting without Connection/Family and Birth bonuses.
You can now set today's seed to different births for each date.
Several more hidden elements have been added.
Updated the "Current Considerations" on the main screen to the latest content.
Thank you to everyone who provided feedback.
Setting up a Wing changes the rank display to "Wing Representative."
Automatically used when HP drops to 30 or below during combat to restore 60 HP. Limited to 1 per battle; can be repurchased at the Workshop after use.
After Endless Mode, the price increases to 20,000 Ahn.
손가락에 들어갈 때 소지를 뺀 네 손가락(엄지·검지·중지·약지) 중에서: When entering the Fingers, you can manually choose from the four Fingers excluding the Pinky (Thumb, Index, Middle, Ring).
선택 화면에 각 손가락의 서열과 패시브가 표시됩니다. 검지의 마지막 서열: The selection screen displays the rank and passive of each Finger. The final rank of the Index is labeled "Messenger / Herald." The first rank of the Ring is "Student."
날개 임원(최고 직급)에 오르면 공방 3등급(명장)이 열립니다. 이전에는: Reaching Wing Executive (highest rank) unlocks Workshop Grade 3 (Master). Previously, this did not unlock because the Fixer grade did not increase.
직접 세운 날개가 승진·엔딩에서 입사한 회사 이름으로 보이던 문제를 고쳤: Fixed an issue where a self-established Wing appeared as the company name joined during promotions/endings.
화상: 라운드가 끝날 때 스택당 3 피해(내가 받으면 2), 최대 15스: Burn: Deals 3 damage per stack at the end of the round (2 if received by the player), max 15 stacks, then half the stacks remain. Burn stacks applied by enemies are halved.
이전의 \"화상 대상 추가 피해 ×1.5\"는 사라졌습니다. 호흡과 효과: The previous "Burn target bonus damage ×1.5" has been removed. This is because the effect overlapped with Poise.
레바테인의 붉은 화염과 푸른 화염은 화상과 별개로 분리했습니다. 레바테인: Levatein’s Red Flame and Blue Flame have been separated from Burn. These are exclusive to Levatein.
Fixed an issue where Burn on cards was not being applied.
보호막은 최대 150까지만 쌓입니다. 최대 체력보다 훨씬 많아지던 문제를: Shields now stack up to a maximum of 150. Prevented an issue where they exceeded maximum HP significantly.
Fixed an issue where the Notice button could not be clicked.
55년을 살아내면 제 1막 종료입니다. 여기서 끝내도 되고, 제 2막 시: Act 1 ends after surviving for 55 years. You can end it here or press Start Act 2 to continue living.
제 2막은 3년마다 위협 등급이 오르는 구간이고, 마지막 등급인 불순물을: Act 2 is a period where the Threat Level increases every 3 years; clearing the final level, Impuritas, leads to the true ending.
불순물을 넘긴 뒤에도 \"무한 모드로 계속한다\"를 고르면, 쓰러질 때까: If you choose "Continue in Endless Mode" after clearing Impuritas, it continues until you fall. You can also choose to end it here.
위협 보정이 끝없이 오르고, 8년마다 더 강해진 불순물이 나타납니다. 이: Threat bonuses increase infinitely, and stronger Impuritas appear every 8 years. Each victory makes the next one tougher.
세계에 균열이 갑니다. 루트와 상관없이 아직 이기지 못한 히든 보스 중: Cracks appear in the world. Regardless of the route, any hidden boss you haven't defeated yet may suddenly appear.
90년차부터는 전투 라운드마다 침식이 시작됩니다. 회피와 보호막으로도 막: From Year 90 onwards, Erosion begins every combat round. This is fixed damage that cannot be blocked by Evasion or Shields, and it increases as the years progress. Stats alone cannot withstand it.
결국 누구도 끝까지 버틸 수 없습니다. 얼마나 오래 살았는지가 기록입니다: In the end, no one can hold out forever. How long you lived is your record.
If you survive for a very long time, something happens.
One Innate trait has been added. It can be encountered very rarely.
엔딩 화면, 기록 공유, 이미지 저장에 클리어한 난이도(쉬움 / 보통 /: The cleared difficulty (Easy / Normal / Hard) is displayed on the ending screen, record sharing, and image saves.
시작 화면의 난이도 설명을 고쳤습니다. \"수동 플레이 권장\"은 쉬움에: Fixed the difficulty description on the start screen. "Manual play recommended" is displayed for Easy, and Normal is displayed as the default difficulty.
"Rest" at the Workshop street can now only be used once per year. This prevents the issue of infinitely recovering Sanity by reloading saves.
전투에서 패배가 정해지면 저장이 지워집니다. 패배 화면에서 새로고침해서: Saves are deleted once defeat is determined in combat. This prevents the issue of refreshing the screen to retry after a defeat.
쉬움 (수동 플레이 권장): 해마다 강해지던 적의 보정을 없애고, 처음: Easy (Manual play recommended): Removes the enemy's annual strength bonus and sets them to the weak enemies configured at the start. There is no card grade bonus based on the protagonist's years. Even on Easy, the minimum strength of hidden bosses remains.
Hard: Same as the existing Hard.
Difficulty is selected upon rebirth, and completion records for Easy/Hard are kept separately.
협회에 입회하면 협회 전용 카드 10장을 한 번에 받고, 덱이 통째로 바: Joining an Association grants 10 Association-exclusive cards at once, and the entire deck is replaced. All previously collected cards disappear.
전용 카드팩이라 이후 카드는 얻을 수 없고, 카드 보상은 돈으로 바뀝니다: As it is an exclusive card pack, no further cards can be obtained, and card rewards are converted into money.
Promotions to Section Chief, Department Head, or Branch Manager grant money along with stat increases.
본부 직속에 오르면 협회 최고에게 주는 전리품 '협회 최고의 휘장'을 받: Reaching Headquarters Direct grants the "Association's Highest Badge," a trophy given to the best in the Association, and the Fixer grade becomes at least Grade 2.
Association passives are maintained even if the card pack is changed to hidden pages later.
하나 협회 · 건곤감리: 전투에서 카드를 고르기 전에 매 라운드 한 가지: Hana Association · Heaven, Earth, Fire, Water: Choose one effect each round before selecting cards in combat. Heaven (Attack Damage +2), Earth (Incoming Damage -30%), Fire (Light +1), Water (HP +2 / Poise +2). The same hexagram cannot be chosen consecutively.
생크 협회 · 결투 선언: 모든 전투에서 나와 상대가 주는 피해가 +3입: Zwei Association · Duel Declaration: Damage dealt by you and the opponent in all battles is +3.
시 협회 · 사의 경계(4코스트 카드): 1d4를 굴려 4가 나오면 피해: Shi Association · Boundary of Death (4-cost card): Roll 1d4; if 4, deal 40 damage; if 1-3, deal base damage.
금기 실험이 최대 8회까지 가능해졌고, 8회 합계 보상은 최대 HP +4: Taboo Experiments can now be performed up to 8 times, with a total reward of Max HP +40, Attack +16, and Evasion +8. Rewards per attempt have been reduced.
Fixed an issue where stats continued to accumulate by repeating Taboo Experiments infinitely.
HP reduction for the "My Body" option has been reduced from -8 to -3.
The path of the 1st Progeny is now open.
A new story begins after defeating the Librarian, Abel.
Today's seed is fixed to Bloodfiend lineage.
Assets remain fixed at the top even when scrolling on the Workshop street.
Assets are visible immediately from any tab when opening the bag.
\"급수 심사\" 사건의 성공 문구가 실제 효과(승급 포인트)와 맞지 않: Fixed the issue where the success message for the "Grade Examination" event did not match the actual effect (Promotion Points).
수동 모드에서는 주사위 결과가 나오면 화면을 클릭할 때까지 멈춥니다. 결: In manual mode, the game pauses when dice results appear until you click the screen. You can check the results visually before proceeding.
Fixed dice positions. Enemies are on the left, and the player is on the right.
이제 글자 입력 최대수가 늘어납니다. 1 ~ 12: The maximum character input limit is now increased to 1-12.
시드는 출생만 정합니다. 출신·재능·결점·무기, 성장기와 숨은 출생 굴림: The seed only determines birth. Origin, Talent, Flaw, Weapon, Growth Period, and hidden birth rolls will be the same if the seed is the same.

. 그 뒤로도 한 번 더 도망쳤다: . I ran away once more after that.
쌍갈고리 해적단과 얽혔다: I got entangled with the Hook Office.

도망치던 재앙을 이제는 사냥하는 쪽이 되었다: I have become the one who hunts the Calamity I once fled from.
은혜는 갚는 쪽이 먼저 기억한다고 했다. 도운 이들의 얼굴이 도시 곳곳에: They said the one who receives a favor remembers it first. The faces of those I helped remained all over the City, nodding at me even on unfamiliar paths.
원한은 소리 없이 쌓였다. 등을 돌린 이들의 말이 골목마다 돌았고, 그: Resentment piled up silently. The words of those who turned their backs on me circulated through every alley, and those words lasted longer than my name.
지나친 일이 많았다. 잘못이라 할 것은 아니었지만, 도시는 침묵도 장부에: There were many things that went too far. It wasn't exactly a mistake, but the City records even silence in its ledger.
Once, someone was by my side. One name I couldn't protect remained for a long time.
The bookshelf was finally moved to the Outskirts.
사서가 쓰러진 날 아벨은 그 이름이 적힌 책을 서가에 꽂았다. 책의 등급: On the day the Librarian fell, Abel placed the book with that name on the shelf. The book's grade was set to match that of the final guest.
호수는 해마다 깊어졌고: The lake grew deeper every year, and

전쟁이 끝난 밤, 몸이 가볍게 갈라지며 날개가 펼쳐졌다. 가루가 떨어지는: On the night the war ended, my body split lightly and wings unfolded. Light flickered wherever the dust fell. The swarm looked up at the Princess in silence. The Princess did not sit on the throne but stood by the window, watching the City's lights for a long time. All the lights were flying toward this side.
전쟁이 끝난 뒤에도 몸은 죽지 않았다. 부서진 자리마다 갑각이 자랐고,: Even after the war ended, the body did not die. Carapace grew where it was broken, and the swarm gathered where it had struck down. The Emperor sat on the throne. The throne was in the middle of the ruins. The Emperor knew that nothing could end this body. The fact that there was nothing left to end was the heaviest burden.
전쟁터는 곧 식탁이 되었다. 대왕이 손을 들자 군체가 일제히 소리를 낮추: The battlefield soon became a dining table. When the Great King raised a hand, the swarm lowered their voices in unison. The rotten and the newly born were placed on the same plate. The Great King ate nothing and watched the swarm eat for a long time. This City will not be quiet for a while.
병기의 몸으로 인간의 하루를 살기로 했다. 이음매는 아직 뻐근했고 먹은: I decided to live a human's day in the body of a weapon. The joints were still stiff, and what I had eaten was quiet inside me. The royal factor lay deep within. I know what this body was made for. So, I greeted the morning without eating anything today.
도서관의 힘을 뽑아 머리에게 가져갔다. 도서관은 도시의 지도에서 사라졌다: I extracted the Library's power and brought it to the Head. The Library disappeared from the City's map. I walked toward where the lights were turning on one by one. The Head's waiting room was empty, and a single order was left on the desk. There was only a number in the reason column. I had returned as a piece on the board. I put the Claw into the drawer without sharpening it.
I destroyed the Library, leaving not a single bookshelf behind. The names within the books scattered. I left the Claw at the entrance to the road. Orders no longer arrived. Outside the line, the sun rose in a different direction each time. I did not follow. The nameless days rusted on the road.
도서관의 힘을 뽑아 균형의 한쪽을 도시에 남겨 두고 돌아섰다. 도서관은: I extracted the Library's power, left one side of the balance in the City, and turned away. The Library disappeared from the City's map. The remaining side was recorded as a single line in the adjustment ledger. The City knew how to maintain balance without this side. The Head said nothing.
도서관을 조율의 대상에서 지웠다. 서가가 하나씩 사라졌다. 조율자의 인장: I erased the Library from the target of adjustment. The bookshelves disappeared one by one. I laid the Arbiter's seal on the road. The seal hit the ground with a sound only after a long time. For the first time, a day passed where nothing needed to be adjusted. It was not an easy day.
도서관이 외곽으로 옮겨진 날, 사서는 마지막 책을 서가의 가장 높은 칸에: On the day the Library was moved to the Outskirts, the Librarian placed the last book on the highest shelf. The library door was open, but Abel said nothing. The invitations to the City did not stop even after that. The Librarian dusts the shelves before guests arrive today as well. No one told me if a single book was created. The Librarian did not ask.
제나가 쓰러진 자리에서 사서는 서가의 불을 하나씩 껐다. 책들은 도시의: Where Zena fell, the Librarian turned off the library lights one by one. The books scattered from the shelves like stars in the City. The book being made remained one page short, never read by anyone. Abel stood in front of the library door for a long time. The Library is neither in the City nor the Outskirts. The Librarian stroked the cover of the last book. No name was written on the cover.
After Luen fell, the terminal rang once. It was a blank screen, not a sentence. The directive I had followed for so long said nothing for the first time. There is a bowl on the table, and I sat in front of it. At the end of the same road, I heard the sound of waves. I did not put the terminal in the drawer. I left it on.
It was the morning I crossed the bridge. The terminal rang once where Luen fell. This time, too, it was a dot, not a sentence. The sound of waves was heard briefly from afar and then stopped. There is still warm soup on the table. Today's directive is just to cross the bridge before sunset. I thought that much was fine to follow.
서명란에 이름이 올라가는 순간 방의 불이 한 번 깜빡였다. 니콜라이가 앉: The moment my name went on the signature line, the room's light flickered once. The seat where Nikolai sat was empty, and now you sit there. A disposal judgment is placed on the Commander's desk. The target in the first line is empty. This ledger will be filled line by line from now on. Beside the desk, the black saber flashed once. For the first time, I sat on the side that writes.
명령서는 찢어졌지만 자리는 비우지 않았다. 사령관의 자리를 지킨 채 도시: The order was torn, but I did not vacate the seat. I kept the Commander's seat and went on a mission outside the City. The path went astray where I followed the traces of the Impurity. I retraced the way back several times, but the place I arrived at was not the City. The dimension of the Outskirts twisted the direction, and the City was no longer a place I could return to.
승강장에 처음으로 해가 졌다. 서류에는 서명이 남았고, 손에는 닳은 공구: For the first time, the sun set on the platform. My signature remained on the documents, and a worn tool was held in my hand. The train sounded its departure signal without you. It was a sound that ended before you could count to ten. You walked with your back to that sound. You can no longer speak of the word Singularity or what happens inside the train. I do not know for what reason. There are still many paths in the City you do not know.
웨이페어러 컴퍼니의 안내원이 서류를 내밀었다. 열차 없이 문과 문을 잇는: A Wayfarer Company guide handed me the documents. It was a contract to connect doors without a train. With the contract money, I had a warm meal for the first time in a while. The W Corp Wing's seat is shaking, and within that shaking, you remained as just another nameless staff member. It felt strange that there was a way to not have your time stolen.
서류는 서랍 안에서 번호표가 되었다. 정리 요원장이 된 당신은 도착한 열: The documents became a number tag in the drawer. As the head of the cleanup crew, you identify the nameless fragments on every arriving train and seat them. The passengers believe they arrived before they could count to ten. You are one of the few who remembers everything that happened between those ten counts. The next train is coming in.
The Head of the Family came out from inside the door. I am with a Head who has the same face but something has changed. I don't know why, but it feels like I missed something. However, as the First Black Silence, I only protect the Head.
후보는 선황충도 가주의 자리도 받아들이지 않았다. 필두는 그 손을 잡고: The candidate did not accept the Seonhwangchung nor the Head's seat. The First took that hand and left the pavilion, and the twelve Black Silences opened the way. The family sent the branch assassins, the pursuing Black Silences, the First Black Silences, and finally Hong Lu, but all fell on the road. The pressure of the family and its dark secrets are now behind me. The City outside the Hongwon is unfamiliar and vast. The story of the two begins now.
붉은 누각의 등이 모두 켜졌다. 열두 흑수가 고개를 숙이고 가주의 자리가: All the lanterns of the Red Pavilion were lit. The twelve Black Silences bowed their heads, and the Head's seat was vacated. You are the one who sat in the seat, but the Seonhwangchung eats and drinks in your name. The body knows no fatigue, and the heart is a layer away. Hongwon has a new owner, and the owner does not yet know who they are.

While you rested, the fatigue in your body slowly unwound.
What remained was not the amount of work done but its shape. It was strangely satisfying.
The stopped clocks pointed to the right time. No one asked why.
같은 이야기를 하는 노인: The Old Man with One Story
공원 의자의 노인이 해마다 같은 이야기를 한다. 올해는 끝이 조금 달라졌: The old man on the park bench tells the same story every year. This year the ending has changed a little: the person in the story steps out of the story and walks away.
마지막 문장이 끝나자 노인은 오래 숨을 내쉬었다. 이야기의 값으로 작은: When the last sentence ended, the old man let out a long breath. As payment for the story he handed over a small pouch.
The old man opened his eyes wide. From the next day the story followed a new road.
Behind you, you heard the story begin again from the start.
처음 보는 사람이 길을 묻는다. 목적지가 이 도시에 없는 이름이다. 그런: A stranger asks the way. The destination is a name that does not exist in this city. Yet they wear the face of someone who must take that road.
아는 길을 알려 준다: Point out a road you know
알려 준 길은 아무 데도 닿지 않았지만, 그 사람은 고개를 숙이고 떠났다: The road you pointed out led nowhere, but the person bowed and left.
한참을 걷다 보니 둘 다 처음 보는 골목에 서 있었다. 다리는 피곤한데: After a long walk, you both found yourselves in an alley neither had seen. Your legs were tired, but your mind was light.
그 사람은 인사 없이 돌아섰다. 돌아서는 걸음이 당신의 걸음과 닮아 있었: The person turned away without a word. The way they walked off resembled your own gait.
오래 입던 외투가 어느 날 갑자기 가벼워졌다. 주머니 속의 것들이 하나씩: The coat you have long worn suddenly became lighter one day. The things in its pockets are vanishing one by one. You cannot tell what has gone.
A few coins from long ago rolled out onto the floor.
The new coat fit snugly. What had vanished stayed vanished.
Your steps were as light as the coat had become.
서랍에서 오래된 사진이 나왔다. 사람들이 줄지어 서 있는데 한 자리가 비: An old photograph turned up in a drawer. People stand in a row, but one place is empty. It looks less like someone was erased from it than like it was left empty from the start.
The next morning, the empty place in the photograph had become a little warmer.
사진을 벽에 건다: Hang the photograph on the wall
걸어 둔 사진은 이튿날 한 칸씩 채워져 있었다. 누구인지는 읽히지 않는다: The hung photograph had one more place filled in by the next day. Who it is cannot be read.
도로 서랍에 넣는다: Put it back in the drawer
The photograph lay quietly in the drawer.
하늘의 얇은 곳: The Thin Place in the Sky
하늘의 한쪽이 종이처럼 얇아져 있다. 구름이 그곳을 지날 때마다 가는 빛: One side of the sky has worn thin like paper. Each time a cloud passes it, a fine light leaks through. No one in the city looks up.
한참 올려다본다: Look up for a long while
A single thread of light came down from the thin place and settled on your shoulder.
모른 척 걷는다: Walk on pretending not to notice
As you walked, your shadow leaned slightly toward the sky.
The person who heard laughed. From that day on, a few people began to look up.
마지막 계절의 냄새: The Smell of the Last Season
바람에서 어딘가 끝나가는 계절의 냄새가 난다. 오래 걸어온 길의 마지막: The wind carries the smell of a season somewhere coming to its end. Someone once said it is the smell met by one who has reached the last stretch of a long road.
The smell settled deep in your chest and sank for a long while.
The pocket was empty, but it stayed warm for a while.
The smell did not follow. That is why it stayed in memory longer.
